+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_clm_apply (L : R2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : R2) :
+    L v = v 0 * L (e 0) + v 1 * L (e 1) := by
+  have hv : v = v 0 • e 0 + v 1 • e 1 := by
+    ext i
+    fin_cases i <;> simp [e]
+  conv_lhs => rw [hv]
+  simp [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
+
+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_opn1 (g : R2 → ℝ) (x : R2) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
+    (h : ∀ j : Fin 2, |pd j g x| ≤ M) : ‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ ≤ 2 * M := by
+  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) fun v => ?_
+  rw [prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_clm_apply (fderiv ℝ g x) v, Real.norm_eq_abs]
+  have hv : ∀ j : Fin 2, |v j| ≤ ‖v‖ := fun j => by
+    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
+    rcases j with ⟨j, hj⟩
+    interval_cases j
+    · calc |v 0| = Real.sqrt (|v 0| ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq (abs_nonneg _)).symm
+        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (|v 0| ^ 2 + |v 1| ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 1)])
+    · calc |v 1| = Real.sqrt (|v 1| ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq (abs_nonneg _)).symm
+        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (|v 0| ^ 2 + |v 1| ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 0)])
+  have h0 := h 0; have h1 := h 1
+  unfold pd at h0 h1
+  calc |v 0 * fderiv ℝ g x (e 0) + v 1 * fderiv ℝ g x (e 1)|
+      ≤ |v 0| * |fderiv ℝ g x (e 0)| + |v 1| * |fderiv ℝ g x (e 1)| := by
+        refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_; rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
+    _ ≤ ‖v‖ * M + ‖v‖ * M := by
+        gcongr
+        · exact hv 0
+        · exact hv 1
+    _ = 2 * M * ‖v‖ := by ring
+
+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_opn2 (F : R2 → R2) (x : R2) (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x) (M : ℝ)
+    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (h : ∀ i j : Fin 2, |pd j (fun y => F y i) x| ≤ M) : ‖fderiv ℝ F x‖ ≤ 4 * M := by
+  have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ v, (fderiv ℝ F x v) i = fderiv ℝ (fun y => F y i) x v := by
+    intro i v
+    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (⇑(EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 2) i) ∘ F)
+        ((EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 2) i).comp (fderiv ℝ F x)) x :=
+      (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 2) i).hasFDerivAt.comp x hF.hasFDerivAt
+    have h2 : (fun y => F y i) = ⇑(EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 2) i) ∘ F := rfl
+    rw [h2, h1.fderiv]; rfl
+  have hci : ∀ i : Fin 2, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => F y i) x‖ ≤ 2 * M := fun i =>

+  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) fun v => ?_
+  have hn : ‖fderiv ℝ F x v‖ ≤ |(fderiv ℝ F x v) 0| + |(fderiv ℝ F x v) 1| := by
+    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
+    rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)]
+    nlinarith [abs_nonneg ((fderiv ℝ F x v) 0), abs_nonneg ((fderiv ℝ F x v) 1)]
+  calc ‖fderiv ℝ F x v‖ ≤ |(fderiv ℝ F x v) 0| + |(fderiv ℝ F x v) 1| := hn
+    _ = |fderiv ℝ (fun y => F y 0) x v| + |fderiv ℝ (fun y => F y 1) x v| := by rw [hcomp 0, hcomp 1]
+    _ ≤ 2 * M * ‖v‖ + 2 * M * ‖v‖ := by
+        gcongr
+        · rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (fderiv ℝ (fun y => F y 0) x).le_of_opNorm_le (hci 0) v
+        · rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (fderiv ℝ (fun y => F y 1) x).le_of_opNorm_le (hci 1) v
+    _ = 4 * M * ‖v‖ := by ring
+
+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_L2 {E' : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E'] (g : R2 → E') (M ρ : ℝ)
+    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hb : ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ M) (hρ : ∀ x : R2, ρ ≤ ‖x‖ → g x = 0) :
+    eLpNorm g 2 volume ≤
+      ENNReal.ofReal (M * (volume (Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) ρ)).toReal ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ))) := by
+  have hpt : ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ ‖(Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) ρ).indicator (fun _ => M) x‖ := by
+    intro x
+    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) ρ
+    · rw [indicator_of_mem hx, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hM]; exact hb x
+    · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hx
+      rw [hρ x hx.le, norm_zero]; exact norm_nonneg _
+  refine (eLpNorm_mono hpt).trans ?_
+  rw [eLpNorm_indicator_const measurableSet_closedBall (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
+  have hv : volume (Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) ρ) =
+      ENNReal.ofReal (volume (Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) ρ)).toReal :=
+    (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_closedBall_lt_top).ne).symm
+  rw [hv, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, ENNReal.toReal_ofNat,
+    ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2),
+    Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs, abs_of_nonneg hM, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hM]
+
+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_n2 (y : R2) : ‖y‖ ≤ |y 0| + |y 1| := by
+  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
+  rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)]
+  nlinarith [abs_nonneg (y 0), abs_nonneg (y 1)]
+
+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_section_differentiable {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F]
+    [NormedSpace ℝ F] {τ : ℝ} (g : ℝ → R2 → F)
+    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => g z.1 z.2) (Icc 0 τ ×ˢ univ))
+    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 τ) : Differentiable ℝ (g t) := by
+  have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((fun z : ℝ × R2 => g z.1 z.2) ∘ (fun x : R2 => (t, x))) univ :=
+    hg.comp (contDiff_prodMk_right t).contDiffOn (fun x _ => ⟨ht, mem_univ _⟩)
+  have hc' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (g t) := by
+    rw [← contDiffOn_univ]
+    exact hc
+  exact hc'.differentiable (by norm_cast)
+
+def prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_WeakForm (κ τ : ℝ) (θ : ℝ → R2 → ℝ) (u fu : ℝ → R2 → R2) : Prop :=
+  ∀ φ : ℝ × R2 → R2, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
+    tsupport φ ⊆ Ioo 0 τ ×ˢ univ → (∀ z : ℝ × R2, div2 (fun y => φ (z.1, y)) z.2 = 0) →
+    ∫ z : ℝ × R2, ∑ i : Fin 2,
+      ( (u z.1 z.2) i * deriv (fun s => (φ (s, z.2)) i) z.1
+        + ∑ j : Fin 2, (u z.1 z.2) i * (u z.1 z.2) j * pd j (fun y => (φ (z.1, y)) i) z.2
+        + (κ * θ z.1 z.2 * (if i = 1 then 1 else 0) + (fu z.1 z.2) i) * (φ z) i ) = 0
+
+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_core {κ T : ℝ} {θ p fθ : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {u fu : ℝ → R2 → R2}
+    (hCB : ClassicalBoussinesq κ T θ p u fu fθ)
+    {R : ℝ} (hθs : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x : R2, R ≤ ‖x‖ → θ t x = 0)
+    (hus : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x : R2, R ≤ ‖x‖ → u t x = 0)
+    {τ : ℝ} (hτT : τ < T)
+    (hweak : prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_WeakForm κ τ θ u fu) :
+    InLipschitzClass κ τ θ u fθ fu := by
+  have hIco : Icc 0 τ ⊆ Ico 0 T := Icc_subset_Ico_right hτT
+  have hS : Icc 0 τ ×ˢ (univ : Set R2) ⊆ Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ := prod_mono hIco subset_rfl
+  have hθsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => θ z.1 z.2) (Icc 0 τ ×ˢ univ) := hCB.smoothθ.mono hS
+  have husm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => u z.1 z.2) (Icc 0 τ ×ˢ univ) := hCB.smoothu.mono hS
+  have huism : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => (u z.1 z.2) i) (Icc 0 τ ×ˢ univ) :=
+    fun i => contDiffOn_euclidean.mp husm i
+  have hθv : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 τ, ∀ x : R2, R ≤ ‖x‖ → θ t x = 0 := fun t ht => hθs t (hIco ht)
+  have huiv : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 τ, ∀ x : R2, R ≤ ‖x‖ → (u t x) i = 0 :=
+    fun i t ht x hx => by rw [hus t (hIco ht) x hx]; rfl
+
+  obtain ⟨Mθ0, hMθ0, hθb0⟩ := Kit.paramLinearOp_contDiffOn_aux_bound 0 τ R θ hθsm hθv []
+  have hθb1 : ∀ j : Fin 2, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 τ, ∀ x : R2, |pd j (θ t) x| ≤ M := fun j =>
+    Kit.paramLinearOp_contDiffOn_aux_bound 0 τ R θ hθsm hθv [j]
+  choose Mθ1 hMθ1 hθb1 using hθb1
+  have hub0 : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 τ, ∀ x : R2, |(u t x) i| ≤ M := fun i =>
+    Kit.paramLinearOp_contDiffOn_aux_bound 0 τ R (fun t x => (u t x) i) (huism i) (huiv i) []
+  choose Mu0 hMu0 hub0 using hub0
+  have hub1 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 τ, ∀ x : R2,
+      |pd j (fun y => (u t y) i) x| ≤ M := fun i j =>
+    Kit.paramLinearOp_contDiffOn_aux_bound 0 τ R (fun t x => (u t x) i) (huism i) (huiv i) [j]
+  choose Mu1 hMu1 hub1 using hub1
+  set VC : ℝ := (volume (Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) R)).toReal ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) with hVC
+  have hVC0 : 0 ≤ VC := by positivity
+  set Mu1s : ℝ := Mu1 0 0 + Mu1 0 1 + Mu1 1 0 + Mu1 1 1 with hMu1s
+  have hMu1s0 : 0 ≤ Mu1s := by
+    have := hMu1 0 0; have := hMu1 0 1; have := hMu1 1 0; have := hMu1 1 1; positivity
+  have hMu1le : ∀ i j : Fin 2, Mu1 i j ≤ Mu1s := by
+    have := hMu1 0 0; have := hMu1 0 1; have := hMu1 1 0; have := hMu1 1 1
+    refine Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩, Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;>
+      simp only [hMu1s] <;> linarith
+  set ME : ℝ := max (Mθ0 * VC) ((Mu0 0 + Mu0 1) * VC) with hME
+  set MD : ℝ := max (2 * (Mθ1 0 + Mθ1 1)) (4 * Mu1s) with hMD
+
+  have hsecu : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 τ, Differentiable ℝ (u t) :=
+    fun t ht => prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_section_differentiable u husm t ht
+  refine ⟨?_, ⟨ME, fun t ht => ?_⟩, ⟨MD, fun t ht x => ?_⟩, fun t ht => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+  ·
+    have h := hθsm.prodMk husm
+    exact (h.of_le (by norm_cast)).locallyLipschitzOn ((convex_Icc 0 τ).prod convex_univ)
+  ·
+    obtain ⟨hmu, hmθ⟩ := hCB.finiteEnergy t (hIco ht)
+    refine ⟨hmu, hmθ, ?_, ?_⟩
+    · have h2 : eLpNorm (u t) 2 volume ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((Mu0 0 + Mu0 1) * VC) := by
+        refine prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_L2 (u t) (Mu0 0 + Mu0 1) R (by linarith [hMu0 0, hMu0 1])
+          (fun x => ?_) (fun x hx => hus t (hIco ht) x hx)
+        exact (prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_n2 _).trans (add_le_add (hub0 0 t ht x) (hub0 1 t ht x))
+      calc (eLpNorm (u t) 2 volume).toReal ≤ (Mu0 0 + Mu0 1) * VC := by
+            refine (ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top h2).trans ?_
+            rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (mul_nonneg (by linarith [hMu0 0, hMu0 1]) hVC0)]
+        _ ≤ ME := le_max_right _ _
+    · have h2 : eLpNorm (θ t) 2 volume ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Mθ0 * VC) := by
+        refine prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_L2 (θ t) Mθ0 R hMθ0 (fun x => ?_) (fun x hx => hθs t (hIco ht) x hx)
+        have := hθb0 t ht x
+        simpa [Cm24.iterPartial, Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
+      calc (eLpNorm (θ t) 2 volume).toReal ≤ Mθ0 * VC := by
+            refine (ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top h2).trans ?_
+            rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (mul_nonneg hMθ0 hVC0)]
+        _ ≤ ME := le_max_left _ _
+  ·
+    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
+    · have h : ∀ j : Fin 2, |pd j (θ t) x| ≤ Mθ1 0 + Mθ1 1 := by
+        intro j
+        fin_cases j
+        · exact (hθb1 0 t ht x).trans (by linarith [hMθ1 1])
+        · exact (hθb1 1 t ht x).trans (by linarith [hMθ1 0])
+      exact (prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_opn1 (θ t) x _ (by linarith [hMθ1 0, hMθ1 1]) h).trans
+        (le_max_left _ _)
+    · have h : ∀ i j : Fin 2, |pd j (fun y => (u t y) i) x| ≤ Mu1s :=
+        fun i j => (hub1 i j t ht x).trans (hMu1le i j)
+      exact (prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_opn2 (u t) x ((hsecu t ht) x) Mu1s hMu1s0 h).trans
+        (le_max_right _ _)
+  ·
+    exact ae_of_all _ (hCB.divFree t (hIco ht))
+  ·
+    have hmeas : MeasurableSet (Icc 0 τ ×ˢ (univ : Set R2)) := measurableSet_Icc.prod MeasurableSet.univ
+    exact (ae_restrict_iff' hmeas).2 (ae_of_all _ fun z hz => hCB.eqθ z.1 (hIco hz.1) z.2)
+  ·
+    exact hweak
+
+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_cmul {U : Set (ℝ × R2)} (hU : IsOpen U) (f g : ℝ × R2 → ℝ)
+    (hf : ContinuousOn f U) (hg : Continuous g) (hgs : tsupport g ⊆ U) :
+    Continuous (fun z => f z * g z) := by
+  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
+  intro z
+  by_cases hz : z ∈ U
+  · exact ((hf z hz).continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).mul hg.continuousAt
+  · have hz' : z ∉ tsupport g := fun h => hz (hgs h)
+    have h0 : g =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hz'
+    have h1 : (fun _ : ℝ × R2 => (0 : ℝ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w => f w * g w := by
+      filter_upwards [h0] with w hw
+      simp [hw]
+    exact continuousAt_const.congr h1
+
+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_integrable {U : Set (ℝ × R2)} (hU : IsOpen U) (f g : ℝ × R2 → ℝ)
+    (hf : ContinuousOn f U) (hg : Continuous g) (hgc : HasCompactSupport g) (hgs : tsupport g ⊆ U) :
+    Integrable (fun z => f z * g z) := by
+  refine (prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_cmul hU f g hf hg hgs).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport ?_
+  exact (hgc.mul_left : HasCompactSupport (f * g))
+
+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_pdt (g : ℝ → R2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : R2) (ht : 0 < t)
+    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => g z.1 z.2) (t, x)) :
+    pdt g t x = fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => g z.1 z.2) (t, x) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : R2)) := by
+  have hc : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => ((τ, x) : ℝ × R2)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : R2)) t :=
+    (hasDerivAt_id t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const t x)
+  have h := hg.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hc
+  have h' : HasDerivAt (fun τ => g τ x) (fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => g z.1 z.2) (t, x) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : R2))) t := h
+  unfold pdt
+  rw [derivWithin_of_mem_nhds (Ici_mem_nhds ht), h'.deriv]
+
+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_pdx (g : ℝ → R2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : R2) (j : Fin 2)
+    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => g z.1 z.2) (t, x)) :
+    pd j (g t) x = fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => g z.1 z.2) (t, x) ((0 : ℝ), e j) := by
+  have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun y : R2 => ((t, y) : ℝ × R2)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ R2) x :=
+    ((hasFDerivAt_const t x).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id x))
+  have h := hg.hasFDerivAt.comp x hc
+  have h' : HasFDerivAt (g t) ((fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => g z.1 z.2) (t, x)).comp
+      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ R2)) x := h
+  unfold pd
+  rw [h'.fderiv]
+  rfl
+
+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_test (φ : ℝ × R2 → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (t : ℝ) (x : R2) (j : Fin 2) :
+    deriv (fun τ => φ (τ, x)) t = fderiv ℝ φ (t, x) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : R2)) ∧
+    pd j (fun y => φ (t, y)) x = fderiv ℝ φ (t, x) ((0 : ℝ), e j) := by
+  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ (t, x) := (hφ.differentiable (by norm_cast)).differentiableAt
+  constructor
+  · have hc : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => ((τ, x) : ℝ × R2)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : R2)) t :=
+      (hasDerivAt_id t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const t x)
+    exact (hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hc).deriv
+  · have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun y : R2 => ((t, y) : ℝ × R2)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ R2) x :=
+      ((hasFDerivAt_const t x).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id x))
+    have h' : HasFDerivAt (fun y => φ (t, y)) ((fderiv ℝ φ (t, x)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ R2)) x :=
+      hd.hasFDerivAt.comp x hc
+    unfold pd; rw [h'.fderiv]; rfl
+
+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_supp {E' F' : Type*} [Zero E'] [Zero F'] [TopologicalSpace E']
+    (g : ℝ × R2 → E') (h : ℝ × R2 → F') (h0 : ∀ z, g z = 0 → h z = 0) :
+    tsupport h ⊆ tsupport g ∧ (HasCompactSupport g → HasCompactSupport h) := by
+  have hs : Function.support h ⊆ Function.support g := fun z hz hg => hz (h0 z hg)
+  exact ⟨closure_mono hs, fun hc => hc.mono hs⟩
+
+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_prodDiff {U : Set (ℝ × R2)} (hU : IsOpen U) (f g : ℝ × R2 → ℝ)
+    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℝ f U) (hg : Differentiable ℝ g) (hgs : tsupport g ⊆ U) (z v : ℝ × R2) :
+    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => f w * g w) z ∧
+      fderiv ℝ (fun w => f w * g w) z v = fderiv ℝ f z v * g z + f z * fderiv ℝ g z v := by
+  by_cases hz : z ∈ U
+  · have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z := hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
+    refine ⟨hfd.mul (hg z), ?_⟩
+    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hfd (hg z)]
+    simp only [add_apply, FunLike.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
+    ring
+  · have hz' : z ∉ tsupport g := fun h => hz (hgs h)
+    have h0 : g =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hz'
+    have h1 : (fun w => f w * g w) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
+      filter_upwards [h0] with w hw
+      simp [hw]
+    refine ⟨(h1.differentiableAt_iff).2 (differentiableAt_const _), ?_⟩
+    rw [h1.fderiv_eq, fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport ℝ hz', image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz']
+    simp
+

+theorem prop_7_3_lipschitzClass_weak (κ Tst T' : ℝ) (hT' : T' ≤ Tst)
+    (θ p : ℝ → R2 → ℝ) (u fu : ℝ → R2 → R2)
+    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => u z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 Tst ×ˢ univ))
+    (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => p z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 Tst ×ˢ univ))
+    (hθ : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × R2 => θ z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 Tst ×ˢ univ))
+    (hfu : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × R2 => fu z.1 z.2 i) (Ico 0 Tst ×ˢ univ))
+    (hdiv : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 Tst, ∀ x, div2 (u t) x = 0)
+    (hequ : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 Tst, ∀ x, ∀ i : Fin 2,
+      pdt (fun τ y => (u τ y) i) t x + advect (u t) (fun y => (u t y) i) x + pd i (p t) x
+        = κ * θ t x * (if i = 1 then 1 else 0) + (fu t x) i)
+    (φ : ℝ × R2 → R2) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
+    (hφs : tsupport φ ⊆ Ioo 0 T' ×ˢ univ) (hφdiv : ∀ z : ℝ × R2, div2 (fun y => φ (z.1, y)) z.2 = 0) :
+    ∫ z : ℝ × R2, ∑ i : Fin 2,
+      ( (u z.1 z.2) i * deriv (fun τ => (φ (τ, z.2)) i) z.1
+        + ∑ j : Fin 2, (u z.1 z.2) i * (u z.1 z.2) j * pd j (fun y => (φ (z.1, y)) i) z.2
+        + (κ * θ z.1 z.2 * (if i = 1 then 1 else 0) + (fu z.1 z.2) i) * (φ z) i ) = 0 := by
+  haveI hHaar : (volume : Measure (ℝ × R2)).IsAddHaarMeasure := Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
+  set U : Set (ℝ × R2) := Ioo 0 Tst ×ˢ univ with hUdef
+  have hUo : IsOpen U := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ
+  have hUS : U ⊆ Ico 0 Tst ×ˢ univ := prod_mono Ioo_subset_Ico_self subset_rfl
+  set ui : Fin 2 → ℝ × R2 → ℝ := fun i z => u z.1 z.2 i with huidef
+  set φi : Fin 2 → ℝ × R2 → ℝ := fun i z => φ z i with hφidef
+  set P : ℝ × R2 → ℝ := fun z => p z.1 z.2 with hPdef
+  set v0 : ℝ × R2 := ((1 : ℝ), (0 : R2)) with hv0
+  set vx : Fin 2 → ℝ × R2 := fun j => ((0 : ℝ), e j) with hvx
+  have hφi_sm : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (φi i) := fun i => contDiff_euclidean.1 hφ i
+  have hφi_d : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (φi i) := fun i => (hφi_sm i).differentiable (by norm_cast)
+  have hui_sm : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ui i) U := fun i => (contDiffOn_euclidean.1 hu i).mono hUS
+  have hui_d : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℝ (ui i) U := fun i => (hui_sm i).differentiableOn (by norm_cast)
+  have hui_c : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (ui i) U := fun i => (hui_sm i).continuousOn
+  have hP_sm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P U := hp.mono hUS
+  have hP_d : DifferentiableOn ℝ P U := hP_sm.differentiableOn (by norm_cast)
+  have hDui_c : ∀ i (w : ℝ × R2), ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ (ui i) z w) U := fun i w =>
+    ((hui_sm i).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hUo (by norm_cast)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
+  have hDP_c : ∀ (w : ℝ × R2), ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ P z w) U := fun w =>
+    (hP_sm.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hUo (by norm_cast)).clm_apply continuousOn_const

+def prop71_rotPath (x : R2) (s : ℝ) : R2 :=

+  constructor <;> simp [prop71_rotPath, Mat2.e_apply]

+theorem prop71_norm_rotPath (x : R2) (s : ℝ) : ‖prop71_rotPath x s‖ = ‖x‖ := by

+    rw [Mat2.normSq_coord, Mat2.normSq_coord, (prop71_rotPath_coord x s).1, (prop71_rotPath_coord x s).2]
+    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq s]

+theorem prop71_hasDerivAt_rotPath (x : R2) : HasDerivAt (prop71_rotPath x) (Mat2.perp x) 0 := by

+    ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos 0).const_mul (x 0)).sub ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin 0).const_mul (x 1))
+  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s => x 0 * Real.sin s + x 1 * Real.cos s)
+      (x 0 * Real.cos 0 + x 1 * -Real.sin 0) 0 :=
+    ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin 0).const_mul (x 0)).add ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos 0).const_mul (x 1))
+  have h : HasDerivAt (prop71_rotPath x)
+      ((x 0 * -Real.sin 0 - x 1 * Real.cos 0) • (e 0 : R2)
+        + (x 0 * Real.cos 0 + x 1 * -Real.sin 0) • (e 1 : R2)) 0 :=
+    (h0.smul_const (e 0 : R2)).add (h1.smul_const (e 1 : R2))

+  simp only [Real.sin_zero, Real.cos_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero, mul_one, zero_sub, add_zero, Mat2.perp]

+  have hconst : ∀ s, χ (prop71_rotPath x s) = χ x := fun s => hrad _ _ (prop71_norm_rotPath x s)
+  have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun s => χ (prop71_rotPath x s)) (fderiv ℝ χ x (Mat2.perp x)) 0 := by

+    have hx : prop71_rotPath x 0 = x := prop71_rotPath_zero x
+    rw [← hx] at hχ

+        + (1 - P.eta t) * (thetaIn P.A0 P.chi0 y - baseTheta0Sharp P y) from rfl,
+      prop71_advect_add (prop71_baseTheta0_differentiableAt hA S t x) (hg.const_mul _), prop71_advect_const_mul hg]
+  have hkill : (1 - P.eta t)
+      * advect (baseU P S t) (fun y => thetaIn P.A0 P.chi0 y - baseTheta0Sharp P y) x = 0 := by
+    by_cases h1 : 1 ≤ t

+    · rw [advect, prop71_baseU_eq_zero_of_lt_one hA hB ht (not_le.1 h1) x]

+  have hcor := prop71_corotation_base hA hB ht x
+  rw [Planar.Rtheta, prop71_pdt_baseTheta hA hB ht x, show perpGrad (basePsi P S t) = baseU P S t

+  linarith

+  have hN : P.N0 ≠ 0 := (prop71_N0_pos hA).ne'
+  have hcN : -(P.A0 / P.N0) * P.N0 = -P.A0 := by field_simp
+  have hχ0 : P.chi0 0 = 1 := hA.chi0_cutoff.2.2.2 0 (by simp)

+      ((-P.A0) • (innerSL ℝ (S.ehat 0 t) : R2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) 0 := by

+    rw [prop71_thetaIn_eq_thetaZeroOf, ← hcN]

+  have h := h0.add ((hIn.sub hSh).const_mul (1 - P.eta t))

+    0 ≤ P.eta t ∧ P.eta t ≤ 1 := by

+    · rw [hA.eta_zero t h]
+    · rw [← hA.eta_zero 0 le_rfl]
+      exact hA.eta_mono h.le
+  · rcases le_or_gt 1 t with h | h

+theorem prop71_abs_thetaZeroOf_le {F : ℝ → ℝ} {χ : R2 → ℝ} {CF Cχ : ℝ} (hF : ∀ s, |F s| ≤ CF)
+    (hχ : ∀ y, |χ y| ≤ Cχ) (c N : ℝ) (eh x : R2) : |prop71_thetaZeroOf c N F χ eh x| ≤ |c| * CF * Cχ := by
+  rw [prop71_thetaZeroOf, abs_mul, abs_mul]
+  have h1 := hF (N * inner ℝ eh x)
+  have h2 := hχ x
+  have : 0 ≤ CF := (abs_nonneg _).trans h1
+  gcongr

+theorem prop71_abs_baseTheta_le {P : DesignParams} (hA : P.Admissible) (S : SkeletonReadout) {CF Cχ : ℝ}
+    (hχ : ∀ y, |P.chi0 y| ≤ Cχ) (hF : ∀ s, |P.F s| ≤ CF) (t : ℝ) (x : R2) :
+    |baseTheta P S t x| ≤ P.A0 / P.N0 * Cχ * (2 * CF + 1) := by
+  have hc : |(-(P.A0 / P.N0))| = P.A0 / P.N0 := by
+    rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg]
+    exact div_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one hA.one_le_A0) (prop71_N0_pos hA).le
+  have h0 : |baseTheta0 P S t x| ≤ P.A0 / P.N0 * CF * Cχ := by
+    rw [prop71_baseTheta0_eq]
+    exact (prop71_abs_thetaZeroOf_le hF hχ _ _ _ _).trans_eq (by rw [hc])
+  have h1 : |baseTheta0Sharp P x| ≤ P.A0 / P.N0 * CF * Cχ := by
+    rw [prop71_baseTheta0Sharp_eq]
+    exact (prop71_abs_thetaZeroOf_le hF hχ _ _ _ _).trans_eq (by rw [hc])
+  have h2 : |thetaIn P.A0 P.chi0 x| ≤ P.A0 / P.N0 * 1 * Cχ := by
+    rw [prop71_thetaIn_eq_thetaZeroOf]
+    exact (prop71_abs_thetaZeroOf_le (fun s => Real.abs_sin_le_one s) hχ _ _ _ _).trans_eq (by rw [hc])
+  have hη := prop71_eta_mem_unitInterval hA t
+  have h3 : |1 - P.eta t| ≤ 1 := by
+    rw [abs_le]
+    constructor <;> linarith [hη.1, hη.2]
+  have hCχ : 0 ≤ Cχ := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hχ 0)
+  have hCF : 0 ≤ CF := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hF 0)
+  have hAN : 0 ≤ P.A0 / P.N0 := div_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one hA.one_le_A0) (prop71_N0_pos hA).le
+  calc |baseTheta P S t x|
+      ≤ |baseTheta0 P S t x| + |1 - P.eta t| * (|thetaIn P.A0 P.chi0 x| + |baseTheta0Sharp P x|) := by
+        rw [baseTheta]
+        refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
+        rw [abs_mul]
+        have h4 := abs_sub (thetaIn P.A0 P.chi0 x) (baseTheta0Sharp P x)
+        have h5 := abs_nonneg (1 - P.eta t)
+        nlinarith
+    _ ≤ P.A0 / P.N0 * CF * Cχ + 1 * (P.A0 / P.N0 * 1 * Cχ + P.A0 / P.N0 * CF * Cχ) := by
+        gcongr
+    _ = P.A0 / P.N0 * Cχ * (2 * CF + 1) := by ring
+

+theorem prop71_advect_perpGrad_of_radial {H G : R2 → ℝ} (hH : IsRadial H) (hG : IsRadial G) {x : R2}
+    (hHd : DifferentiableAt ℝ H x) (hGd : DifferentiableAt ℝ G x)
+    (h0 : x = 0 → pd 0 H x = 0 ∧ pd 1 H x = 0) : advect (perpGrad H) G x = 0 := by
+  have a := prop71_radial_tangential_deriv hH hHd
+  have b := prop71_radial_tangential_deriv hG hGd
+  simp only [advect, perpGrad, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Mat2.e_apply]
+  simp
+  by_cases hx : x = 0
+  · obtain ⟨h0', h1'⟩ := h0 hx
+    rw [h0', h1']
+    ring
+  · have hx' : x 0 ≠ 0 ∨ x 1 ≠ 0 := by
+      by_contra hc
+      simp only [not_or, not_not] at hc
+      exact hx (Mat2.ext_coord (by simpa using hc.1) (by simpa using hc.2))
+    have e0 : x 0 * (-(pd 1 H x * pd 0 G x) + pd 0 H x * pd 1 G x) = 0 := by linear_combination (pd 0 H x) * b - (pd 0 G x) * a
+    have e1 : x 1 * (-(pd 1 H x * pd 0 G x) + pd 0 H x * pd 1 G x) = 0 := by linear_combination (pd 1 H x) * b - (pd 1 G x) * a
+    rcases hx' with h | h
+    · exact (mul_eq_zero.1 e0).resolve_left h
+    · exact (mul_eq_zero.1 e1).resolve_left h

+theorem prop71_forceOmegaBase_eq {P : DesignParams} (hA : P.Admissible) {S : SkeletonReadout} (hB : prop71_BaseCore S)
+    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ico 0 S.Tstar) :
+    ∃ a : ℝ, HasDerivWithinAt S.psidot a (Ico 0 S.Tstar) t ∧
+      ∀ x : R2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (baseTheta P S t) x ∧
+        Planar.Romega (baseTheta P S) (basePsi P S) t x = a * Δ P.H x - pd 0 (baseTheta P S t) x := by

+theorem prop_7_1_a_iterPartial_param_contDiff {Φ : ℝ → R2 → ℝ}
+    (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × R2 => Φ p.1 p.2)) :
+    ∀ w : List (Fin 2), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × R2 => iterPartial w (Φ p.1) p.2)
+  | [] => hΦ
+  | (i :: w) => by
+    have ih := prop_7_1_a_iterPartial_param_contDiff hΦ w
+    have hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞
+        (Function.uncurry fun (p : ℝ × R2) (y : R2) => iterPartial w (Φ p.1) y) :=
+      ih.comp ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_fst).prodMk contDiff_snd)
+    exact (ContDiff.fderiv (m := ∞) (n := ∞) hu contDiff_snd le_rfl).clm_apply contDiff_const

+theorem prop_7_1_a_iteratedDeriv_param_contDiff {h : ℝ → R2 → ℝ}
+    (hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × R2 => h p.1 p.2)) :
+    ∀ i : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × R2 => iteratedDeriv i (fun φ => h φ p.2) p.1)
+  | 0 => by simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hh
+  | (i + 1) => by
+    have ih := prop_7_1_a_iteratedDeriv_param_contDiff hh i
+    have hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞
+        (Function.uncurry fun (p : ℝ × R2) (φ : ℝ) => iteratedDeriv i (fun φ' => h φ' p.2) φ) :=
+      ih.comp (contDiff_snd.prodMk (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_fst))
+    have hd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × R2 =>
+        fderiv ℝ (fun φ => iteratedDeriv i (fun φ' => h φ' p.2) φ) p.1 (1 : ℝ)) :=
+      (ContDiff.fderiv (m := ∞) (n := ∞) hu contDiff_fst le_rfl).clm_apply contDiff_const
+    have e : (fun p : ℝ × R2 => iteratedDeriv (i + 1) (fun φ => h φ p.2) p.1)
+        = fun p : ℝ × R2 => fderiv ℝ (fun φ => iteratedDeriv i (fun φ' => h φ' p.2) φ) p.1 1 := by
+      funext p
+      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
+      rfl
+    rw [e]
+    exact hd

+theorem prop_7_1_a_param_deriv_bound {Φ : ℝ → R2 → ℝ}
+    (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × R2 => Φ p.1 p.2)) {R : ℝ}
+    (hR : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : R2), R < ‖y‖ → Φ φ y = 0) (M₀ : ℝ) (w : List (Fin 2)) (i : ℕ) :
+    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ φ : ℝ, |φ| ≤ M₀ → ∀ x : R2,
+      ‖iteratedDeriv i (fun φ' => iterPartial w (Φ φ') x) φ‖ ≤ C := by
+  have hc : Continuous
+      (fun p : ℝ × R2 => iteratedDeriv i (fun φ' => iterPartial w (Φ φ') p.2) p.1) :=
+    (prop_7_1_a_iteratedDeriv_param_contDiff (prop_7_1_a_iterPartial_param_contDiff hΦ w) i).continuous
+  have hK : IsCompact (Icc (-M₀) M₀ ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) R) :=
+    isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
+  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc.continuousOn
+  refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun φ hφ x => ?_⟩
+  by_cases hx : ‖x‖ ≤ R
+  · have hmem : (φ, x) ∈ Icc (-M₀) M₀ ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) R :=
+      ⟨abs_le.1 hφ, by rwa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]⟩
+    exact (hC (φ, x) hmem).trans (le_max_left _ _)
+  · have hzero : (fun φ' => iterPartial w (Φ φ') x) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
+      funext fun φ' => iterPartial_vanish_gt (hR φ') w x (not_le.1 hx)
+    rw [hzero]
+    have h0 : iteratedDeriv i (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) φ = 0 := by
+      rw [iteratedDeriv_const]
+      split_ifs <;> rfl
+    rw [h0, norm_zero]
+    exact le_max_right _ _

+theorem prop_7_1_a_Ici_eventuallyEq_Ico {T t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ico 0 T) :
+    (Ici (0 : ℝ) : Set ℝ) =ᶠ[𝓝 t] Ico 0 T := by
+  filter_upwards [isOpen_Iio.mem_nhds ht.2] with τ hτ

+theorem prop_7_1_a_comp_bound {T : ℝ} {Φ : ℝ → R2 → ℝ}
+    (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × R2 => Φ p.1 p.2)) {R : ℝ}
+    (hR : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : R2), R < ‖y‖ → Φ φ y = 0)
+    {ψ : ℝ → ℝ} (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ (Ico 0 T))
+    (hψb : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ‖iteratedDerivWithin n ψ (Ico 0 T) t‖ ≤ M)
+    (a : ℕ) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
+    ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x : R2, ‖mixedPartial a w (fun τ y => Φ (ψ τ) y) t x‖ ≤ B := by
+  choose M hM using hψb
+  have hM0 : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, |ψ t| ≤ M 0 := fun t ht => by
+    simpa only [iteratedDerivWithin_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hM 0 t ht
+  choose C hC0 hC using fun i : ℕ => prop_7_1_a_param_deriv_bound hΦ hR (M 0) w i
+  set Csum : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), C i with hCsum
+  set D : ℝ := max 1 (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), |M i|) with hD
+  have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := le_max_left _ _
+  refine ⟨(a.factorial : ℝ) * Csum * D ^ a, fun t ht x => ?_⟩
+  have e1 : mixedPartial a w (fun τ y => Φ (ψ τ) y) t x
+      = iteratedDerivWithin a ((fun φ => iterPartial w (Φ φ) x) ∘ ψ) (Ico 0 T) t := by
+    unfold mixedPartial
+    rw [mixedBridge_iterate_pdt]
+    unfold iteratedDerivWithin
+    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_congr_set (prop_7_1_a_Ici_eventuallyEq_Ico ht)]
+    rfl
+  rw [e1, ← norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin]
+  have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun φ => iterPartial w (Φ φ) x) univ :=
+    ((prop_7_1_a_iterPartial_param_contDiff hΦ w).comp (contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const)).contDiffOn
+  have hCb : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ a →
+      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun φ => iterPartial w (Φ φ) x) univ (ψ t)‖ ≤ Csum := by
+    intro i hi
+    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
+    refine (hC i (ψ t) (hM0 t ht) x).trans ?_
+    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => C j) (fun j _ => hC0 j)
+      (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
+  have hDb : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ a → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ψ (Ico 0 T) t‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
+    intro i hi1 hia
+    rw [norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin]
+    calc ‖iteratedDerivWithin i ψ (Ico 0 T) t‖ ≤ M i := hM i t ht
+      _ ≤ |M i| := le_abs_self _
+      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), |M j| :=
+          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |M j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
+            (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hia))
+      _ ≤ D := le_max_right _ _
+      _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
+  exact norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hψ (by exact_mod_cast le_top) uniqueDiffOn_univ
+    (uniqueDiffOn_Ico 0 T) (mapsTo_univ _ _) ht hCb hDb

+theorem prop_7_3_psidot_eq_zero {T : ℝ} {ψ ψd : ℝ → ℝ}
+    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt ψ (ψd t) (Ico 0 T) t)
+    (h0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ψ t = 0) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ico 0 T) (ht1 : t < 1) : ψd t = 0 := by
+  have huniq : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ (Ico 0 T) t := uniqueDiffOn_Ico 0 T t ht
+  have hev : ψ =ᶠ[𝓝[Ico 0 T] t] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
+    have hmem : Ico 0 T ∩ Iio (1 : ℝ) ∈ 𝓝[Ico 0 T] t :=
+      inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ (Iio_mem_nhds ht1)
+    filter_upwards [hmem] with s hs
+    exact h0 s ⟨hs.1.1, le_of_lt hs.2⟩
+  have h1 : HasDerivWithinAt (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) (ψd t) (Ico 0 T) t :=
+    (hd t ht).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev.symm (h0 t ⟨ht.1, ht1.le⟩).symm
+  have h2 : HasDerivWithinAt (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) 0 (Ico 0 T) t := hasDerivWithinAt_const _ _ _
+  exact huniq.eq_deriv _ h1 h2

+    (h0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ψ t = 0) {a : ℝ} (ha : HasDerivWithinAt ψd a (Ico 0 T) 0) :
+    a = 0 := by

+  have huniq : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ (Ico 0 T) 0 := uniqueDiffOn_Ico 0 T 0 h00
+  have hev : ψd =ᶠ[𝓝[Ico 0 T] 0] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
+    have hmem : Ico 0 T ∩ Iio (1 : ℝ) ∈ 𝓝[Ico 0 T] 0 :=
+      inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ (Iio_mem_nhds one_pos)
+    filter_upwards [hmem] with s hs
+    exact prop_7_3_psidot_eq_zero hd h0 hs.1 hs.2
+  have h1 : HasDerivWithinAt (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) a (Ico 0 T) 0 :=
+    ha.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev.symm (prop_7_3_psidot_eq_zero hd h0 h00 one_pos).symm

+theorem thm_7_2_b_N_ge {P : DesignParams} (hP : P.Admissible) {N1 : ℝ} (hN1 : 1 ≤ N1) :
+    ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → N1 ≤ N P N1 m ∧ 1 ≤ N P N1 m := by
+  intro m hm
+  induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
+  | base => simp [N, hN1]
+  | succ n hn ih =>
+      obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih
+      match n, hn with
+      | (n' + 1), _ =>
+        have hQ : 2 ≤ Q P (n' + 2) := thm_7_2_b_two_le_Q P hP _
+        have hpow : N P N1 (n' + 1) ≤ N P N1 (n' + 1) ^ Q P (n' + 2) := by
+          calc N P N1 (n' + 1) = N P N1 (n' + 1) ^ 1 := (pow_one _).symm
+            _ ≤ _ := pow_le_pow_right₀ ih2 (by omega)
+        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
+        · show N1 ≤ N P N1 (n' + 1) ^ Q P (n' + 2)
+          exact le_trans ih1 hpow
+        · show 1 ≤ N P N1 (n' + 1) ^ Q P (n' + 2)
+          exact le_trans ih2 hpow

+theorem thm_7_2_b_N_succ_ge_sq {P : DesignParams} (hP : P.Admissible) {N1 : ℝ} (hN1 : 1 ≤ N1)

+    N P N1 m ^ 2 ≤ N P N1 (m + 1) := by
+  match m, hm with
+  | (n + 1), _ =>
+    show N P N1 (n + 1) ^ 2 ≤ N P N1 (n + 1) ^ Q P (n + 2)
+    exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (thm_7_2_b_N_ge hP hN1 (n + 1) (by omega)).2 (thm_7_2_b_two_le_Q P hP _)
+
+theorem thm_7_2_b_N_rpow_le {P : DesignParams} (hP : P.Admissible) {N1 : ℝ} (hN1 : 1 ≤ N1) :
+    ∀ m, 1 ≤ m →
+      N P N1 m ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ (N1 ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ^ m := by
+  intro m hm
+  induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
+  | base => simp [N]
+  | succ n hn ih =>
+      have hNn := (thm_7_2_b_N_ge hP hN1 n hn)
+      have hNn1 := (thm_7_2_b_N_ge hP hN1 (n + 1) (by omega))
+      have hsq := thm_7_2_b_N_succ_ge_sq hP hN1 hn
+
+      have h1 : N P N1 (n + 1) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ (N P N1 n ^ 2) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
+        apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (pow_pos (by linarith [hNn.2]) 2) hsq (by norm_num)
+      have h2 : (N P N1 n ^ 2) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) =
+          N P N1 n ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * N P N1 n ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
+        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith [hNn.2]), ← Real.rpow_add (by linarith [hNn.2])]
+        norm_num
+      have h3 : N P N1 n ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ N1 ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
+        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by linarith) hNn.1 (by norm_num)
+      calc N P N1 (n + 1) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
+          ≤ N P N1 n ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * N P N1 n ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
+            rw [← h2]; exact h1
+        _ ≤ (N1 ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ^ n * N1 ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
+            apply mul_le_mul ih h3 (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith [hNn.2]) _)
+              (pow_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _) _)
+        _ = (N1 ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ^ (n + 1) := by ring

+theorem thm_7_2_b_summable_N_rpow {P : DesignParams} (hP : P.Admissible) {N1 : ℝ} (hN1 : 1 < N1) :

+    · simp only [hm, if_false]; positivity

+      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => G j z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 τ ×ˢ univ) :=
+    fun j hj => (hG j (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hj).1).mono hsub
+  have hsum : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (M + 1), G j z.1 z.2)
+      (Ico 0 τ ×ˢ univ) := ContDiffOn.sum fun j hj => hGs j hj
+  have hmp : mixedPartial a w F t x
+      = mixedPartial a w Fb t x + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (M + 1), mixedPartial a w (G j) t x := by
+    rw [Slab.mixedPartial_congr_on hS' hloc a w t ht',
+      Slab.mixedPartial_add hS' (hb.mono hsub) hsum a w t ht',
+      thm_7_2_b_mixedPartial_finsum hS' a w _ hGs t ht' x]
+
+  have h1 : (‖mixedPartial a w Fb t x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ cnormST (Ico 0 T) k Fb :=
+    Slab.nnnorm_mixedPartial_le_cnormST Fb haw ht x
+  have h2 : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (M + 1), (‖mixedPartial a w (G j) t x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)
+      ≤ (if 1 ≤ j then cnormST (Ico 0 T) k (G j) else 0) := by
+    intro j hj
+    rw [if_pos (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hj).1]
+    exact Slab.nnnorm_mixedPartial_le_cnormST (G j) haw ht x
+  calc (‖mixedPartial a w F t x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)
+      = (‖mixedPartial a w Fb t x + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (M + 1), mixedPartial a w (G j) t x‖₊ :
+          ℝ≥0∞) := by rw [hmp]
+    _ ≤ (‖mixedPartial a w Fb t x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)
+          + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (M + 1), (‖mixedPartial a w (G j) t x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) := by
+        refine le_trans (ENNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr (nnnorm_add_le _ _)) ?_
+        rw [ENNReal.coe_add]
+        refine add_le_add le_rfl ?_
+        refine le_trans (ENNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr (nnnorm_sum_le _ _)) ?_
+        rw [ENNReal.ofNNReal_finsetSum]
+    _ ≤ cnormST (Ico 0 T) k Fb
+          + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (M + 1), (if 1 ≤ j then cnormST (Ico 0 T) k (G j) else 0) :=
+        add_le_add h1 (Finset.sum_le_sum h2)
+    _ ≤ cnormST (Ico 0 T) k Fb + ∑' m : ℕ, (if 1 ≤ m then cnormST (Ico 0 T) k (G m) else 0) :=
+        add_le_add le_rfl (ENNReal.sum_le_tsum _)
+
+theorem thm_7_2_b_headTail_cnormST {T : ℝ} {F Fb : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {G : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ}
+    (htel : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x : R2, F t x = Fb t x + thm_7_2_b_lsum G t x)
+    (hfin : ∀ τ : ℝ, τ < T → ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, M < m → ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 τ, ∀ x : R2, G m t x = 0)
+    (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => Fb z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    (hG : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => G m z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    {kseq : ℕ → ℕ} (k' : ℕ) {tail : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞}
+    (hsmall : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → k' ≤ kseq m → cnormST (Ico 0 T) k' (G m) ≤ tail m) :
+    cnormST (Ico 0 T) k' F ≤
+      cnormST (Ico 0 T) k' Fb +
+        (∑' m : ℕ, if 1 ≤ m ∧ kseq m < k' then cnormST (Ico 0 T) k' (G m) else 0) +
+        ∑' m : ℕ, if 1 ≤ m then tail m else 0 := by
+  refine le_trans (thm_7_2_b_cnormST_total_le htel hfin hb hG k') ?_
+  rw [add_assoc]
+  exact add_le_add le_rfl (thm_7_2_b_split_tsum k' hsmall)
+
+theorem thm_7_2_b_cnormST_curl_le {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsTimeSlab S) {E : ℝ → R2 → ℝ}
+    {F : ℝ → R2 → R2}
+    (hF : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => (F z.1 z.2) i) (S ×ˢ univ))
+    (hcurl : ∀ t ∈ S, ∀ x : R2, E t x = curl2 (F t) x) (k : ℕ) :
+    cnormST S k E ≤ cnormST S (k + 1) (fun t x => (F t x) 1) + cnormST S (k + 1) (fun t x => (F t x) 0) := by
+  have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => pd 0 (fun y => (F z.1 y) 1) z.2) (S ×ˢ univ) :=
+    Slab.pd_slice_contDiffOn hS (g := fun t y => (F t y) 1) (hF 1) 0
+  have h0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => pd 1 (fun y => (F z.1 y) 0) z.2) (S ×ˢ univ) :=
+    Slab.pd_slice_contDiffOn hS (g := fun t y => (F t y) 0) (hF 0) 1
+  have hE : ∀ t ∈ S, ∀ x : R2,
+      E t x = pd 0 (fun y => (F t y) 1) x - pd 1 (fun y => (F t y) 0) x := fun t ht x => by
+    rw [hcurl t ht x]; rfl
+  rw [Slab.cnormST_congr hS hE k]
+  refine le_trans (Slab.cnormST_sub_le hS k h1 h0) (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
+  · exact Slab.cnormST_pd_le S k (fun t y => (F t y) 1) 0
+  · exact Slab.cnormST_pd_le S k (fun t y => (F t y) 0) 1
+
+theorem thm_7_2_b_curl_tail_le {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsTimeSlab S) {E : ℝ → R2 → ℝ}
+    {F : ℝ → R2 → R2}
+    (hF : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => (F z.1 z.2) i) (S ×ˢ univ))
+    (hcurl : ∀ t ∈ S, ∀ x : R2, E t x = curl2 (F t) x) (k : ℕ) {b : ℝ≥0∞}
+    (hb : ∀ i : Fin 2, cnormST S (k + 1) (fun t x => (F t x) i) ≤ b) :
+    cnormST S k E ≤ 2 * b := by
+  rw [two_mul]
+  exact le_trans (thm_7_2_b_cnormST_curl_le hS hF hcurl k) (add_le_add (hb 1) (hb 0))
+
+theorem thm_7_2_c_extend (h34 : lem_3_4) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {F : ℝ × R2 → ℝ}
+    (hF : SmoothForce T F) :
+    ∃ Fbar : ℝ × R2 → ℝ,
+      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fbar (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ) ∧
+      (∀ z ∈ Ico 0 T ×ˢ (univ : Set R2), Fbar z = F z) ∧
+      (∀ (k : ℕ) (M : ℝ), (∀ z ∈ Ico 0 T ×ˢ (univ : Set R2),
+          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k F (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) z‖ ≤ M) →
+        ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 T ×ˢ (univ : Set R2),
+          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k Fbar (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ) z‖ ≤ M) ∧
+      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 T ×ˢ (univ : Set R2),
+        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k Fbar (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ) z‖ ≤ M) ∧
+      (∃ Rb : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x : R2, Rb < ‖x‖ → Fbar (t, x) = 0) ∧
+      ((∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x : R2, F (t, -x) = -F (t, x)) →
+        ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x : R2, Fbar (t, -x) = -Fbar (t, x)) ∧
+      ((∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x : R2, F (t, -x) = F (t, x)) →
+        ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x : R2, Fbar (t, -x) = Fbar (t, x)) := by
+  obtain ⟨⟨Fbar, hsmooth, heq, hbd, hodd, heven, hsupp⟩, -⟩ :=
+    h34 T F hT hF.smooth hF.bounded
+  obtain ⟨Rb, hRb⟩ := hF.support
+
+  have hsplit : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, t ∈ Ico 0 T ∨ t = T := fun t ht =>
+    (lt_or_eq_of_le ht.2).imp (fun h => ⟨ht.1, h⟩) id
+  refine ⟨Fbar, hsmooth, heq, hbd, fun k => ?_, ⟨Rb, fun t ht x hx => ?_⟩, fun hO t ht x => ?_,
+    fun hE t ht x => ?_⟩
+  · obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hF.bounded k
+    exact ⟨M, hbd k M hM⟩
+  · rcases hsplit t ht with h | rfl
+    · rw [heq (t, x) ⟨h, mem_univ _⟩]
+      exact hRb t h x hx
+    · have hclosed : IsClosed (Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) Rb) := Metric.isClosed_closedBall
+      refine hsupp (Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) Rb) hclosed (fun s hs y hy => hRb s hs y ?_) x ?_
+      · rwa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hy
+      · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le]
+        exact hx
+  · rcases hsplit t ht with h | rfl
+    · rw [heq (t, -x) ⟨h, mem_univ _⟩, heq (t, x) ⟨h, mem_univ _⟩]
+      exact hO t h x
+    · exact hodd hO x
+  · rcases hsplit t ht with h | rfl
+    · rw [heq (t, -x) ⟨h, mem_univ _⟩, heq (t, x) ⟨h, mem_univ _⟩]
+      exact hE t h x
+    · exact heven hE x
+
+theorem thm_7_2_c_pd_section {S : Set ℝ} {g : ℝ × R2 → ℝ}
+    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (S ×ˢ univ)) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ S) (x : R2) (j : Fin 2) :
+    pd j (fun y => g (t, y)) x = fderivWithin ℝ g (S ×ˢ univ) (t, x) ((0 : ℝ), e j) := by
+  have hd : HasFDerivWithinAt g (fderivWithin ℝ g (S ×ˢ univ) (t, x)) (S ×ˢ univ) (t, x) :=
+    (hg.differentiableOn (by simp) (t, x) ⟨ht, mem_univ _⟩).hasFDerivWithinAt
+  have h2 : HasFDerivWithinAt (fun y : R2 => ((t, y) : ℝ × R2)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ R2)
+      univ x := (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right t x).hasFDerivWithinAt
+  have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => g (t, y))
+      ((fderivWithin ℝ g (S ×ˢ univ) (t, x)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ R2)) x :=
+    (hd.comp x h2 (fun y _ => ⟨ht, mem_univ _⟩)).hasFDerivAt_of_univ
+  rw [pd, h3.fderiv]
+  simp
+
+theorem thm_7_2_c_pd_section_continuousOn {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {g : ℝ × R2 → ℝ}
+    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ)) (j : Fin 2) :
+    ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × R2 => pd j (fun y => g (z.1, y)) z.2) (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ) := by
+  have hU : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (Icc (0 : ℝ) T ×ˢ (univ : Set R2)) :=
+    (uniqueDiffOn_Icc hT).prod uniqueDiffOn_univ
+  have hD : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × R2 => fderivWithin ℝ g (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ) z ((0 : ℝ), e j))
+      (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ) :=
+    ((hg.fderivWithin hU (m := ∞) le_rfl).continuousOn).clm_apply continuousOn_const
+  refine hD.congr (fun z hz => ?_)
+  exact thm_7_2_c_pd_section hg hz.1 z.2 j
+
+theorem thm_7_2_c_section_continuous {T : ℝ} {g : ℝ × R2 → ℝ}
+    (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ)) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
+    Continuous (fun y : R2 => g (t, y)) := by
+  have h : Continuous (fun y : R2 => ((t, y) : ℝ × R2)) := by fun_prop
+  exact hg.comp_continuous h (fun y => ⟨ht, mem_univ _⟩)
+
+theorem thm_7_2_c_integral_endpoint {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {g : ℝ × R2 → ℝ}
+    (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ)) {R : ℝ}
+    (hsupp : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x : R2, R < ‖x‖ → g (t, x) = 0)
+    (hzero : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∫ x, g (t, x) = 0) :
+    ∫ x, g (T, x) = 0 := by
+
+  have hcont : Continuous (Function.uncurry (fun (s : Icc (0 : ℝ) T) (y : R2) => g (s.1, y))) := by
+    have h1 : Continuous (fun p : Icc (0 : ℝ) T × R2 => ((p.1 : ℝ), p.2)) := by fun_prop
+    exact hg.comp_continuous h1 (fun p => ⟨p.1.2, mem_univ _⟩)
+  have hpar : Continuous (fun s : Icc (0 : ℝ) T =>
+      ∫ y in Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) R, g (s.1, y)) :=
+    continuous_parametric_integral_of_continuous hcont (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
+
+  have hball : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∫ y in Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) R, g (t, y) = ∫ y, g (t, y) := by
+    intro t ht
+    apply setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
+    intro y hy
+    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hy
+    exact hsupp t ht y hy
+
+  have hclosed : IsClosed {s : Icc (0 : ℝ) T | ∫ y in Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) R, g (s.1, y) = 0} :=
+    isClosed_eq hpar continuous_const
+  have hTmem : (⟨T, ⟨hT.le, le_rfl⟩⟩ : Icc (0 : ℝ) T) ∈
+      closure {s : Icc (0 : ℝ) T | (s : ℝ) < T} := by
+    rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
+    intro ε hε
+    obtain ⟨d, hd0, hdε, hdT⟩ : ∃ d : ℝ, 0 < d ∧ d < ε ∧ d < T :=
+      ⟨min (ε / 2) (T / 2), by positivity, by
+        have := min_le_left (ε / 2) (T / 2); linarith, by
+        have := min_le_right (ε / 2) (T / 2); linarith⟩
+    refine ⟨⟨T - d, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩, by show T - d < T; linarith, ?_⟩
+    show dist T (T - d) < ε
+    rw [Real.dist_eq, show T - (T - d) = d by ring, abs_of_pos hd0]
+    exact hdε
+  have hsub : {s : Icc (0 : ℝ) T | (s : ℝ) < T} ⊆
+      {s : Icc (0 : ℝ) T | ∫ y in Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) R, g (s.1, y) = 0} := by
+    intro s hs
+    show ∫ y in Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) R, g (s.1, y) = 0
+    rw [hball s.1 s.2]
+    exact hzero s.1 ⟨s.2.1, hs⟩
+  have hmem := (closure_minimal hsub hclosed) hTmem
+  have hTmem' : (T : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 T := ⟨hT.le, le_rfl⟩
+  rw [← hball T hTmem']
+  exact hmem
+
+theorem thm_7_2_c_tsupport_subset {E' : Type*} [Zero E'] [TopologicalSpace E'] {f : R2 → E'} {R : ℝ}
+    (h : ∀ x : R2, R < ‖x‖ → f x = 0) : tsupport f ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) R := by
+  apply closure_minimal _ Metric.isClosed_closedBall
+  intro x hx
+  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
+  by_contra hlt
+  exact hx (h x (lt_of_not_ge hlt))

+theorem thm_7_2_c_closed_slab (h34 : lem_3_4) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
+    {fθ E : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {fu : ℝ → R2 → R2} {R : ℝ}
+    (hfθ : SmoothForce T (fun z : ℝ × R2 => fθ z.1 z.2))
+    (hfu : ∀ i : Fin 2, SmoothForce T (fun z : ℝ × R2 => (fu z.1 z.2) i))
+    (hE : SmoothForce T (fun z : ℝ × R2 => E z.1 z.2))
+    (hoddθ : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x : R2, fθ t (-x) = -fθ t x)
+    (hoddu : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x : R2, fu t (-x) = -fu t x)
+    (hevE : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x : R2, E t (-x) = E t x)
+    (hsθ : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x : R2, R < ‖x‖ → fθ t x = 0)
+    (hsu : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x : R2, R < ‖x‖ → fu t x = 0)
+    (hsE : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x : R2, R < ‖x‖ → E t x = 0)
+    (hcurl : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x : R2, curl2 (fu t) x = E t x)
+    (hmean : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∫ x, E t x = 0) :
+    ∃ gth : ℝ → R2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => gth z.1 z.2) (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ) ∧
+      ∃ gu : ℝ → R2 → R2,
+        (∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => (gu z.1 z.2) i) (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ)) ∧
+      ∃ gE : ℝ → R2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => gE z.1 z.2) (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ) ∧
+      (∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, gth t = fθ t ∧ gu t = fu t ∧ gE t = E t) ∧
+      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
+        (∀ x : R2, gth t (-x) = -gth t x ∧ gu t (-x) = -gu t x ∧ gE t (-x) = gE t x) ∧
+        tsupport (gth t) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) R ∧
+        tsupport (gu t) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) R ∧
+        (∀ x : R2, curl2 (gu t) x = gE t x) ∧
+        Integrable (gE t) ∧ ∫ x, gE t x = 0) := by
+
+  have hsupp_of : ∀ {F : ℝ × R2 → ℝ}, (∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x : R2, R < ‖x‖ → F (t, x) = 0) →
+      SmoothForce T F → SmoothForce T F := fun _ h => h
+
+  obtain ⟨⟨Gθ, hGθs, hGθeq, -, hGθodd, -, hGθsupp⟩, -⟩ := h34 T _ hT hfθ.smooth hfθ.bounded
+  obtain ⟨⟨G0, hG0s, hG0eq, -, hG0odd, -, hG0supp⟩, -⟩ := h34 T _ hT (hfu 0).smooth (hfu 0).bounded
+  obtain ⟨⟨G1, hG1s, hG1eq, -, hG1odd, -, hG1supp⟩, -⟩ := h34 T _ hT (hfu 1).smooth (hfu 1).bounded
+  obtain ⟨⟨GE, hGEs, hGEeq, -, -, hGEeven, hGEsupp⟩, hGEuniq⟩ := h34 T _ hT hE.smooth hE.bounded
+
+  have hclosed : IsClosed (Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) R) := Metric.isClosed_closedBall
+  have hout : ∀ x : R2, x ∉ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) R ↔ R < ‖x‖ := fun x => by
+    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le]
+  have hsplit : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, t ∈ Ico 0 T ∨ t = T := fun t ht =>
+    (lt_or_eq_of_le ht.2).imp (fun h => ⟨ht.1, h⟩) id
+
+  refine ⟨fun t x => Gθ (t, x), hGθs, fun t x => (G0 (t, x)) • e 0 + (G1 (t, x)) • e 1, ?_,
+    fun t x => GE (t, x), hGEs, ?_, ?_⟩
+  ·
+    intro i
+    fin_cases i
+    · exact (hG0s.congr (fun z _ => by simp [e])).mono Subset.rfl
+    · exact (hG1s.congr (fun z _ => by simp [e])).mono Subset.rfl
+  ·
+    intro t ht
+    refine ⟨funext fun x => hGθeq (t, x) ⟨ht, mem_univ _⟩, funext fun x => ?_,
+      funext fun x => hGEeq (t, x) ⟨ht, mem_univ _⟩⟩
+    show (G0 (t, x)) • e 0 + (G1 (t, x)) • e 1 = fu t x
+    rw [hG0eq (t, x) ⟨ht, mem_univ _⟩, hG1eq (t, x) ⟨ht, mem_univ _⟩]
+    exact (Mat2.coord_decomp (fu t x)).symm
+  ·
+    have hc0 : ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ y : R2, ((G0 (s, y)) • e 0 + (G1 (s, y)) • e 1 : R2) 0 = G0 (s, y) := by
+      intro s y; simp [e]
+    have hc1 : ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ y : R2, ((G0 (s, y)) • e 0 + (G1 (s, y)) • e 1 : R2) 1 = G1 (s, y) := by
+      intro s y; simp [e]
+    have hu0 : ∀ s ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ y : R2, (fu s (-y)) 0 = -(fu s y) 0 := by
+      intro s hs y; rw [hoddu s hs y]; rfl
+    have hu1 : ∀ s ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ y : R2, (fu s (-y)) 1 = -(fu s y) 1 := by
+      intro s hs y; rw [hoddu s hs y]; rfl
+    have hsu0 : ∀ s ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ y : R2, R < ‖y‖ → (fu s y) 0 = 0 := by
+      intro s hs y hy; rw [hsu s hs y hy]; rfl
+    have hsu1 : ∀ s ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ y : R2, R < ‖y‖ → (fu s y) 1 = 0 := by
+      intro s hs y hy; rw [hsu s hs y hy]; rfl
+

+def thm_7_2_c_Xq (I : Set ℝ) (q : ℕ) (h : ℝ → R2 → ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞ :=

+    (cnorm r (mixedPartial a [] h t) +
+      ENNReal.ofReal (sobolevW1 r (mixedPartial a [] h t)) +
+      ENNReal.ofReal (momentNorm r (mixedPartial a [] h t)))

+def thm_7_2_c_CM (r : ℕ) (R : ℝ) : ℝ :=
+  (Nat.choose (r + 2) 2 : ℝ) * Real.pi * R ^ 2 * (1 + (max 1 R) ^ r)

+theorem thm_7_2_c_CM_nonneg (r : ℕ) (R : ℝ) : 0 ≤ thm_7_2_c_CM r R := by
+  unfold thm_7_2_c_CM

+  positivity

+theorem thm_7_2_c_CM_mono {r q : ℕ} (h : r ≤ q) (R : ℝ) : thm_7_2_c_CM r R ≤ thm_7_2_c_CM q R := by

+  have hc : (Nat.choose (r + 2) 2 : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.choose (q + 2) 2 : ℝ) := by
+    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_mono 2 (by omega)
+  have hp : (max 1 R) ^ r ≤ (max 1 R) ^ q := pow_le_pow_right₀ hm h
+  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (max 1 R) ^ r := pow_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one hm) r
+  have hπ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.pi := Real.pi_pos.le
+  gcongr

+  have hB : ∀ (a : ℕ) (w : List (Fin 2)), a + w.length ≤ q → ∀ t ∈ S, ∀ x : R2,

+theorem thm_7_2_o_locFinite {T : ℝ} {tIn : ℕ → ℝ} (hlim : Tendsto tIn atTop (𝓝 T))
+    {θL ψL : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ}
+    (hθ : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, t ≤ tIn m → ∀ x : R2, θL m t x = 0)
+    (hψ : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, t ≤ tIn m → ∀ x : R2, ψL m t x = 0) :
+    ∀ τ : ℝ, τ < T → ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, M < m → ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 τ, ∀ x : R2,
+      θL m t x = 0 ∧ ψL m t x = 0 := by
+  intro τ hτ
+  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := (hlim.eventually (eventually_gt_nhds hτ)).exists_forall_of_atTop
+  refine ⟨M, fun m hm t ht x => ?_⟩
+  have htm : t ≤ tIn m := ht.2.trans (hM m hm.le).le
+  have htT : t ∈ Ico 0 T := ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt hτ⟩
+  exact ⟨hθ m (by omega) t htT htm x, hψ m (by omega) t htT htm x⟩
+
+theorem thm_7_2_o_total_eq_base {T : ℝ} {gB : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {gL : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ}
+    (hL : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, tsupport (gL m t) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 4))
+    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ico 0 T) {y : R2} (hy : y ∉ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 4)) :
+    asmTotal gB gL t y = gB t y := by
+  unfold asmTotal asmSum
+  have h0 : ∀ j : ℕ, (if 1 ≤ j then gL j t y else 0) = 0 := fun j => by
+    split_ifs with hj
+    · exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hy (hL j hj t ht h))
+    · rfl
+  simp [h0]
+
+theorem thm_7_2_o_tsupport_total {T : ℝ} {gB : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {gL : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {K : Set R2}
+    (hL : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, tsupport (gL m t) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 4))
+    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ico 0 T) (hB : tsupport (gB t) ⊆ K) :
+    tsupport (asmTotal gB gL t) ⊆ K ∪ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 4) := by
+  intro x hx
+  by_cases hxb : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 4)
+  · exact Or.inr hxb
+  · refine Or.inl (hB ?_)
+    have hU : IsOpen (Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 4))ᶜ := Metric.isClosed_closedBall.isOpen_compl
+    rw [tsupport, mem_closure_iff_nhds] at hx ⊢
+    intro V hV
+    obtain ⟨y, hyV, hy⟩ := hx (V ∩ (Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 4))ᶜ) (inter_mem hV (hU.mem_nhds hxb))
+    refine ⟨y, hyV.1, ?_⟩
+    rw [Function.mem_support] at hy ⊢
+    rwa [thm_7_2_o_total_eq_base hL ht hyV.2] at hy
+
+theorem thm_7_2_o_balls {P : DesignParams} (hP : P.Admissible) :
+    Metric.ball (0 : R2) P.R0 ∪ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 4) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : R2) P.RH := by
+  have h1 := asm_R0_add_one_le_RH hP
+  have h2 := hP.two_lt_R0
+  refine union_subset (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)) ?_
+  exact (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) / 4 < P.RH))

+theorem thm_7_2_o_structural (h33a : prop_3_3_a) (h33c : prop_3_3_c) (h33d : prop_3_3_d)
+    {P : DesignParams} (hP : P.Admissible) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {tIn : ℕ → ℝ}
+    (hlim : Tendsto tIn atTop (𝓝 T))
+    {θB ΨB : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {θL ψL : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ}
+    (hθB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => θB z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    (hθBo : OddOn (Ico 0 T) θB)
+    (hθBs : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, tsupport (θB t) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : R2) P.R0)
+    (hΨB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => ΨB z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    (hΨBe : EvenOn (Ico 0 T) ΨB)
+    (hΨBs : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, tsupport (ΨB t) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : R2) P.RH)
+    (hθL : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => θL m z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    (hθLo : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → OddOn (Ico 0 T) (θL m))
+    (hθLs : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, tsupport (θL m t) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 4))
+    (hθLv : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, t ≤ tIn m → ∀ x : R2, θL m t x = 0)
+    (hψL : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => ψL m z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    (hψLe : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → EvenOn (Ico 0 T) (ψL m))
+    (hψLs : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, tsupport (ψL m t) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 4))
+    (hψLv : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, t ≤ tIn m → ∀ x : R2, ψL m t x = 0) :
+    (∀ τ : ℝ, τ < T → ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, M < m → ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 τ, ∀ x : R2,
+      θL m t x = 0 ∧ ψL m t x = 0) ∧
+    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => asmTotal θB θL z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) ∧
+    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => asmTotal ΨB ψL z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) ∧
+    OddOn (Ico 0 T) (asmTotal θB θL) ∧
+    (∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, tsupport (asmTotal θB θL t) ⊆
+      Metric.ball (0 : R2) P.R0 ∪ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 4)) ∧
+    Metric.ball (0 : R2) P.R0 ∪ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 4) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : R2) P.RH ∧
+    EvenOn (Ico 0 T) (asmTotal ΨB ψL) ∧
+    (∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, tsupport (asmTotal ΨB ψL t) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : R2) P.RH) ∧
+    SubstData (Ico 0 T) P.phi0 (asmTotal θB θL) (asmTotal ΨB ψL) P.RH ∧
+    ClassicalBoussinesq 1 T (asmTotal θB θL) (substP P.phi0 (asmTotal θB θL) (asmTotal ΨB ψL))
+      (substU (asmTotal ΨB ψL)) (substFu P.phi0 (asmTotal θB θL) (asmTotal ΨB ψL))
+      (Rtheta (asmTotal θB θL) (asmTotal ΨB ψL)) := by
+  have hR := asm_R0_add_one_le_RH hP
+  have hR0 := hP.two_lt_R0
+  have hfinθ := thm_7_2_o_locFinite_of_entry hlim hθLv
+  have hfinψ := thm_7_2_o_locFinite_of_entry hlim hψLv
+  have hq : (1 : ℝ) / 4 < P.RH := by linarith
+  have hD : SubstData (Ico 0 T) P.phi0 (asmTotal θB θL) (asmTotal ΨB ψL) P.RH :=
+    asmTotal_substData hT (thm_7_2_o_isUnitBump hP) (by linarith) hfinθ hfinψ hθB hΨB hθL hψL hθBo hθLo
+      hΨBe hψLe (fun t ht x hx => asm_vanish_of_tsupport_ball (hθBs t ht) (by linarith) x hx)
+      (fun t ht x hx => asm_vanish_of_tsupport_ball (hΨBs t ht) le_rfl x hx)
+      (fun m hm t ht x hx => asm_vanish_of_tsupport_closedBall (hθLs m hm t ht) hq x hx)
+      (fun m hm t ht x hx => asm_vanish_of_tsupport_closedBall (hψLs m hm t ht) hq x hx)
+  refine ⟨thm_7_2_o_locFinite hlim hθLv hψLv, asmTotal_contDiffOn hfinθ hθB hθL,
+    asmTotal_contDiffOn hfinψ hΨB hψL, asmTotal_oddOn hfinθ hθBo hθLo,
+    fun t ht => thm_7_2_o_tsupport_total hθLs ht (hθBs t ht), thm_7_2_o_balls hP,
+    asmTotal_evenOn hfinψ hΨBe hψLe, fun t ht => ?_, hD, asm_classical_of_substData h33a h33c h33d hD⟩
+  exact (thm_7_2_o_tsupport_total hψLs ht (hΨBs t ht)).trans
+    (union_subset Subset.rfl (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)))
+

+theorem thm_7_2_a_eq_zero_of_vanish_before {g : ℝ → ℝ} {T t₀ : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < t₀) (hT : t₀ < T)
+    (hc : ContinuousWithinAt g (Ico 0 T) t₀) (hv : ∀ τ ∈ Ioo 0 t₀, g τ = 0) : g t₀ = 0 := by
+  have hsub : Ioo 0 t₀ ⊆ Ico 0 T := fun τ hτ => ⟨hτ.1.le, hτ.2.trans hT⟩
+  have hc' : Tendsto g (𝓝[Ioo 0 t₀] t₀) (𝓝 (g t₀)) := hc.tendsto.mono_left (nhdsWithin_mono _ hsub)
+  have hz : Tendsto g (𝓝[Ioo 0 t₀] t₀) (𝓝 0) := by
+    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
+    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with τ hτ
+    exact (hv τ hτ).symm
+  haveI : (𝓝[Ioo 0 t₀] t₀).NeBot := by
+    rw [← mem_closure_iff_nhdsWithin_neBot, closure_Ioo h0.ne]
+    exact ⟨h0.le, le_rfl⟩
+  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hc' hz

+theorem thm_7_2_a_section_eq_zero_at_entry {f : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {T t₀ : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < t₀)
+    (hT : t₀ < T) (hc : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × R2 => f z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    (hv : ∀ τ ∈ Ico 0 t₀, ∀ y : R2, f τ y = 0) (x : R2) : f t₀ x = 0 := by
+  have hcx : ContinuousWithinAt (fun τ => f τ x) (Ico 0 T) t₀ := by
+    have h1 : ContinuousWithinAt (fun z : ℝ × R2 => f z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) (t₀, x) :=
+      hc (t₀, x) ⟨⟨h0.le, hT⟩, mem_univ _⟩
+    have h2 : ContinuousWithinAt (fun τ : ℝ => (τ, x)) (Ico 0 T) t₀ :=
+      (Continuous.prodMk_left x).continuousWithinAt
+    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun τ : ℝ => (τ, x)) (Ico 0 T) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ (univ : Set R2)) :=

+def AsmLocFinite (T : ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ) : Prop :=

+theorem asmSum_eq_sum {g : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {M : ℕ} {t : ℝ} {x : R2}

+  unfold asmSum
+  rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := Finset.Ico 1 M)]
+  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro j hj
+    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hj
+    simp [hj.1]
+  · intro j hj
+    rw [Finset.mem_Ico, not_and_or, not_le, not_lt] at hj
+    rcases hj with hj | hj
+    · have : ¬ (1 ≤ j) := by omega
+      simp [this]
+    · simp [h j hj]

+  refine ⟨M + 1, by omega, fun t ht x => ?_⟩

+  intro m hm
+  exact hM m (by omega) t ht x

+  have h1 : Θ t = Θ' t := funext (hΘ t ht)
+  have h2 : Ψ t = Ψ' t := funext (hΨ t ht)
+  have h3 : ∀ s ∈ Ico 0 τ, ∀ y : R2,
+      (fun σ z => Δ (Ψ σ) z) s y = (fun σ z => Δ (Ψ' σ) z) s y := by
+    intro s hs y
+    have : Ψ s = Ψ' s := funext (hΨ s hs)
+    simp [this]
+  rw [asm_pdt_congr_slab ht h3, h1, h2]
+

+theorem asmTotal_Rtheta {T : ℝ} {Θb Ψb : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {θ ψ : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ}
+    (hfinθ : AsmLocFinite T θ) (hfinψ : AsmLocFinite T ψ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ico 0 T) (x : R2) :
+    Rtheta (asmTotal Θb θ) (asmTotal Ψb ψ) t x =
+      Rtheta Θb Ψb t x +
+        asmSum (fun m => ownedTheta (asmBelow Θb θ m) (asmBelow Ψb ψ m) (θ m) (ψ m)) t x := by
+  obtain ⟨τ, htτ, hτT⟩ := exists_between ht.2
+  obtain ⟨Mθ, hMθ⟩ := hfinθ τ hτT
+  obtain ⟨Mψ, hMψ⟩ := hfinψ τ hτT
+  set M : ℕ := max Mθ Mψ + 1 with hMdef
+  have hθM : ∀ m, M ≤ m → ∀ s ∈ Ico 0 τ, ∀ y : R2, θ m s y = 0 :=
+    fun m hm => hMθ m (by omega)
+  have hψM : ∀ m, M ≤ m → ∀ s ∈ Ico 0 τ, ∀ y : R2, ψ m s y = 0 :=
+    fun m hm => hMψ m (by omega)
+  have htτ' : t ∈ Ico 0 τ := ⟨ht.1, htτ⟩
+  rw [asm_Rtheta_congr_slab htτ' (asmTotal_eq_asmBelow_from hθM Θb le_rfl)
+    (asmTotal_eq_asmBelow_from hψM Ψb le_rfl) x, asmBelow_Rtheta _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
+  congr 1
+  rw [asmSum_eq_sum (M := M)]
+  intro m hm
+  exact asm_ownedTheta_eq_zero_slab htτ' (hθM m hm) (hψM m hm) x
+

+  obtain ⟨Mψ, hMψ⟩ := hfinψ τ hτT

+  have hθM : ∀ m, M ≤ m → ∀ s ∈ Ico 0 τ, ∀ y : R2, θ m s y = 0 :=
+    fun m hm => hMθ m (by omega)
+  have hψM : ∀ m, M ≤ m → ∀ s ∈ Ico 0 τ, ∀ y : R2, ψ m s y = 0 :=
+    fun m hm => hMψ m (by omega)
+  have htτ' : t ∈ Ico 0 τ := ⟨ht.1, htτ⟩
+  rw [asm_Romega_congr_slab htτ' (asmTotal_eq_asmBelow_from hθM Θb le_rfl)
+    (asmTotal_eq_asmBelow_from hψM Ψb le_rfl) x, asmBelow_Romega _ _ _ _ (by omega)]

+theorem asmLocFinite_ownedTheta {T : ℝ} {Θb Ψb : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {θ ψ : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ}

+theorem asmBelow_uncurry_eq (Gb : ℝ → R2 → ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ) (M : ℕ) :
+    (fun z : ℝ × R2 => asmBelow Gb g M z.1 z.2) =
+      (fun z : ℝ × R2 => Gb z.1 z.2) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 M, (fun z : ℝ × R2 => g j z.1 z.2) := by

+theorem asmTotal_iteratedFDerivWithin {T : ℝ} {Gb : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {g : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ}
+    (hfin : AsmLocFinite T g)
+    (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => Gb z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    (hg : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => g m z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    (k : ℕ) {z : ℝ × R2} (hz : z ∈ Ico 0 T ×ˢ (univ : Set R2)) :
+    ∃ M : ℕ, (∀ M', M ≤ M' →
+      iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × R2 => asmTotal Gb g w.1 w.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) z =
+        iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × R2 => Gb w.1 w.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) z +
+          ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 M',
+            iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × R2 => g j w.1 w.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) z) ∧
+      (∀ m, M ≤ m → iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × R2 => g m w.1 w.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) z = 0) := by
+  obtain ⟨⟨hz0, hzT⟩, -⟩ := hz
+  obtain ⟨τ, htτ, hτT⟩ := exists_between hzT
+  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hfin τ hτT
+  have hU : (Iio τ ×ˢ (univ : Set R2)) ∈ nhdsWithin z (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) := by
+    apply mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds
+    exact (isOpen_Iio.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds ⟨htτ, mem_univ _⟩
+  have hzmem : z ∈ Ico (0:ℝ) T ×ˢ (univ : Set R2) := ⟨⟨hz0, hzT⟩, mem_univ _⟩
+  refine ⟨M, fun M' hM' => ?_, fun m hm => ?_⟩
+  · have heq : (fun w : ℝ × R2 => asmTotal Gb g w.1 w.2) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ)]
+        (fun w : ℝ × R2 => asmBelow Gb g M' w.1 w.2) := by
+      filter_upwards [hU, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with w hw hw'
+      exact asmTotal_eq_asmBelow_from hM Gb hM' w.1 ⟨hw'.1.1, hw.1⟩ w.2
+    have hkb : ContDiffWithinAt ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × R2 => Gb w.1 w.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) z :=
+      (hb z hzmem).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
+    have hkg : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 M',
+        ContDiffWithinAt ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × R2 => g j w.1 w.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) z :=
+      fun j hj => ((hg j (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hj).1) z hzmem).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
+    have hks : ContDiffWithinAt ℝ k (∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 M', fun w : ℝ × R2 => g j w.1 w.2)
+        (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) z := by
+      rw [Finset.sum_fn]
+      exact ContDiffWithinAt.sum hkg
+    rw [(heq.iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k).self_of_nhdsWithin hzmem, asmBelow_uncurry_eq,
+      iteratedFDerivWithin_add_apply hkb hks (asm_uniqueDiffOn_slab T) hzmem,
+      iteratedFDerivWithin_sum_apply (asm_uniqueDiffOn_slab T) hzmem hkg]
+  · have heq : (fun w : ℝ × R2 => g m w.1 w.2) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ)]
+        (fun _ => 0) := by
+      filter_upwards [hU, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with w hw hw'
+      exact hM m hm w.1 ⟨hw'.1.1, hw.1⟩ w.2
+    rw [(heq.iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k).self_of_nhdsWithin hzmem]
+    simp
+
+theorem asmTotal_iteratedFDerivWithin_le {T : ℝ} {Gb : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {g : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ}
+    (hfin : AsmLocFinite T g)
+    (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => Gb z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    (hg : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => g m z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    (k : ℕ) {Mb : ℝ} {B : ℕ → ℝ}
+    (hMb : ∀ z ∈ Ico 0 T ×ˢ (univ : Set R2),
+      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × R2 => Gb w.1 w.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) z‖ ≤ Mb)
+    (hB : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ Ico 0 T ×ˢ (univ : Set R2),
+      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × R2 => g m w.1 w.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) z‖ ≤ B m)
+    (hB0 : ∀ m, 0 ≤ B m) (hsum : Summable B)
+    {z : ℝ × R2} (hz : z ∈ Ico 0 T ×ˢ (univ : Set R2)) :
+    ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × R2 => asmTotal Gb g w.1 w.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) z‖ ≤
+      Mb + ∑' m, B m := by
+  obtain ⟨M, hM, -⟩ := asmTotal_iteratedFDerivWithin hfin hb hg k hz
+  rw [hM M le_rfl]
+  refine le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (add_le_add (hMb z hz) ?_)
+  refine le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _) ?_
+  refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj => hB j (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hj).1 z hz) ?_
+  exact hsum.sum_le_tsum _ (fun m _ => hB0 m)
+

+theorem asm_norm_kerK_le (h31a : lem_3_1_a) {φ₀ : R2 → ℝ} (hφ : IsUnitBump φ₀) {C : ℝ}
+    (hC : ∀ y, |φ₀ y| ≤ C) (x z : R2) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
+    ‖kerK φ₀ x z‖ ≤ C * (1 + (‖x‖ + 1 / 2) / ‖z‖) := by
+  have h := ((h31a φ₀ hφ z hz).2 [] x).2 C (by simpa [iterPartial] using hC)
+  simpa [kerK, norm_smul, iterPartial] using h
+
+theorem asm_integrable_bog (h31a : lem_3_1_a) {φ₀ : R2 → ℝ} (hφ : IsUnitBump φ₀) {E : R2 → ℝ}
+    (hE : Continuous E) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hEs : ∀ y : R2, R < ‖y‖ → E y = 0) (x : R2) :
+    Integrable (fun z : R2 => E (x - z) • kerK φ₀ x z) := by
+
+  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C, ∀ y, |φ₀ y| ≤ C := by
+    have hcs : HasCompactSupport φ₀ :=
+      HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 2))
+        (subset_trans (subset_trans subset_closure hφ.2.2.1) Metric.ball_subset_closedBall)
+    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (hφ.1.continuous.norm).bddAbove_range_of_hasCompactSupport hcs.norm
+    exact ⟨C, fun y => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC (Set.mem_range_self y)⟩
+  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A, ∀ y, |E y| ≤ A := by
+    have hcs : HasCompactSupport E := by
+      apply HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : R2) R)
+      intro y hy
+      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
+      by_contra h
+      exact hy (hEs y (lt_of_not_ge h))
+    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := (hE.norm).bddAbove_range_of_hasCompactSupport hcs.norm
+    exact ⟨A, fun y => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hA (Set.mem_range_self y)⟩
+
+  set ρ : ℝ := ‖x‖ + R + 1 with hρ
+  have hvan : ∀ z : R2, z ∉ Metric.ball (0 : R2) ρ → E (x - z) • kerK φ₀ x z = 0 := by
+    intro z hz
+    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, not_lt] at hz
+    have : R < ‖x - z‖ := by
+      have := norm_sub_norm_le z x
+      rw [norm_sub_rev] at this
+      linarith
+    simp [hEs _ this]
+  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z : R2 => E (x - z) • kerK φ₀ x z) volume :=
+    ((hE.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable).smul
+      (asm_kerK_aestronglyMeasurable hφ.1.continuous x)
+  rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Set.union_compl_self (Metric.ball (0 : R2) ρ), integrableOn_union]
+  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
+  ·
+    have hd : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ R2 := by simp
+    have hα : (1 : ℝ) < Module.finrank ℝ R2 := by simp
+    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hA 0)
+    have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hC 0)
+    have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := by rw [hρ]; positivity
+    apply integrableOn_ball_of_norm_le_rpow hd hα (C := A * (C * (ρ + (‖x‖ + 1 / 2)))) _ hmeas
+    apply ae_restrict_of_ae
+    have hne : ({0} : Set R2)ᶜ ∈ ae (volume : Measure R2) :=
+      compl_mem_ae_iff.mpr (measure_singleton 0)
+    filter_upwards [hne] with z hz
+    rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
+    have hzpos : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz
+    by_cases hzb : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : R2) ρ
+    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hzb
+      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.rpow_neg_one]
+      have hK := asm_norm_kerK_le h31a hφ hC x z hz
+      have hfrac : 1 + (‖x‖ + 1 / 2) / ‖z‖ ≤ (ρ + (‖x‖ + 1 / 2)) * ‖z‖⁻¹ := by
+        rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ hzpos, add_mul, one_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hzpos.ne']
+        linarith
+      calc |E (x - z)| * ‖kerK φ₀ x z‖
+          ≤ A * (C * (1 + (‖x‖ + 1 / 2) / ‖z‖)) :=
+            mul_le_mul (hA _) hK (norm_nonneg _) hA0
+        _ ≤ A * (C * ((ρ + (‖x‖ + 1 / 2)) * ‖z‖⁻¹)) := by gcongr
+        _ = A * (C * (ρ + (‖x‖ + 1 / 2))) * ‖z‖⁻¹ := by ring
+    · rw [hvan z hzb, norm_zero]
+      exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.rpow_nonneg hzpos.le _)
+  · exact integrableOn_zero.congr_fun (fun z hz => (hvan z hz).symm)
+      Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet.compl
+
+theorem asm_bogB_add (h31a : lem_3_1_a) {φ₀ : R2 → ℝ} (hφ : IsUnitBump φ₀) {E₁ E₂ : R2 → ℝ}
+    (h₁ : Continuous E₁) (h₂ : Continuous E₂) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
+    (hs₁ : ∀ y : R2, R < ‖y‖ → E₁ y = 0) (hs₂ : ∀ y : R2, R < ‖y‖ → E₂ y = 0) (x : R2) :
+    bogB φ₀ (fun y => E₁ y + E₂ y) x = bogB φ₀ E₁ x + bogB φ₀ E₂ x := by
+  unfold bogB
+  rw [← integral_add (asm_integrable_bog h31a hφ h₁ hR hs₁ x) (asm_integrable_bog h31a hφ h₂ hR hs₂ x)]
+  congr 1
+  funext z
+  rw [add_smul]
+
+theorem asm_Rc_add (h31a : lem_3_1_a) {φ₀ : R2 → ℝ} (hφ : IsUnitBump φ₀) {E₁ E₂ : R2 → ℝ}
+    (h₁ : Continuous E₁) (h₂ : Continuous E₂) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
+    (hs₁ : ∀ y : R2, R < ‖y‖ → E₁ y = 0) (hs₂ : ∀ y : R2, R < ‖y‖ → E₂ y = 0) (x : R2) :
+    Rc φ₀ (fun y => E₁ y + E₂ y) x = Rc φ₀ E₁ x + Rc φ₀ E₂ x := by
+  unfold Rc
+  rw [asm_bogB_add h31a hφ h₁ h₂ hR hs₁ hs₂ x]
+  simp only [Mat2.perp, PiLp.add_apply, neg_add, add_smul]
+  abel
+
+theorem asm_Rc_sum (h31a : lem_3_1_a) {φ₀ : R2 → ℝ} (hφ : IsUnitBump φ₀) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
+    {E : ι → R2 → ℝ} (hE : ∀ i ∈ s, Continuous (E i)) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
+    (hs : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ y : R2, R < ‖y‖ → E i y = 0) (x : R2) :
+    Rc φ₀ (fun y => ∑ i ∈ s, E i y) x = ∑ i ∈ s, Rc φ₀ (E i) x := by
+  classical
+  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
+  | empty =>
+      simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
+      unfold Rc bogB
+      simp [Mat2.perp]
+  | insert a s ha ih =>
+      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
+      have hE' : ∀ i ∈ s, Continuous (E i) := fun i hi => hE i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
+      have hs' : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ y : R2, R < ‖y‖ → E i y = 0 :=
+        fun i hi => hs i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
+      rw [← ih hE' hs']
+      simp only [Finset.sum_insert ha]
+      apply asm_Rc_add h31a hφ (hE a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)) (continuous_finsetSum s fun i hi => hE' i hi) hR
+        (hs a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
+      intro y hy
+      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi => hs' i hi y hy
+
+theorem asm_continuous_section {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
+    {T : ℝ} {Θ : ℝ → R2 → F}
+    (h : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => Θ z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ)) {t : ℝ}
+    (ht : t ∈ Ico 0 T) : Continuous (Θ t) := by
+  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × R2 => Θ z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ) := h.continuousOn

+    apply hc.comp_continuous (by fun_prop)

+  apply hg.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport
+  apply HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : R2) R)

+    (hs : ∀ x : R2, R ≤ ‖x‖ → g x = 0) : MemLp g 2 (volume : Measure R2) := by

+theorem asm_classical_of_substData (h33a : prop_3_3_a) (h33c : prop_3_3_c) (h33d : prop_3_3_d)
+    {T : ℝ} {φ₀ : R2 → ℝ} {Θ Ψ : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {R : ℝ}
+    (hD : SubstData (Ico 0 T) φ₀ Θ Ψ R) :
+    ClassicalBoussinesq 1 T Θ (substP φ₀ Θ Ψ) (substU Ψ) (substFu φ₀ Θ Ψ) (Rtheta Θ Ψ) := by
+  obtain ⟨hu_smooth, -, hu_div, hu_supp, -, -⟩ := h33a _ _ _ _ _ hD
+  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hp_smooth, -⟩ := h33c _ _ _ _ _ hD
+  have hd := h33d _ _ _ _ _ hD
+  obtain ⟨-, -, hΘ_smooth, -, -, -, -, hsupp⟩ := hD
+  refine ⟨hΘ_smooth, ?_, hp_smooth, fun t ht x => (hd t ht x).2.2.1, fun t ht => ⟨?_, ?_⟩,
+    fun t ht x => (hd t ht x).1, fun t ht x i => ?_⟩

+    exact asm_memLp_two_of_vanish_vec hcu (fun x hx => hu_supp t ht x hx)

+  · rw [one_mul]

+theorem asm_Rc_zero (φ₀ : R2 → ℝ) (x : R2) : Rc φ₀ (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x = 0 := by

+theorem asm_Rc_asmTotal (h31a : lem_3_1_a) {φ₀ : R2 → ℝ} (hφ : IsUnitBump φ₀) {T : ℝ}
+    {Eb : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {EL : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ} (hfin : AsmLocFinite T EL) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
+    (hb : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, Continuous (Eb t))
+    (hbs : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ y : R2, R < ‖y‖ → Eb t y = 0)
+    (hL : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, Continuous (EL m t))
+    (hLs : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ y : R2, R < ‖y‖ → EL m t y = 0)
+    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ico 0 T) (x : R2) (i : Fin 2) :
+    (Rc φ₀ (asmTotal Eb EL t) x) i =
+      (Rc φ₀ (Eb t) x) i + asmSum (fun m s y => (Rc φ₀ (EL m s) y) i) t x := by
+  obtain ⟨τ, htτ, hτT⟩ := exists_between ht.2
+  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hfin τ hτT
+  have htτ' : t ∈ Ico 0 τ := ⟨ht.1, htτ⟩
+  have hfun : asmTotal Eb EL t = fun y => Eb t y + ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 M, EL m t y := by
+    funext y
+    exact asmTotal_eq_asmBelow_from hM Eb le_rfl t htτ' y
+  rw [hfun, asm_Rc_add h31a hφ (hb t ht) (continuous_finsetSum _ fun m hm =>
+      hL m (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hm).1 t ht) hR (hbs t ht)
+      (fun y hy => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun m hm => hLs m (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hm).1 t ht y hy) x,
+    asm_Rc_sum h31a hφ (Finset.Ico 1 M) (fun m hm => hL m (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hm).1 t ht) hR
+      (fun m hm => hLs m (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hm).1 t ht) x]
+  rw [PiLp.add_apply]
+  congr 1
+  rw [asmSum_eq_sum (M := M)]
+  · simp [Finset.sum_apply]
+  · intro m hm
+    have : EL m t = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := funext fun y => hM m hm t htτ' y
+    rw [this, asm_Rc_zero]
+    rfl
+
+theorem asmTotal_substFu (h31a : lem_3_1_a) {φ₀ : R2 → ℝ} (hφ : IsUnitBump φ₀) {T : ℝ}
+    {Θb Ψb : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {θ ψ : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ}
+    (hfinθ : AsmLocFinite T θ) (hfinψ : AsmLocFinite T ψ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
+    (hb : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, Continuous (Romega Θb Ψb t))
+    (hbs : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ y : R2, R < ‖y‖ → Romega Θb Ψb t y = 0)
+    (hL : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T,
+      Continuous (ownedOmega (asmBelow Θb θ m) (asmBelow Ψb ψ m) (θ m) (ψ m) t))
+    (hLs : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ y : R2, R < ‖y‖ →
+      ownedOmega (asmBelow Θb θ m) (asmBelow Ψb ψ m) (θ m) (ψ m) t y = 0)
+    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ico 0 T) (x : R2) (i : Fin 2) :
+    (substFu φ₀ (asmTotal Θb θ) (asmTotal Ψb ψ) t x) i =
+      (Rc φ₀ (Romega Θb Ψb t) x) i +
+        asmSum (fun m s y =>
+          (Rc φ₀ (ownedOmega (asmBelow Θb θ m) (asmBelow Ψb ψ m) (θ m) (ψ m) s) y) i) t x := by
+  unfold substFu
+  have hfun : Romega (asmTotal Θb θ) (asmTotal Ψb ψ) t =
+      asmTotal (Romega Θb Ψb)
+        (fun m => ownedOmega (asmBelow Θb θ m) (asmBelow Ψb ψ m) (θ m) (ψ m)) t := by
+    funext y
+    exact asmTotal_Romega hfinθ hfinψ ht y
+  rw [hfun]
+  exact asm_Rc_asmTotal h31a hφ (asmLocFinite_ownedOmega hfinθ hfinψ) hR hb hbs hL hLs ht x i
+
+theorem asm_vanish_of_tsupport_ball {g : R2 → ℝ} {R₁ R : ℝ}
+    (h : tsupport g ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : R2) R₁) (hR : R₁ ≤ R) (x : R2) (hx : R ≤ ‖x‖) : g x = 0 := by
+  apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
+  intro hmem
+  have := h hmem

+  linarith

+    (h : tsupport g ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) R₁) (hR : R₁ < R) (x : R2) (hx : R ≤ ‖x‖) :
+    g x = 0 := by

+theorem asm_thm_7_2_o_substData {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {φ₀ : R2 → ℝ} (hφ : IsUnitBump φ₀)
+    {R0 RH : ℝ} (hR0 : R0 ≤ RH) (hq : (1 : ℝ) / 4 < RH) (hh : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ RH)
+    {θB ΨB : ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {θL ψL : ℕ → ℝ → R2 → ℝ} {tIn : ℕ → ℝ}
+    (hθB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => θB z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    (hθBo : OddOn (Ico 0 T) θB)
+    (hθBs : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, tsupport (θB t) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : R2) R0)
+    (hΨB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => ΨB z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    (hΨBe : EvenOn (Ico 0 T) ΨB)
+    (hΨBs : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, tsupport (ΨB t) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : R2) RH)
+    (hlim : Tendsto tIn atTop (𝓝 T))
+    (hθL : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => θL m z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    (hθLo : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → OddOn (Ico 0 T) (θL m))
+    (hθLs : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, tsupport (θL m t) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 4))
+    (hθLv : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t, t ≤ tIn m → ∀ x : R2, θL m t x = 0)
+    (hψL : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R2 => ψL m z.1 z.2) (Ico 0 T ×ˢ univ))
+    (hψLe : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → EvenOn (Ico 0 T) (ψL m))
+    (hψLs : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, tsupport (ψL m t) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : R2) (1 / 4))
+    (hψLv : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t, t ≤ tIn m → ∀ x : R2, ψL m t x = 0) :
+    SubstData (Ico 0 T) φ₀ (asmTotal θB θL) (asmTotal ΨB ψL) RH :=
+  asmTotal_substData hT hφ hh (asmLocFinite_of_entry hlim hθLv) (asmLocFinite_of_entry hlim hψLv)
+    hθB hΨB hθL hψL hθBo hθLo hΨBe hψLe
+    (fun t ht x hx => asm_vanish_of_tsupport_ball (hθBs t ht) hR0 x hx)
+    (fun t ht x hx => asm_vanish_of_tsupport_ball (hΨBs t ht) le_rfl x hx)
+    (fun m hm t ht x hx => asm_vanish_of_tsupport_closedBall (hθLs m hm t ht) hq x hx)
+    (fun m hm t ht x hx => asm_vanish_of_tsupport_closedBall (hψLs m hm t ht) hq x hx)
+
+theorem asm_R0_add_one_le_RH {P : DesignParams} (hP : P.Admissible) : P.R0 + 1 ≤ P.RH := by
+  by_contra h
+  rw [not_le] at h
+
+  have hR0 : 2 < P.R0 := hP.two_lt_R0
+  set r : ℝ := max P.RH 1 with hr
+  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := le_max_right _ _
+  have hrR : P.RH ≤ r := le_max_left _ _
+  have hrlt : r < P.R0 + 1 := max_lt h (by linarith)
+  set x : R2 := r • e 0 with hx
+  have hnx : ‖x‖ = r := by
+    rw [hx, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
+    simp [e]
+  have hH : P.H x = ‖x‖ ^ 2 / 2 := hP.H_core x (by rw [hnx]; exact hrlt)
+  have hHne : P.H x ≠ 0 := by
+    rw [hH, hnx]; positivity
+  have hxs : x ∈ tsupport P.H := subset_tsupport _ hHne
+  have := hP.H_support hxs
+  rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hnx] at this
+  linarith
+
+end AffineCore.Construction.Assembly.TotalsAux

+def xenv (K : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' (by simp) (fun b => max 1 (K b))
+
+theorem one_le_xenv (K : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ xenv K n :=
+  le_trans (le_max_left 1 (K 0)) (Finset.le_sup' (fun b => max 1 (K b)) (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)))
+
+theorem le_xenv (K : ℕ → ℝ) {b n : ℕ} (h : b ≤ n) : K b ≤ xenv K n :=
+  le_trans (le_max_right 1 (K b)) (Finset.le_sup' (fun b => max 1 (K b)) (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)))
