+theorem bounds_at_order {D : Frame} {X f : ℝ → Mat} (hf : AllOrderBounds D.I f) (hXf : EqOn X f D.I) {S : ℝ}
+    (hS : 0 < S) (n : ℕ) :
+    ∃ B : ℝ, 1 ≤ B ∧ ∀ b ≤ n, ∀ t ∈ D.I, ‖iteratedDerivWithin b X D.I t‖ ≤ B * D.piL ^ b * S := by
+  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := piControlled_of_allOrders (t₁ := D.tin) (T := D.Tstar) hf hS D.piL_pos
+  refine ⟨xenv C n, one_le_xenv C n, fun b hb t ht => ?_⟩
+  have h := (piControlled_congr (fun τ hτ => (hXf hτ).symm) (hC n)).2 b hb t ht
+  exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
+    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_xenv C hb) (pow_nonneg D.piL_pos.le b)) hS.le)
+
+theorem xdata_allOrders (P : DesignParams) (N1 : ℝ) (k : ℕ → ℕ) (S : SkeletonReadout) (m : ℕ) (D : Frame)
+    (htin : D.tin = S.tIn m) (hT : D.Tstar = S.Tstar) (hcdom : D.cdom = Ioo 0 S.Tstar)
+    (M Minv : ℝ → Mat) (hMs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ M (Ioo 0 S.Tstar)) (hMis : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Minv (Ioo 0 S.Tstar))
+    (hDs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (S.Dbelow P N1 k m) (Ioo 0 S.Tstar))
+    (hpin : ∀ t ∈ S.Iwin m, M t = S.M m t ∧ Minv t = S.Minv m t)
+    (aoM : Cascade.SmoothBoundedOn S m (S.M m)) (aoMi : Cascade.SmoothBoundedOn S m (S.Minv m))
+    (aoD : Cascade.SmoothBoundedOn S m (S.Dbelow P N1 k m)) (Ncar : ℝ) (p : R2) (n : ℕ) :
+    ∃ X : XData D n, X.N = Ncar ∧ X.p = p ∧ X.zeta = zetaF Minv p ∧ X.Minv = minvF Minv ∧
+      X.Emat = ematF M Minv (S.Dbelow P N1 k m) := by
+  have hI : D.I = S.Iwin m := by show Ico D.tin D.Tstar = Ico (S.tIn m) S.Tstar; rw [htin, hT]
+  have hMs' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ M D.cdom := by rw [hcdom]; exact hMs
+  have hMis' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Minv D.cdom := by rw [hcdom]; exact hMis
+  have hDs' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (S.Dbelow P N1 k m) D.cdom := by rw [hcdom]; exact hDs
+  have aoM' : AllOrderBounds D.I (S.M m) := by rw [hI]; exact allOrderBounds_of_smoothBoundedOn aoM
+  have aoMi' : AllOrderBounds D.I (S.Minv m) := by rw [hI]; exact allOrderBounds_of_smoothBoundedOn aoMi
+  have aoD' : AllOrderBounds D.I (S.Dbelow P N1 k m) := by rw [hI]; exact allOrderBounds_of_smoothBoundedOn aoD
+  have hpinM : EqOn M (S.M m) D.I := fun t ht => (hpin t (hI ▸ ht)).1
+  have hpinMi : EqOn Minv (S.Minv m) D.I := fun t ht => (hpin t (hI ▸ ht)).2
+  obtain ⟨BM, hBM1, hbM⟩ := bounds_at_order aoM' hpinM one_pos n
+  obtain ⟨BMi, hBMi1, hbMi⟩ := bounds_at_order aoMi' hpinMi one_pos n
+  obtain ⟨BD, hBD1, hbD⟩ := bounds_at_order aoD' (fun _ _ => rfl) one_pos n
+  have hBM0 : 0 ≤ BM := zero_le_one.trans hBM1
+  have hBMi0 : 0 ≤ BMi := zero_le_one.trans hBMi1
+  have hBD0 : 0 ≤ BD := zero_le_one.trans hBD1
+
+  have hMent : ∀ kk i : Fin 2, TMem D (fun _ => 1) BMi n (minvF Minv kk i) := by
+    intro kk i
+    exact tmem_clm_of_bounds D ((EuclideanSpace.proj kk : R2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
+      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ R2 (ChainPlanar.e i))) (norm_entry_le_one kk i) hMis'
+      (fun b hb t ht => by simpa using hbMi b hb t ht)
+
+  have hz : ∀ i : Fin 2, TMem D (fun _ => 1) ((|p 0| + |p 1|) * BMi) n (zetaF Minv p i) := by
+    intro i
+    have h := ((hMent 0 i).const_mul (p 0)).add ((hMent 1 i).const_mul (p 1))
+    have hfun : (fun t => p 0 * minvF Minv 0 i t + p 1 * minvF Minv 1 i t) = zetaF Minv p i := by
+      funext t
+      simp only [minvF, zetaF, TwoScale.covec, Mat2.transpose, Mat2.adjoint_coord]
+    rw [hfun] at h
+    refine h.mono (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) (le_of_eq (by ring)) le_rfl
+
+  have hE : ∀ kk l : Fin 2, TMem D (fun _ => 1) (3 ^ n * (BMi * BD * BM)) n
+      (ematF M Minv (S.Dbelow P N1 k m) kk l) := by
+    intro kk l
+    have hEs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun t => Minv t ∘L S.Dbelow P N1 k m t ∘L M t) D.cdom :=
+      hMis'.clm_comp (hDs'.clm_comp hMs')
+    exact tmem_clm_of_bounds D ((EuclideanSpace.proj kk : R2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
+      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ R2 (ChainPlanar.e l))) (norm_entry_le_one kk l) hEs
+      (fun b hb t ht => by
+        have hU := uniqueDiffOn_Ico D.tin D.Tstar
+        have hsub : D.I ⊆ D.cdom := D.I_subset_cdom
+        have h3 := comp3_bound hU (hMis'.mono hsub) (hDs'.mono hsub) (hMs'.mono hsub) ht
+          (fun i hi => hbMi i (hi.trans hb) t ht) (fun i hi => hbD i (hi.trans hb) t ht)
+          (fun i hi => hbM i (hi.trans hb) t ht)
+        refine h3.trans ?_
+        have h3b : (3 : ℝ) ^ b ≤ 3 ^ n := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hb
+        have hP0 : 0 ≤ D.piL ^ b := pow_nonneg D.piL_pos.le b
+        have hprod : 0 ≤ BMi * BD * BM := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hBMi0 hBD0) hBM0
+        calc (3 : ℝ) ^ b * (BMi * BD * BM) * D.piL ^ b * (1 * 1 * 1)
+            = (3 : ℝ) ^ b * (BMi * BD * BM) * D.piL ^ b := by ring
+          _ ≤ 3 ^ n * (BMi * BD * BM) * D.piL ^ b := by gcongr)
+  refine ⟨mkX D n Ncar p M Minv (S.Dbelow P N1 k m)
+    (mul_nonneg (add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) hBMi0) hBMi0 (by positivity) hz
+    hMent hE, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
+
+end AffineCore.Construction.Cascade.AllOrdersXDataAux

+structure LayerCoeffFns where
+
+  kinv : ℝ → ℝ
+
+  cp : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ
+
+  Cm : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ
+
+  Gt : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ
+
+  e1t : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ
+
+def PsiS (Sc : Scales) (kinv : ℝ → ℝ) (Wt : P3 → ℝ) : P3 → ℝ :=
+  fun x => (Sc.N * Sc.sigma)⁻¹ * (kinv x.1 * sAnti Wt x)
+
+def Z1 (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (q : ℕ) : P3 → ℝ :=
+  fun x => (2 / Sc.N) * (L.kinv x.1 * (L.cp 0 x.1 * dd (Ltr.a 0).vec (F (q - 1)).2 x
+    + L.cp 1 x.1 * dd (Ltr.a 1).vec (F (q - 1)).2 x))
+
+def Z2 (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) : ℕ → P3 → ℝ
+  | 0 => fun _ => 0
+  | 1 => fun _ => 0
+  | m + 2 => fun x => Sc.sigma / Sc.N * DeltaM L.Cm (PsiS Sc L.kinv (F m).2) x
+
+def calZ (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (q : ℕ) : P3 → ℝ :=
+  fun x => Z1 Sc L F q x + Z2 Sc L F q x
+
+def T1 (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) : P3 → ℝ :=
+  fun x => -(L.Gt 0 x.1 * PsiS Sc L.kinv (dd (Ltr.a 1).vec (F (n - 1)).2) x)
+    + L.Gt 1 x.1 * PsiS Sc L.kinv (dd (Ltr.a 0).vec (F (n - 1)).2) x
+
+def T2 (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) : P3 → ℝ :=
+  fun x => Sc.N * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
+    Js Sc.p (fun y => (Sc.N * Sc.sigma)⁻¹ * (L.kinv y.1 * sAnti (F i).2 y)) (F (n - 1 - i)).1 x
+
+def T3 (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) : P3 → ℝ :=
+  fun x => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), brA (PsiS Sc L.kinv (F i).2) (F (n - 2 - i)).1 x
+
+def Stheta (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) : P3 → ℝ :=
+  fun x => T1 Sc L F n x + T2 Sc L F n x + T3 Sc L F n x
+
+def U1 (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) : P3 → ℝ :=
+  dd Ltr.t.vec (fun x => (2 / Sc.N) * (L.kinv x.1 * (L.cp 0 x.1 * dd (Ltr.a 0).vec (F (n - 1)).2 x
+    + L.cp 1 x.1 * dd (Ltr.a 1).vec (F (n - 1)).2 x)))
+
+def U2 (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) : ℕ → P3 → ℝ
+  | 0 => fun _ => 0
+  | 1 => fun _ => 0
+  | m + 2 => fun x => Sc.sigma / Sc.N * dd Ltr.t.vec (DeltaM L.Cm (PsiS Sc L.kinv (F m).2)) x
+
+def U3 (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) : P3 → ℝ :=
+  fun x => -(Sc.sigma / Sc.N) * (L.e1t 0 x.1 * dd (Ltr.a 0).vec (F (n - 1)).1 x
+    + L.e1t 1 x.1 * dd (Ltr.a 1).vec (F (n - 1)).1 x)
+
+def U4W (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) : P3 → ℝ :=
+  fun x => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Sc.N *
+    (dd Ltr.s.vec (PsiS Sc L.kinv (F i).2) x * dd Ltr.s.vec (dperp Sc.p (F (n - 1 - i)).2) x
+      - dd Ltr.s.vec (dd Ltr.s.vec (F (n - 1 - i)).2) x * PsiS Sc L.kinv (dperp Sc.p (F i).2) x)
+
+def U4Z (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) : P3 → ℝ :=
+  fun x => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), Sc.N *
+    (dd Ltr.s.vec (PsiS Sc L.kinv (F i).2) x * dperp Sc.p (calZ Sc L F (n - 1 - i)) x
+      - dd Ltr.s.vec (calZ Sc L F (n - 1 - i)) x * PsiS Sc L.kinv (dperp Sc.p (F i).2) x)
+
+def U4 (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) : P3 → ℝ :=
+  fun x => U4W Sc L F n x + U4Z Sc L F n x
+
+def U5 (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) : P3 → ℝ :=
+  fun x => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1),
+      brA (PsiS Sc L.kinv (F i).2) (dd Ltr.s.vec (F (n - 1 - 1 - i)).2) x)
+    + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1 - 1), brA (PsiS Sc L.kinv (F i).2) (calZ Sc L F (n - 1 - 1 - i)) x
+
+def Stomega (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) : P3 → ℝ :=
+  fun x => U1 Sc L F n x + U2 Sc L F n x + U3 Sc L F n x + U4 Sc L F n x + U5 Sc L F n x
+
+theorem PsiS_eq (C : LevelGeom) (kinv : ℝ → ℝ) (Wt : P3 → ℝ) : PsiS C.S kinv Wt = C.Psi kinv Wt := rfl
+
+theorem T3_eq (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) :
+    T3 C.S L F n = C.T3 L.kinv F n := rfl
+
+theorem U3_eq (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) :
+    U3 C.S L F n = C.U3 L.e1t F n := rfl
+
+theorem Z1_eq (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (q : ℕ) :
+    Z1 C.S L F q = C.Z1 L.kinv L.cp F q := rfl
+
+theorem Z2_eq (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (q : ℕ) :
+    Z2 C.S L F q = C.Z2 L.kinv L.Cm F q := by
+  rcases q with _ | _ | q <;> rfl
+
+theorem T1_eq (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) :
+    T1 C.S L F n = LeafT1Aux.termT1 C L.kinv L.Gt F n := rfl
+
+theorem U1_eq (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) :
+    U1 C.S L F n = LeafU1Aux.termU1 C L.kinv L.cp F n := rfl
+
+theorem U4_eq (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ)
+    (h : C.calZ = calZ C.S L) : U4 C.S L F n = LeafU4Aux.termU4 C L.kinv F n := by
+  funext x
+  simp only [U4, U4W, U4Z, LeafU4Aux.termU4, LeafU4Aux.termU4W, LeafU4Aux.termU4Z, h]
+  rfl
+
+theorem T2_eq (Sc : Scales) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) :
+    T2 Sc L F n = LeafT2Aux.termT2 Sc L.kinv F n := rfl
+
+theorem U2_eq (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) :
+    U2 C.S L F n = LeafU2Aux.termU2 C L.Cm L.kinv F n := by
+  rcases n with _ | _ | n <;> rfl
+
+theorem U5_eq (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ)
+    (h : C.calZ = calZ C.S L) : U5 C.S L F n = LeafU5Aux.termU5 C L.kinv F n := by
+  funext x
+  simp only [U5, LeafU5Aux.termU5, LeafU5Aux.termU5W, LeafU5Aux.termU5Z, h]
+  rfl
+
+def leafCth (U : UniversalData) (r : ℕ) : ℝ :=
+  LeafT1Aux.cT1 U.kapSeq U.Cbar r + LeafT2Aux.rowT2 U.Ybr U.kapSeq r + LevelData.cT3 U.kapSeq U.Ybr r
+
+def leafCom (U : UniversalData) (r : ℕ) : ℝ :=
+  LeafU1Aux.constU1 U.kapSeq U.Cbar r + LeafU2Aux.rowU2 U.kapSeq U.Cbar r + LevelData.cU3 U.Cbar r
+    + LeafU4Aux.constU4 U.kapSeq U.Ybr r + LeafU5Aux.rowU5 U.kapSeq U.Ybr r
+
+def leafCZ (U : UniversalData) (r : ℕ) : ℝ :=
+  LevelData.cZ1 U.kapSeq U.Cbar r + LevelData.cZ2 U.kapSeq U.Cbar r
+
+theorem leafCth_nonneg (U : UniversalData) (r : ℕ) : 0 ≤ leafCth U r := by
+  have h1 := U.kapSeq_nonneg (r + 1); have h3 := U.kapSeq_nonneg (r + 3)
+  have hC := U.Cbar_nonneg r; have hY := U.Ybr_nonneg
+  unfold leafCth LeafT1Aux.cT1 LeafT2Aux.rowT2 LevelData.cT3
+  positivity
+
+theorem leafCom_nonneg (U : UniversalData) (r : ℕ) : 0 ≤ leafCom U r := by
+  have h1 := U.kapSeq_nonneg (r + 1); have h3 := U.kapSeq_nonneg (r + 3)
+  have hC := U.Cbar_nonneg r; have hC1 := U.Cbar_nonneg (r + 1); have hY := U.Ybr_nonneg
+  unfold leafCom LeafU1Aux.constU1 LeafU2Aux.rowU2 LevelData.cU3 LeafU4Aux.constU4
+    LeafU4Aux.constU4half LeafU5Aux.rowU5
+  positivity
+
+theorem leafCZ_nonneg (U : UniversalData) (r : ℕ) : 0 ≤ leafCZ U r := by
+  have h0 := U.kapSeq_nonneg r; have h2 := U.kapSeq_nonneg (r + 2)
+  have hC := U.Cbar_nonneg r
+  unfold leafCZ LevelData.cZ1 LevelData.cZ2
+  positivity
+
+def leafConstsOf (U : UniversalData) : LeafConsts where
+  cth := leafCth U
+  com := leafCom U
+  cZ := leafCZ U
+  cth_nonneg := leafCth_nonneg U
+  com_nonneg := leafCom_nonneg U
+  cZ_nonneg := leafCZ_nonneg U
+
+end AffineCore.Construction.Cascade

+theorem casc_iii_row_le (S : Scales) {Kk x y z e : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ Kk)
+    (he : e = -(29 : ℝ) / 5 ∨ e = -(24 : ℝ) / 5) (hx : x ≤ Kk * S.N ^ e)
+    (hy : y ≤ Kk * S.N ^ (-(31 : ℝ) / 20)) (hz : z ≤ S.N ^ (-(53 : ℝ) / 10)) :

+  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := S.pieces_le
+  have hN := S.N_pos
+  have hK0 : 0 ≤ Kk := zero_le_one.trans hK
+  have hrow : 0 ≤ S.N ^ (-(31 : ℝ) / 20) := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hN _).le
+  have hxe : S.N ^ e ≤ S.N ^ (-(31 : ℝ) / 20) := by
+    rcases he with rfl | rfl
+    · exact h1
+    · exact h2
+  have hx' : x ≤ Kk * S.N ^ (-(31 : ℝ) / 20) := hx.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxe hK0)
+  have hz' : z ≤ Kk * S.N ^ (-(31 : ℝ) / 20) :=

+theorem casc_iii_assembly (S : Scales) {Kk CRc fθ fu E xθ yθ zθ xω yω zω : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ Kk)

+    (hzθ : zθ ≤ S.N ^ (-(53 : ℝ) / 10)) (hxω : xω ≤ Kk * S.N ^ (-(24 : ℝ) / 5))
+    (hyω : yω ≤ Kk * S.N ^ (-(31 : ℝ) / 20)) (hzω : zω ≤ S.N ^ (-(53 : ℝ) / 10))
+    (hRc : fu ≤ CRc * E) (hH0 : 3 * (1 + CRc) * Kk ≤ S.N ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 10)) :
+    fθ + fu ≤ S.N ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 2) := by
+  have hN := S.N_pos
+  have hrow : 0 ≤ S.N ^ (-(31 : ℝ) / 20) := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hN _).le

+  have hE' : E ≤ 3 * (Kk * S.N ^ (-(31 : ℝ) / 20)) := hE.trans h2

+    hRc.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE' hC)
+  calc fθ + fu ≤ 3 * (Kk * S.N ^ (-(31 : ℝ) / 20)) + CRc * (3 * (Kk * S.N ^ (-(31 : ℝ) / 20))) :=

+    _ = (3 * (1 + CRc) * Kk) * S.N ^ (-(31 : ℝ) / 20) := by ring

+theorem casc_iii_Stheta_mem (C : LevelData) (hZ : C.LeafZ) (hθ : C.LeafTheta) (hω : C.LeafOmega)

+    (C.invZ_all hZ hθ hω hF (m + 1))).1 r hr

+  refine h.mono hwt ?_ le_rfl
+  calc C.cth r * C.ampS m r ≤ (C.cth r + C.com r) * C.ampS m r :=
+        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_add_of_nonneg_right (C.com_nonneg r)) (C.ampS_nonneg m r)

+        rw [C.sfrak_eq]; unfold LevelData.ampS; ring

+    show deriv (fun τ => S.ramp P N1 k m τ * S.OmegaHat P N1 m τ) t
+      - bh t * (S.ramp P N1 k m t * S.Theta m t) = 0
+    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ht with hlt | rfl
+    · rw [(hbefore t hlt).2, h0 t ht]; ring
+    · rw [(hon _ htinI).2, hdw0, h0 _ le_rfl]; ring
+  · show deriv (fun τ => S.ramp P N1 k m τ * S.OmegaHat P N1 m τ) t
+      - bh t * (S.ramp P N1 k m t * S.Theta m t) = _
+    rw [(hon t ht).2, LevelZeroInputsAux.Ytop_apply1_lz]; ring
+
+theorem cr_iteratedDeriv_zero (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : iteratedDeriv n (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) t = 0 := by
+  induction n generalizing t with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
+    have : iteratedDeriv n (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) = fun _ => 0 := funext ih
+    rw [this]; simp
+
+theorem cr_factor_bounds {W : LemmaSWindows} {Lc : CascadeLetters} {P : DesignParams}
+    {B : ProfileBounds}
+    {ε N1 : ℝ} {k : ℕ → ℕ} {S : SkeletonReadout} {m : ℕ} {Cb Cprime cj CRc : ℕ → ℝ} {K : ℝ}
+    {Kmaster : ℕ → ℝ} {Sc : CascadeClasses.Scales}
+    (hbase : cascadeHyp_base W Lc P B ε N1 k S m Cb Cprime cj CRc K Kmaster)
+    (hSc : IsLayerScales P N1 S m Sc) (i : Fin 2) {c : ℝ → ℝ}
+    (hcs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c Sc.toFrame.cdom)
+    (hcI : ∀ t ∈ S.Iwin m, c t = deriv (S.ramp P N1 k m) t * (S.Ytop P N1 m t) i)
+    {kk : ℕ} (hkk : kk + 1 ≤ rStar k m) :
+    (∀ j ≤ kk, ∀ t ∈ Sc.toFw.toFrame.I, |iteratedDeriv j c t|
+        ≤ (2 ^ kk * runMax B.etaN (kk + 1) * runMax Cprime kk * rampY0Const ε
+            * Sc.N ^ (-((k m : ℕ) : ℝ) - 6)) * Sc.toFw.piL * Sc.toFw.piL ^ j) ∧
+    (∀ j ≤ kk, ∀ t ∈ Sc.toFw.toFrame.I, t ∉ rampWin P N1 k S m → iteratedDeriv j c t = 0) := by
+  obtain ⟨⟨ht0, htin, hT, -, hpi, -⟩, hN, -, -, -⟩ := hSc
+  have hI : Sc.toFw.toFrame.I = S.Iwin m := by
+    show Ico Sc.tin Sc.Tstar = Ico (S.tIn m) S.Tstar; rw [htin, hT]
+  have hpi' : Sc.toFw.piL = gaugePi P N1 m := hpi
+  have hN' : Sc.N = N P N1 m := hN
+  have hPg : 0 ≤ gaugePi P N1 m := (inv_pos.2 hbase.ell_pos).le.trans hbase.h0p.ellInv_le
+  have hGam : 0 < S.Gam P N1 k m :=
+    (inv_pos.2 ((inv_pos.2 hbase.ell_pos).trans_le hbase.h0p.ellInv_le)).trans_le
+      hbase.h0p.gam_window.1
+
+  have hwithin : ∀ j, ∀ t ∈ S.Iwin m, iteratedDeriv j c t
+      = iteratedDerivWithin j (fun τ => deriv (S.ramp P N1 k m) τ * (S.Ytop P N1 m τ) i)
+          (S.Iwin m) t := by
+    intro j t ht
+    rw [← LevelZeroInputsAux.iteratedDerivWithin_I_eq_lz Sc.toFw.toFrame hcs j (hI.symm ▸ ht), hI]
+    exact iteratedDerivWithin_congr (fun τ hτ => hcI τ hτ) ht
+
+  have hzero : ∀ j, ∀ t ∈ S.Iwin m, t ∉ rampWin P N1 k S m → iteratedDeriv j c t = 0 := by
+    intro j t ht htR
+    have hgt : S.tIn m + (S.Gam P N1 k m)⁻¹ < t := by
+      by_contra h; exact htR ⟨ht.1, not_lt.1 h⟩
+    have hU : IsOpen (Ioo (S.tIn m + (S.Gam P N1 k m)⁻¹) S.Tstar) := isOpen_Ioo
+    have hsub : Ioo (S.tIn m + (S.Gam P N1 k m)⁻¹) S.Tstar ⊆ S.Iwin m := fun τ hτ =>
+      ⟨((le_add_of_nonneg_right (inv_nonneg.2 hGam.le)).trans hτ.1.le), hτ.2⟩
+    have hdw := cr_dramp_eventually_zero hbase hgt
+    have hev : c =ᶠ[𝓝 t] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
+      have h1 : ∀ᶠ τ in 𝓝 t, τ ∈ Ioo (S.tIn m + (S.Gam P N1 k m)⁻¹) S.Tstar :=
+        hU.mem_nhds ⟨hgt, ht.2⟩
+      filter_upwards [h1, hdw] with τ hτ hτ'
+      rw [hcI τ (hsub hτ), hτ', zero_mul]
+    rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq, cr_iteratedDeriv_zero]
+  refine ⟨fun j hj t ht => ?_, fun j hj t ht htR => hzero j t (hI ▸ ht) htR⟩
+  rw [hI] at ht
+  have hR0 : 0 ≤ (2 ^ kk * runMax B.etaN (kk + 1) * runMax Cprime kk * rampY0Const ε
+      * Sc.N ^ (-((k m : ℕ) : ℝ) - 6)) * Sc.toFw.piL * Sc.toFw.piL ^ j := by
+    have := runMax_nonneg B.etaN (kk + 1); have := runMax_nonneg Cprime kk
+    have := rampY0Const_nonneg ε
+    have : 0 ≤ Sc.N ^ (-((k m : ℕ) : ℝ) - 6) :=
+      Real.rpow_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans Sc.one_lt_N.le) _
+    have : 0 ≤ Sc.toFw.piL := hpi' ▸ hPg
+    positivity
+  by_cases htR : t ∈ rampWin P N1 k S m
+  · rw [hwithin j t ht]
+    refine (cr_prod_bound hbase i hkk j hj t ht).trans ?_
+    have hY := cr_Ytop_ramp hbase htR
+    rw [← hN'] at hY
+    rw [hpi', mul_one]
+    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ 2 ^ kk := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hj
+    have hη := runMax_nonneg B.etaN (kk + 1); have hC := runMax_nonneg Cprime kk
+    have hYc := rampY0Const_nonneg ε
+    have hpow : 0 ≤ gaugePi P N1 m ^ j := pow_nonneg hPg _
+    calc 2 ^ j * (runMax B.etaN (kk + 1) * gaugePi P N1 m) * runMax Cprime kk * gaugePi P N1 m ^ j
+          * ‖S.Ytop P N1 m t‖
+        = 2 ^ j * ‖S.Ytop P N1 m t‖
+          * (runMax B.etaN (kk + 1) * runMax Cprime kk * gaugePi P N1 m * gaugePi P N1 m ^ j) := by
+          ring
+      _ ≤ 2 ^ kk * (rampY0Const ε * Sc.N ^ (-((k m : ℕ) : ℝ) - 6))
+          * (runMax B.etaN (kk + 1) * runMax Cprime kk * gaugePi P N1 m * gaugePi P N1 m ^ j) :=
+          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul h2 hY (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
+            (by positivity)
+      _ = _ := by ring
+  · rw [hzero j t ht htR, abs_zero]; exact hR0
+
+theorem cr_iteratedDeriv_const_le (c : ℝ) {Pg : ℝ} (hPg : 1 ≤ Pg) (j : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
+    |iteratedDeriv j (fun _ : ℝ => c) t| ≤ |c| * Pg ^ j := by
+  cases j with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ n =>
+    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ']
+    have : deriv (fun _ : ℝ => c) = fun _ => 0 := by funext x; simp
+    rw [this, cr_iteratedDeriv_zero, abs_zero]
+    exact mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg c) (pow_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans hPg) _)
+
+theorem cr_profileF {P : DesignParams} {B : ProfileBounds} (hadm : P.Admissible) (hB : B.Holds P)
+    (kk : ℕ) :
+    (ContDiff ℝ ∞ P.F ∧ Function.Periodic P.F (2 * π) ∧
+      ∀ i ≤ kk, ∀ s : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv i P.F s| ≤ runMax B.FN kk) ∧
+    (ContDiff ℝ ∞ (deriv P.F) ∧ Function.Periodic (deriv P.F) (2 * π) ∧
+      ∀ i ≤ kk, ∀ s : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv i (deriv P.F) s| ≤ runMax B.FN (kk + 1)) := by
+  have hF := hadm.F_smooth
+  have hFb := hB.2.2.1
+  have hper : Function.Periodic (deriv P.F) (2 * π) := by
+    intro s
+    have h := funext hadm.F_periodic
+    rw [← deriv_comp_add_const, h]
+  refine ⟨⟨hF, hadm.F_periodic, fun i hi s => ?_⟩, ⟨hF.iterate_deriv 1, hper, fun i hi s => ?_⟩⟩
+  · have h := hFb i s; rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
+    exact h.trans (le_runMax B.FN hi)
+  · rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
+    have h := hFb (i + 1) s; rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
+    exact h.trans (le_runMax B.FN (by omega))
+
+theorem cr_profileG (D : Framework.Cascade.Frame) {P : DesignParams} {B : ProfileBounds}
+    (hadm : P.Admissible) (hB : B.Holds P) (hf0 : ∀ a : R2, 1 < ‖a‖ → P.fBump a = 0) (kk : ℕ) :
+    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun a : R2 => P.fBump (D.ell⁻¹ • a)) ∧
+    (∀ a : R2, D.ell < ‖a‖ → P.fBump (D.ell⁻¹ • a) = 0) ∧
+    (∀ u : List (Fin 2), u.length ≤ kk → ∀ a : R2, ‖a‖ ≤ D.ell →
+      |iterA u (fun a : R2 => P.fBump (D.ell⁻¹ • a)) a| ≤ runMax B.fN kk * D.ell⁻¹ ^ u.length) := by
+  have hf := hadm.fBump_smooth
+  have hfb := hB.2.2.2.1
+  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := Lemma54W0Aux.rescaled_profile (D := D) (fb := B.fN) hf hf0
+    (fun u a _ => (Lemma54W0Aux.abs_iterA_le_norm_iteratedFDeriv hf u a).trans (hfb u.length a))
+  refine ⟨h1, h2, fun u hu a ha => (h3 u a ha).trans ?_⟩
+  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_runMax B.fN hu) (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 D.ell_pos.le) _)
+
+theorem cr_rows_good {D : CascadeClasses.Frame} {L : LayerCoeffs} {M Minv : ℝ → Mat2}
+    {ζ G : ℝ → R2} {w Θ Ωh PΘ PΩ F : ℝ → ℝ} {f : R2 → ℝ} {ah bh : ℝ → ℝ} {J : ℕ} {Y : ℕ → LevelPair}
+    (hset : LevelSetting D L M Minv ζ G w Θ Ωh PΘ PΩ F f ah bh J Y) :
+    Lem55OpsAux.Good D (SthetaRamp L Y) ∧ Lem55OpsAux.Good D (SomegaRamp L Y) := by
+  have hL := Lem55OpsAux.coeffsOK_of_setting hset
+  have hY := Lem55OpsAux.niceFamily_trunc hset
+  rw [← Lem55OpsAux.SthetaRamp_truncLv L Y (Nat.succ_pos J),
+    ← Lem55OpsAux.SomegaRamp_truncLv L Y (Nat.succ_pos J)]
+  have hV := (hY 0).1
+  have hΨ := Lem55OpsAux.Good.PsiLv hL hY 0
+  have hc1 := hL.2.2.2.1
+  have hc2 := hL.2.2.2.2
+  have hkap := hL.1
+  constructor
+  · have h := (hV.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.t.vec).add
+      ((Lem55OpsAux.Good.tcoef_mul hc1 (hΨ.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec)).const_mul L.N)
+    have hfun : SthetaRamp L (truncLv Y (J + 1)) = fun x =>
+        Framework.Cascade.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.t.vec (lvV (truncLv Y (J + 1)) 0) x
+        + L.N * (L.c1 x.1 * Framework.Cascade.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec
+            (PsiLv L (truncLv Y (J + 1)) 0) x) := by
+      funext x
+      show CascadeClasses.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.t.vec (lvV (truncLv Y (J + 1)) 0) x
+        + L.N * L.c1 x.1 * CascadeClasses.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec
+            (PsiLv L (truncLv Y (J + 1)) 0) x = _
+      rw [mul_assoc]; rfl
+    rw [hfun]; exact h
+  · have hin := Lem55OpsAux.Good.tcoef_mul hkap ((hΨ.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec).dd
+      CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec)
+    have h := ((hin.const_mul (L.N ^ 2)).dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.t.vec).sub
+      ((Lem55OpsAux.Good.tcoef_mul hc2 (hV.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec)).const_mul L.N)
+    have hfun : SomegaRamp L (truncLv Y (J + 1)) = fun x =>
+        Framework.Cascade.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.t.vec (fun y => L.N ^ 2 * (L.kap y.1
+          * Framework.Cascade.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec (Framework.Cascade.dd
+              CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec (PsiLv L (truncLv Y (J + 1)) 0)) y)) x
+        - L.N * (L.c2 x.1 * Framework.Cascade.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec
+            (lvV (truncLv Y (J + 1)) 0) x) := by
+      funext x
+      show CascadeClasses.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.t.vec (fun y => L.N ^ 2 * L.kap y.1
+          * CascadeClasses.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec
+            (CascadeClasses.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec (PsiLv L (truncLv Y (J + 1)) 0)) y) x
+        - L.N * L.c2 x.1 * CascadeClasses.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec
+            (lvV (truncLv Y (J + 1)) 0) x = _
+      rw [mul_assoc]
+      have : (fun y : CascadeClasses.P3 => L.N ^ 2 * L.kap y.1
+          * CascadeClasses.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec
+            (CascadeClasses.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec (PsiLv L (truncLv Y (J + 1)) 0)) y)
+          = fun y => L.N ^ 2 * (L.kap y.1 * CascadeClasses.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec
+            (CascadeClasses.dd CascadeClasses.Ltr.s.vec (PsiLv L (truncLv Y (J + 1)) 0)) y) := by
+        funext y; rw [mul_assoc]
+      rw [this]; rfl
+    rw [hfun]; exact h
+
+theorem cr_rows_offA {D : CascadeClasses.Frame} {L : LayerCoeffs} {M Minv : ℝ → Mat2}

+theorem ramp_rows_mem (W : LemmaSWindows) (Lc : CascadeLetters) (P : DesignParams)
+    (B : ProfileBounds) (ε N1 : ℝ) (k : ℕ → ℕ) (S : SkeletonReadout) (m : ℕ)
+    (Cb Cprime cj CRc : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (Θb Ψb : ℝ → R2 → ℝ) (LC : LevelTableCoeffs)
+    (rfrak : ℕ → ℝ) (L : LayerCoeffs) (Minv : ℝ → Mat2) (ah bh : ℝ → ℝ)
+    (Sc : CascadeClasses.Scales) (Y : ℕ → LevelPair)
+    (hhyp :
+      cascadeLemma_hyp W Lc P B ε N1 k S m Cb Cprime cj CRc K Θb Ψb LC rfrak L Minv ah bh Sc Y)
+    (kk : ℕ) (hkk : kk ≤ k m) :
+    CascadeClasses.YMem Sc.toFrame (fun _ => 1)
+        (rampThetaConst ε B Cprime kk * (Sc.N ^ (-((k m : ℕ) : ℝ) - 6) * Sc.toFrame.piL)) kk
+        (SthetaRamp L Y) ∧
+    CascadeClasses.YMem Sc.toFrame (fun _ => 1)
+        (rampOmegaConst ε B Cprime kk * (Sc.N ^ (-((k m : ℕ) : ℝ) - 5) * Sc.toFrame.piL)) kk
+        (SomegaRamp L Y) := by
+  obtain ⟨hcasc, -, hSc, hpins, -, hset⟩ := hhyp
+  have hbase := hcasc.1
+  have hSc' := hSc
+  obtain ⟨⟨ht0, htin, hT, hell, hpi, -⟩, hN, hσ, -, -⟩ := hSc'
+  obtain ⟨hLN, hLσ, -, -⟩ := hpins
+  have hdata := hset.data
+  obtain ⟨hadm, hB⟩ := hbase.h1
+  have hkR : kk + 1 ≤ rStar k m := by show kk + 1 ≤ 9 * k m + 41; omega
+  have hI : Sc.toFw.toFrame.I = S.Iwin m := by
+    show Ico Sc.tin Sc.Tstar = Ico (S.tIn m) S.Tstar; rw [htin, hT]
+  have hPg : 0 ≤ gaugePi P N1 m := (inv_pos.2 hbase.ell_pos).le.trans hbase.h0p.ellInv_le
+  have hpi' : Sc.toFw.piL = gaugePi P N1 m := hpi
+  have hNpos : 0 < Sc.N := zero_lt_one.trans Sc.one_lt_N
+
+  obtain ⟨⟨hθs, hθ0, hθI⟩, ⟨hωs, hω0, hωI⟩⟩ := cr_factors hbase hSc hset
+  obtain ⟨hθb, hθz⟩ := cr_factor_bounds hbase hSc 0 hθs hθI hkR
+  obtain ⟨hωb, hωz⟩ := cr_factor_bounds hbase hSc 1 hωs hωI hkR
+
+  obtain ⟨⟨hF, hFper, hFb⟩, ⟨hdF, hdFper, hdFb⟩⟩ := cr_profileF hadm hB kk
+  obtain ⟨hg, hgs, hgb⟩ := cr_profileG Sc.toFw.toFrame hadm hB hdata.f_zero kk
+
+  have hKnn : 0 ≤ 2 ^ kk * runMax B.etaN (kk + 1) * runMax Cprime kk * rampY0Const ε
+      * Sc.N ^ (-((k m : ℕ) : ℝ) - 6) := by
+    have := runMax_nonneg B.etaN (kk + 1); have := runMax_nonneg Cprime kk
+    have := rampY0Const_nonneg ε
+    have : 0 ≤ Sc.N ^ (-((k m : ℕ) : ℝ) - 6) := Real.rpow_nonneg hNpos.le _
+    positivity
+  have hFnn := runMax_nonneg B.FN kk
+  have hdFnn := runMax_nonneg B.FN (kk + 1)
+
+  have hqθ := CascIIIRampAux.casc_iii_ramp_mem Sc.toFw (rampWin P N1 k S m)
+    (amp := fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (Aamp := 1) hKnn zero_le_one hFnn hθs hθ0 contDiffOn_const hθb hθz
+    (fun j _ t _ _ => by
+      have := cr_iteratedDeriv_const_le (1 : ℝ) Sc.toFw.toFrame.one_le_piL j t
+      rwa [abs_one] at this)
+    hF hFper hFb hg hgs hgb
+  have hqω := CascIIIRampAux.casc_iii_ramp_mem Sc.toFw (rampWin P N1 k S m)
+    (amp := fun _ => L.N / L.sigma) (Aamp := |L.N / L.sigma|) hKnn (abs_nonneg _) hdFnn hωs hω0
+    contDiffOn_const hωb hωz
+    (fun j _ t _ _ => cr_iteratedDeriv_const_le _ Sc.toFw.toFrame.one_le_piL j t)
+    hdF hdFper hdFb hg hgs hgb
+
+  obtain ⟨hgθ, hgω⟩ := cr_rows_good hset
+  obtain ⟨hoθ, hoω⟩ := cr_rows_offA hset
+  have hslab_eq : ∀ z ∈ Sc.toFrame.slab,
+      (SthetaRamp L Y z = cTheta P N1 k S m ah z.1 * (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) z.1 * P.F z.2.1
+          * P.fBump (Sc.toFw.toFrame.ell⁻¹ • z.2.2)) ∧
+      (SomegaRamp L Y z = cOmega P N1 k S m bh z.1 * (fun _ : ℝ => L.N / L.sigma) z.1
+          * deriv P.F z.2.1 * P.fBump (Sc.toFw.toFrame.ell⁻¹ • z.2.2)) := by
+    intro z hz
+    rcases lt_or_ge z.1 Sc.toFrame.tin with hlt | hge
+    · rw [hgθ.early z hlt.le, hgω.early z hlt.le, hθ0 z.1 hlt.le, hω0 z.1 hlt.le]; simp
+    · have hzI : z.1 ∈ Sc.toFrame.I := ⟨hge, hz.2⟩
+      have hzIw : z.1 ∈ S.Iwin m := hI ▸ hzI
+      rw [Lem55CoreAux.ramp_theta hset hz hzI, Lem55CoreAux.ramp_omega hset hz hzI,
+        hθI z.1 hzIw, hωI z.1 hzIw, LevelZeroInputsAux.Ytop_apply0_lz,
+        LevelZeroInputsAux.Ytop_apply1_lz, show Sc.toFw.toFrame.ell = Sc.toFrame.ell from rfl]
+      constructor
+      · simp only [gLift]; ring
+      · simp only [gLift]; ring
+  have ht0lt : ∀ x : CascadeClasses.P3, x.1 ∈ Sc.toFrame.I → x ∈ Sc.toFrame.slab :=
+    fun x hx => ⟨Sc.toFrame.t0_lt_tin.trans_le hx.1, hx.2⟩
+
+  have hYθ : YMem Sc.toFrame.toFw (fun _ => 1) _ kk (SthetaRamp L Y) :=
+    ⟨⟨hgθ.smooth, hgθ.periodic, fun w hw x hxI hxa => by
+      rw [Framework.Cascade.iter_congr Sc.toFrame.toFw.isOpen_slab
+        (fun z hz => (hslab_eq z hz).1) w (ht0lt x hxI)]

+  by_cases hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x
+  · rw [show (fun y => f y + g y) = f + g from rfl, fderiv_add hf hg.differentiableAt, hg.fderiv,
+      add_zero]
+  · have hfg : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => f y + g y) x := by
+      intro h
+      have : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (f y + g y) - g y) x := h.sub hg.differentiableAt
+      simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] at this
+      exact hf this

+        h.sub hg.differentiableWithinAt
+      simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] at this

+      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun τ => by simp [real_inner_comm])) (by simp [real_inner_comm])

+theorem casc_i_own_DeltaNMAt_expand (N : ℝ) (Minv : Mat2) (p : R2) (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ)
+    (q : ℝ × ℝ × R2) :
+    TwoScale.DeltaNMAt N Minv p Ψ q
+      = N ^ 2 * TwoScale.kappaOf Minv p * TwoScale.dS (TwoScale.dS Ψ) q
+        + N * (2 * ∑ k : Fin 2, (TwoScale.metricC Minv p) k * TwoScale.dA k (TwoScale.dS Ψ) q)
+        + ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2,
+            (TwoScale.metricC Minv (e l)) k * TwoScale.dA k (TwoScale.dA l Ψ) q := by
+  simp only [TwoScale.DeltaNMAt, TwoScale.D1At, TwoScale.DeltaMAt]
+
+theorem casc_i_own_DeltaNM_comp_flat_time (N : ℝ) (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ) (kap : ℝ → ℝ)
+    (cp : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (Cm : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ × R2) {s : Set ℝ} {t : ℝ}
+    (hkap : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ kap s t) (hcp : ∀ k, DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ (cp k) s t)
+    (hCm : ∀ k l, DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ (Cm k l) s t) (hc : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ c s t)
+    (hflat : ∀ u u' : ℝ × ℝ × R2, TwoScale.dd u (TwoScale.dd u' Ψ) (c t) = 0 ∧
+      HasFDerivAt (TwoScale.dd u (TwoScale.dd u' Ψ)) (0 : ℝ × ℝ × R2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c t)) :
+    HasDerivWithinAt (fun τ =>
+      N ^ 2 * kap τ * TwoScale.dS (TwoScale.dS Ψ) (c τ)
+        + N * (2 * ∑ k : Fin 2, cp k τ * TwoScale.dA k (TwoScale.dS Ψ) (c τ))
+        + ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, Cm k l τ * TwoScale.dA k (TwoScale.dA l Ψ) (c τ)) 0 s t := by
+  have term : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (u u' : ℝ × ℝ × R2), DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ f s t →
+      HasDerivWithinAt (fun τ => f τ * TwoScale.dd u (TwoScale.dd u' Ψ) (c τ)) 0 s t :=
+    fun f u u' hf => casc_i_own_mul_flat hf (casc_i_own_comp_flat_time hc (hflat u u').2)
+      (hflat u u').1
+  simp only [TwoScale.dS, TwoScale.dA, Fin.sum_univ_two]
+  have h1 := (term kap TwoScale.dirS TwoScale.dirS hkap).const_mul (N ^ 2)
+  have h2 := (((term (cp 0) (TwoScale.dirA (e 0)) TwoScale.dirS (hcp 0)).add
+    (term (cp 1) (TwoScale.dirA (e 1)) TwoScale.dirS (hcp 1))).const_mul 2).const_mul N
+  have h3 := ((term (Cm 0 0) (TwoScale.dirA (e 0)) (TwoScale.dirA (e 0)) (hCm 0 0)).add
+    (term (Cm 0 1) (TwoScale.dirA (e 0)) (TwoScale.dirA (e 1)) (hCm 0 1))).add
+    ((term (Cm 1 0) (TwoScale.dirA (e 1)) (TwoScale.dirA (e 0)) (hCm 1 0)).add
+    (term (Cm 1 1) (TwoScale.dirA (e 1)) (TwoScale.dirA (e 1)) (hCm 1 1)))
+  have key := (h1.add h2).add h3
+  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at key
+  refine key.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun τ => ?_)) ?_
+  · show _ = _; simp only [Pi.add_apply]; ring
+  · simp only [Pi.add_apply]; ring
+
+theorem casc_i_own_DeltaNM_flat_space (N : ℝ) (ζ : ℝ → R2) (Minv : ℝ → Mat2) (Mc : Mat2)
+    (p : R2) (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : R2)
+    (hflat : ∀ u u' : ℝ × ℝ × R2, HasFDerivAt (TwoScale.dd u (TwoScale.dd u' Ψ))
+      (0 : ℝ × ℝ × R2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (t, N * inner ℝ (ζ t) x, Minv t x)) :
+    HasFDerivAt (fun y => TwoScale.DeltaNMAt N Mc p Ψ (t, N * inner ℝ (ζ t) y, Minv t y))
+      (0 : R2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x := by
+  have term : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u u' : ℝ × ℝ × R2), HasFDerivAt
+      (fun y => a * TwoScale.dd u (TwoScale.dd u' Ψ) (t, N * inner ℝ (ζ t) y, Minv t y))
+      (0 : R2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x := by
+    intro a u u'
+    have := (casc_i_own_natural_flat_space N ζ Minv (TwoScale.dd u (TwoScale.dd u' Ψ)) t x
+      (hflat u u')).const_mul a
+    simpa [TwoScale.natural] using this
+  simp only [casc_i_own_DeltaNMAt_expand, TwoScale.dS, TwoScale.dA, Fin.sum_univ_two]
+  have h1 := term (N ^ 2 * TwoScale.kappaOf Mc p) TwoScale.dirS TwoScale.dirS
+  have h2 := ((term ((TwoScale.metricC Mc p) 0) (TwoScale.dirA (e 0)) TwoScale.dirS).add
+    (term ((TwoScale.metricC Mc p) 1) (TwoScale.dirA (e 1)) TwoScale.dirS))
+  have h3 := ((term ((TwoScale.metricC Mc (e 0)) 0) (TwoScale.dirA (e 0)) (TwoScale.dirA (e 0))).add
+    (term ((TwoScale.metricC Mc (e 1)) 0) (TwoScale.dirA (e 0)) (TwoScale.dirA (e 1)))).add
+    ((term ((TwoScale.metricC Mc (e 0)) 1) (TwoScale.dirA (e 1)) (TwoScale.dirA (e 0))).add
+    (term ((TwoScale.metricC Mc (e 1)) 1) (TwoScale.dirA (e 1)) (TwoScale.dirA (e 1))))
+  have key := (h1.add ((h2.const_mul 2).const_mul N)).add h3
+  simp only [add_zero, smul_zero] at key
+  refine key.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
+  show _ = _
+  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
+
+theorem casc_i_own_hasDerivWithinAt_Ici0_of_lifespan {g : ℝ → ℝ} {tIn Tstar t : ℝ}
+    (ht : t ∈ Ico tIn Tstar) (hg : HasDerivWithinAt g 0 (Ico tIn Tstar) t)
+    (hl : t = tIn → ∀ τ, τ ≤ t → g τ = 0) : HasDerivWithinAt g 0 (Ici 0) t := by
+  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht.1 with heq | hlt
+  ·
+    have hl' := hl heq.symm
+    subst heq
+    have hmem : Ico tIn Tstar ∈ 𝓝[Ici tIn] tIn :=
+      mem_nhdsWithin.mpr ⟨Iio Tstar, isOpen_Iio, ht.2, fun τ hτ => ⟨hτ.2, hτ.1⟩⟩
+    exact casc_i_own_hasDerivWithinAt_Ici0_of_sides g tIn hl' (hg.mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin hmem)
+  ·
+    have hmem : Ico tIn Tstar ∈ 𝓝 t :=
+      mem_nhds_iff.mpr ⟨Ioo tIn Tstar, Ioo_subset_Ico_self, isOpen_Ioo, ⟨hlt, ht.2⟩⟩
+    exact (hg.hasDerivAt hmem).hasDerivWithinAt
+

+theorem casc_i_own_c_theta (Nf : ℝ) (ζ : ℝ → R2) (Mi Mm : ℝ → Mat2) (p : R2) (G : ℝ → R2)

+    (hflatV : HasFDerivAt Vs (0 : ℝ × ℝ × R2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (t, Nf * inner ℝ (ζ t) x, Mi t x))
+    (hflatP : HasFDerivAt Ps (0 : ℝ × ℝ × R2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (t, Nf * inner ℝ (ζ t) x, Mi t x)) :

+          (fun τ y => TwoScale.natural Nf ζ Mi Ps (τ, y)) t x := by
+
+  have hL : TwoScale.natural Nf ζ Mi (Planar.Etheta Nf Mm Mi p G Vs Ps) (t, x) = 0 :=

+    (casc_i_own_natural_flat_space Nf ζ Mi Vs t x hflatV)

+    (hflatV : HasFDerivAt Vs (0 : ℝ × ℝ × R2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (t, Nf * inner ℝ (ζ t) x, Mi t x))
+    (hflatP : HasFDerivAt Ps (0 : ℝ × ℝ × R2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (t, Nf * inner ℝ (ζ t) x, Mi t x))

+      TwoScale.dd u (TwoScale.dd u' Ps) (t, Nf * inner ℝ (ζ t) x, Mi t x) = 0 ∧

+  have hslab : IsOpen {z : ℝ × ℝ × R2 | 0 < z.1 ∧ z.1 < Tstar} :=

+
+  have hL : TwoScale.natural Nf ζ Mi (Planar.Eomega Nf Mi p Vs Ps) (t, x) = 0 :=
+    casc_i_own_Eomega_eq_zero Nf Mi p Vs Ps _ hflatV.fderiv hflatP.fderiv hΔfd

+  set ψ : ℝ → R2 → ℝ := fun τ y => TwoScale.natural Nf ζ Mi Ps (τ, y) with hψ

+  have hψ0 : ∀ τ, τ ≤ tIn → ∀ y, ψ τ y = 0 := fun τ hτ y => hearly _ hτ
+
+  have hI3' : ∀ τ ∈ Ico tIn Tstar, ∀ y : R2,

+    intro τ hτ y
+    have hfun : ψ τ = fun y' => TwoScale.natural Nf (fun _ => TwoScale.covec (Mi τ) p)
+        (fun _ => Mi τ) Ps (τ, y') := by
+      funext y'; simp [hψ, TwoScale.natural, hzeta τ hτ]
+    rw [hfun, hzeta τ hτ]
+    exact hI3 (Mm τ) (Mi τ) p Nf _ Ps τ y ⟨hinv τ hτ, hdet τ hτ, hslab, htpos τ hτ⟩
+      (hPs.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top))
+
+  have hadd : ∀ τ ∈ Ico tIn Tstar, ∀ y : R2, (∃ O : Set R2, IsOpen O ∧ y ∈ O ∧
+      ContDiffOn ℝ 3 (Ψb τ) O) →
+      Δ (fun y' => Ψb τ y' + ψ τ y') y - Δ (Ψb τ) y = Δ (ψ τ) y := by
+    intro τ hτ y ⟨O, hO, hyO, hC⟩

+    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (ψ τ) y := casc_i_own_natural_contDiffAt Nf ζ Mi hPs (htpos τ hτ) y
+    rw [show (fun y' => Ψb τ y' + ψ τ y') = Ψb τ + ψ τ from rfl, h1.laplacian_add h2]
+    ring

+  set G : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => TwoScale.DeltaNMAt Nf (Mi τ) p Ps (τ, Nf * inner ℝ (ζ τ) x, Mi τ x)
+    with hG
+  have hGearly : ∀ τ, τ ≤ tIn → G τ = 0 :=
+    fun τ hτ => casc_i_own_DeltaNMAt_early hearly Nf (Mi τ) p _ hτ
+  have hgG : ∀ τ ∈ Ico 0 Tstar, Δ (fun y' => Ψb τ y' + ψ τ y') x - Δ (Ψb τ) x = G τ := by
+    intro τ hτ

+    · have : (fun y' => Ψb τ y' + ψ τ y') = Ψb τ := by

+      rw [hadd τ ⟨hge, hτ.2⟩ x ⟨O, hO, hxO, hC⟩, hI3' τ ⟨hge, hτ.2⟩ x]

+  have hGI : HasDerivWithinAt G 0 (Ico tIn Tstar) t := by
+    have hc := casc_i_own_lift_differentiableWithinAt Nf ζ Mi x hζ hMi
+    have hE := casc_i_own_DeltaNM_comp_flat_time Nf Ps kap cp Cm
+      (fun τ => ((τ, Nf * inner ℝ (ζ τ) x, Mi τ x) : ℝ × ℝ × R2)) hkapd hcpd hCmd hc hflat2
+    refine hE.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.eventually_of_mem self_mem_nhdsWithin

+def cb_RowNonneg (row : TableRow) : Prop := ∀ r, 0 ≤ row.C r ∧ 0 ≤ row.Cp r ∧ 0 ≤ row.S r
+
+theorem cb_zeroRow_nonneg : cb_RowNonneg TableRow.zeroRow := fun _ => ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, le_rfl⟩
+
+theorem cb_getD_nonneg {rows : List TableRow} (h : ∀ row ∈ rows, cb_RowNonneg row) (i : ℕ) :
+    cb_RowNonneg (rows.getD i TableRow.zeroRow) := by
+  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
+  cases hi : rows[i]? with
+  | none => exact cb_zeroRow_nonneg
+  | some row => exact h row (List.mem_of_getElem? hi)
+
+theorem cb_rowBack_nonneg {rows : List TableRow} (h : ∀ row ∈ rows, cb_RowNonneg row) (j : ℕ) :
+    cb_RowNonneg (LevelTableCoeffs.rowBack rows j) := by
+  unfold LevelTableCoeffs.rowBack
+  split_ifs
+  · exact cb_getD_nonneg h _
+  · exact cb_zeroRow_nonneg
+
+theorem cb_rowNext_nonneg {LC : LevelTableCoeffs} (hLC : LC.coeffsNonneg) {rows : List TableRow}
+    (h : ∀ row ∈ rows, cb_RowNonneg row) : cb_RowNonneg (LC.rowNext rows) := by
+  obtain ⟨-, hcp, hcs, hD⟩ := hLC
+  have hg := fun i => cb_getD_nonneg h i
+  have hb := fun j => cb_rowBack_nonneg h j
+  have hS : ∀ r, 0 ≤ (LC.rowNext rows).S r := by
+    intro r
+    show 0 ≤ LC.csfrak r * _
+    refine mul_nonneg (hcs r) (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (add_nonneg ((hb 1) _).1 ((hb 2) _).1) ?_) ?_)
+    · exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg ((hg i) _).1
+        (add_nonneg ((hg _) _).1 ((hg _) _).2.1))
+    · exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg ((hg i) _).1
+        (add_nonneg ((hg _) _).1 ((hg _) _).2.1))
+  intro r
+  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hS r⟩
+  · show 0 ≤ 4 * LC.Dcoef r * (LC.rowNext rows).S r
+    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hD r)) (hS r)
+  · show 0 ≤ LC.cprime r * _
+    exact mul_nonneg (hcp r) (add_nonneg ((hb 1) _).1 ((hb 2) _).1)
+
+theorem cb_tableRows_nonneg {LC : LevelTableCoeffs} (hLC : LC.coeffsNonneg) :
+    ∀ n, ∀ row ∈ LC.tableRows n, cb_RowNonneg row := by
+  intro n
+  induction n with
+  | zero =>
+    intro row hrow
+    have : row = LC.rowZero := by simpa [LevelTableCoeffs.tableRows] using hrow
+    subst this
+    exact fun r => ⟨hLC.1 r, le_rfl, le_rfl⟩
+  | succ n ih =>
+    intro row hrow
+    rw [LevelTableCoeffs.tableRows, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hrow
+    rcases hrow with h | rfl
+    · exact ih row h
+    · exact cb_rowNext_nonneg hLC ih
+
+theorem cb_table_nonneg {LC : LevelTableCoeffs} (hLC : LC.coeffsNonneg) (n r : ℕ) :
+    0 ≤ LC.calC n r ∧ 0 ≤ LC.calCp n r ∧ 0 ≤ LC.frakS n r :=
+  cb_getD_nonneg (cb_tableRows_nonneg hLC n) n r
+

+theorem jp_of_biParity {ε ε' : ℝ} {Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : Cascade.BiParity ε ε' Φ) :
+    Framework.Cascade.HasParity jNegL (ε * ε') Φ := by
+  intro x
+  show Φ (x.1, -x.2.1, -x.2.2) = (ε * ε') • Φ x
+  have h1 := h.1 (x.1, x.2.1, -x.2.2)
+  have h2 := h.2 x
+  simp only at h1
+  rw [h1, h2, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

+theorem jp_fsum {ε : ℝ} {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ}

+    Framework.Cascade.HasParity jNegL ε (fun z => ∑ i ∈ s, f i z) := by
+  intro x
+  show ∑ i ∈ s, f i (jNegL x) = ε • ∑ i ∈ s, f i x
+  rw [smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
+  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => by rw [h i hi x, smul_eq_mul])

+theorem earlyT_Eomega {tin : ℝ} {V Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (hV : earlyT tin V) (hΨ : earlyT tin Ψ)
+    (N : ℝ) (Minv : ℝ → Mat2) (p : R2) : earlyT tin (Planar.Eomega N Minv p V Ψ) := by
+  have hZ := earlyT_DeltaNMAt hΨ N Minv p
+  intro z hz
+  show dT (fun ζ' => DeltaNMAt N (Minv ζ'.1) p Ψ ζ') z
+      + brN N p Ψ (fun ζ' => DeltaNMAt N (Minv ζ'.1) p Ψ ζ') z
+      - N * (covec (Minv z.1) p) 0 * dS V z
+      - ∑ k : Fin 2, (eTilde (Minv z.1) 0) k * dA k V z = 0
+  rw [earlyT_dT hZ z hz, earlyT_brN hΨ hZ N p z hz, earlyT_dS hV z hz,
+    Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k _ => by rw [earlyT_dA hV k z hz, mul_zero])]
+  ring
+
+theorem earlyT_sumUpTo {tin : ℝ} {J : ℕ} {V : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ}
+    (h : ∀ n, n ≤ J → earlyT tin (V n)) : earlyT tin (Fields.sumUpTo J V) :=
+  earlyT_fsum _ (fun n hn => h n (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hn)))
+
+theorem natural_eq_zero_of_earlyT {tin : ℝ} {Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : earlyT tin Φ) (N : ℝ)
+    (ζ : ℝ → R2) (Minv : ℝ → Mat2) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ tin) (x : R2) :
+    natural N ζ Minv Φ (t, x) = 0 :=
+  h _ ht
+
+theorem Rc_zero (φ₀ : R2 → ℝ) (x : R2) : Planar.Rc φ₀ (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x = 0 := by
+  unfold Planar.Rc Planar.bogB Mat2.perp
+  simp
+
+def offA (ℓ : ℝ) (Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ) : Prop := ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ × R2, ℓ < ‖z.2.2‖ → Φ z = 0
+
+theorem isOpen_offA (ℓ : ℝ) : IsOpen {z : ℝ × ℝ × R2 | ℓ < ‖z.2.2‖} :=
+  isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_norm.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd))
+
+theorem offA_zero (ℓ : ℝ) : offA ℓ (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := fun _ _ => rfl
+
+theorem offA_add {ℓ : ℝ} {Φ Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ Φ) (h' : offA ℓ Ψ) :
+    offA ℓ (fun z => Φ z + Ψ z) := fun z hz => by simp [h z hz, h' z hz]
+
+theorem offA_sub {ℓ : ℝ} {Φ Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ Φ) (h' : offA ℓ Ψ) :
+    offA ℓ (fun z => Φ z - Ψ z) := fun z hz => by simp [h z hz, h' z hz]
+
+theorem offA_neg {ℓ : ℝ} {Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ Φ) : offA ℓ (fun z => -Φ z) :=
+  fun z hz => by simp [h z hz]
+
+theorem offA_mul_left {ℓ : ℝ} {Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ Φ) (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ) :
+    offA ℓ (fun z => Φ z * Ψ z) := fun z hz => by simp [h z hz]
+
+theorem offA_mul_right {ℓ : ℝ} {Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ Ψ) (Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ) :
+    offA ℓ (fun z => Φ z * Ψ z) := fun z hz => by simp [h z hz]
+
+theorem offA_fsum {ℓ : ℝ} {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ}
+    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, offA ℓ (f i)) : offA ℓ (fun z => ∑ i ∈ s, f i z) :=
+  fun z hz => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i hi => h i hi z hz)
+
+theorem offA_dd {ℓ : ℝ} {Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ Φ) (v : ℝ × ℝ × R2) :
+    offA ℓ (dd v Φ) := by
+  intro z hz
+  have hev : Φ =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
+    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_offA ℓ).mem_nhds hz) (fun y hy => h y hy)
+  show fderiv ℝ Φ z v = 0
+  rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
+  simp
+
+theorem offA_dT {ℓ : ℝ} {Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ Φ) : offA ℓ (dT Φ) := offA_dd h _
+
+theorem offA_dS {ℓ : ℝ} {Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ Φ) : offA ℓ (dS Φ) := offA_dd h _
+
+theorem offA_dA {ℓ : ℝ} {Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ Φ) (k : Fin 2) : offA ℓ (dA k Φ) :=
+  offA_dd h _
+
+theorem offA_dperpAt {ℓ : ℝ} {Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ Φ) (p : R2) :
+    offA ℓ (dperpAt p Φ) := offA_dd h _
+
+theorem offA_JsAt {ℓ : ℝ} {Ψ Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (hΨ : offA ℓ Ψ) (hΦ : offA ℓ Φ) (p : R2) :
+    offA ℓ (JsAt p Ψ Φ) :=
+  offA_sub (offA_mul_left (offA_dd hΨ _) _) (offA_mul_left (offA_dd hΦ _) _)
+
+theorem offA_brAAt {ℓ : ℝ} {Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (hΨ : offA ℓ Ψ) (Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ) :
+    offA ℓ (brAAt Ψ Φ) :=
+  offA_add (offA_neg (offA_mul_left (offA_dd hΨ _) _)) (offA_mul_left (offA_dd hΨ _) _)
+
+theorem offA_brN {ℓ : ℝ} {Ψ Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (hΨ : offA ℓ Ψ) (hΦ : offA ℓ Φ) (N : ℝ)
+    (p : R2) : offA ℓ (brN N p Ψ Φ) :=
+  offA_add (offA_mul_right (offA_JsAt hΨ hΦ p) _) (offA_brAAt hΨ Φ)
+
+theorem offA_D1At {ℓ : ℝ} {Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ Ψ) (Minv : Mat2) (p : R2) :
+    offA ℓ (D1At Minv p Ψ) :=
+  offA_mul_right (offA_fsum _ (fun _ _ => offA_mul_right (offA_dd (offA_dd h _) _) _)) _
+
+theorem offA_DeltaMAt {ℓ : ℝ} {Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ Ψ) (Minv : Mat2) :
+    offA ℓ (DeltaMAt Minv Ψ) :=
+  offA_fsum _ (fun _ _ => offA_fsum _ (fun _ _ => offA_mul_right (offA_dd (offA_dd h _) _) _))
+
+theorem offA_DeltaNMAt {ℓ : ℝ} {Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ Ψ) (N : ℝ) (Minv : ℝ → Mat2)
+    (p : R2) : offA ℓ (fun z => DeltaNMAt N (Minv z.1) p Ψ z) := by
+  intro z hz
+  show N ^ 2 * kappaOf (Minv z.1) p * dS (dS Ψ) z + N * D1At (Minv z.1) p Ψ z
+      + DeltaMAt (Minv z.1) Ψ z = 0
+  rw [offA_dS (offA_dS h) z hz, offA_D1At h _ _ z hz, offA_DeltaMAt h _ z hz]
+  ring
+
+theorem offA_Etheta {ℓ : ℝ} {V Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (hV : offA ℓ V) (hΨ : offA ℓ Ψ) (N : ℝ)
+    (M Minv : ℝ → Mat2) (p : R2) (G : ℝ → R2) :
+    offA ℓ (Planar.Etheta N M Minv p G V Ψ) := by
+  intro z hz
+  show dT V z + N * inner ℝ (Mat2.perp (covec (Minv z.1) p)) (G z.1) * dS Ψ z
+      + (-(dA 1 Ψ z) * (gTilde (M z.1) (G z.1)) 0 + dA 0 Ψ z * (gTilde (M z.1) (G z.1)) 1)
+      + brN N p Ψ V z = 0
+  rw [offA_dT hV z hz, offA_dS hΨ z hz, offA_dA hΨ 1 z hz, offA_dA hΨ 0 z hz,
+    offA_brN hΨ hV N p z hz]
+  ring
+
+theorem offA_Eomega {ℓ : ℝ} {V Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (hV : offA ℓ V) (hΨ : offA ℓ Ψ) (N : ℝ)
+    (Minv : ℝ → Mat2) (p : R2) : offA ℓ (Planar.Eomega N Minv p V Ψ) := by
+  have hZ := offA_DeltaNMAt hΨ N Minv p
+  intro z hz
+  show dT (fun ζ' => DeltaNMAt N (Minv ζ'.1) p Ψ ζ') z
+      + brN N p Ψ (fun ζ' => DeltaNMAt N (Minv ζ'.1) p Ψ ζ') z
+      - N * (covec (Minv z.1) p) 0 * dS V z
+      - ∑ k : Fin 2, (eTilde (Minv z.1) 0) k * dA k V z = 0
+  rw [offA_dT hZ z hz, offA_brN hΨ hZ N p z hz, offA_dS hV z hz,
+    Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k _ => by rw [offA_dA hV k z hz, mul_zero])]
+  ring
+
+theorem offA_sumUpTo {ℓ : ℝ} {J : ℕ} {V : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ}
+    (h : ∀ n, n ≤ J → offA ℓ (V n)) : offA ℓ (Fields.sumUpTo J V) :=
+  offA_fsum _ (fun n hn => h n (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hn)))
+
+theorem natural_eq_zero_off_tube {ℓ : ℝ} {Φ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ Φ) (N : ℝ)
+    (ζ : ℝ → R2) (Minv : ℝ → Mat2) (t : ℝ) {x : R2} (hx : x ∉ tube (Minv t) ℓ) :
+    natural N ζ Minv Φ (t, x) = 0 :=
+  h _ (lt_of_not_ge hx)
+
+theorem isClosed_tube (Minv : Mat2) (ℓ : ℝ) : IsClosed (tube Minv ℓ) :=
+  isClosed_le (continuous_norm.comp Minv.continuous) continuous_const
+
+theorem tsupport_subset_tube {f : R2 → ℝ} {Minv : Mat2} {ℓ : ℝ}
+    (h : ∀ x, x ∉ tube Minv ℓ → f x = 0) : tsupport f ⊆ tube Minv ℓ :=
+  closure_minimal (fun x hx => by_contra fun hxt => hx (h x hxt)) (isClosed_tube Minv ℓ)
+
+section Levels
+open AffineCore.CascadeClasses AffineCore.Cascade
+
+theorem offA_lv_sAnti {ℓ : ℝ} {φ : P3 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ φ) : offA ℓ (sAnti φ) :=
+  fun x hx => Framework.Cascade.sAnti_eq_zero_of (fun σ => h (sAt x σ) hx)
+
+theorem offA_lv_smean {ℓ : ℝ} {φ : P3 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ φ) : offA ℓ (smean φ) :=
+  fun x hx => Framework.Cascade.smean_eq_zero_of (fun σ => h (sAt x σ) hx)
+
+theorem offA_lv_Pne {ℓ : ℝ} {φ : P3 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ φ) : offA ℓ (Pne φ) :=
+  fun x hx => by
+    show φ x - CascadeClasses.smean φ x = 0
+    rw [h x hx, offA_lv_smean h x hx, sub_zero]
+
+theorem offA_lv_Psi {ℓ : ℝ} (L : LayerCoeffs) {X : P3 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ X) : offA ℓ (Psi L X) :=
+  offA_mul_right (offA_mul_right (offA_lv_sAnti h) (fun y => L.kinv y.1))
+    (fun _ => (L.N * L.sigma)⁻¹)
+
+theorem offA_lv_D1 {ℓ : ℝ} (cp : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) {X : P3 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ X) : offA ℓ (D1 cp X) :=
+  offA_mul_right (offA_add (offA_mul_right (offA_dd (offA_dd h _) _) _)
+    (offA_mul_right (offA_dd (offA_dd h _) _) _)) _
+
+theorem offA_lv_DeltaM {ℓ : ℝ} (Cm : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) {X : P3 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ X) :
+    offA ℓ (DeltaM Cm X) :=
+  offA_fsum _ (fun _ _ => offA_fsum _ (fun _ _ => offA_mul_right (offA_dd (offA_dd h _) _) _))
+
+theorem offA_lv_Js {ℓ : ℝ} (p : R2) {X X' : P3 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ X) (h' : offA ℓ X') :
+    offA ℓ (Js p X X') :=
+  offA_sub (offA_mul_left (offA_dd h _) _) (offA_mul_left (offA_dd h' _) _)
+
+theorem offA_lv_brA {ℓ : ℝ} {X : P3 → ℝ} (h : offA ℓ X) (X' : P3 → ℝ) : offA ℓ (brA X X') :=
+  offA_add (offA_neg (offA_mul_left (offA_dd h _) _)) (offA_mul_left (offA_dd h _) _)
+
+theorem offA_lv_sources {ℓ : ℝ} (L : LayerCoeffs) {Y : ℕ → LevelPair} {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
+    (hY : ∀ j, j < n → offA ℓ (lvV Y j) ∧ offA ℓ (lvW Y j)) :
+    offA ℓ (Stheta L Y n) ∧ offA ℓ (Stomega L Y n) := by
+  have hΨ : ∀ j, j < n → offA ℓ (PsiLv L Y j) := fun j hj => offA_lv_Psi L (hY j hj).2
+  have hZf : ∀ j, j < n → offA ℓ (Zflat L Y j) := fun j hj => by
+    match j, hj with
+    | 0, _ => exact offA_zero ℓ
+    | 1, hj => exact offA_mul_right (offA_lv_D1 L.cp (hΨ 0 (by omega))) _
+    | q + 2, hj =>
+      exact offA_add (offA_mul_right (offA_lv_D1 L.cp (hΨ (q + 1) (by omega))) _)
+        (offA_lv_DeltaM L.Cm (hΨ q (by omega)))
+  have hZq : ∀ j, j < n → offA ℓ (Zq L Y j) := fun j hj =>
+    offA_add (offA_mul_right (offA_dd (offA_dd (hΨ j hj) _) _) _) (hZf j hj)
+  have hlt : n - 1 < n := by omega
+  have hT1 : offA ℓ (termT1 L Y n) :=
+    offA_add (offA_mul_left (offA_neg (offA_dd (hΨ _ hlt) _)) _)
+      (offA_mul_left (offA_dd (hΨ _ hlt) _) _)
+  have hT2 : offA ℓ (termT2 L Y n) :=
+    offA_mul_right (offA_fsum _ (fun i hi =>
+      offA_lv_Js L.p (hΨ i (Finset.mem_range.1 hi)) (hY (n - 1 - i) (by omega)).1)) _
+  have hT3 : offA ℓ (termT3 L Y n) :=
+    offA_fsum _ (fun i hi => offA_lv_brA (hΨ i (by have := Finset.mem_range.1 hi; omega)) _)
+  have hU1 : offA ℓ (termU1 L Y n) := offA_dd (offA_mul_right (offA_lv_D1 L.cp (hΨ _ hlt)) _) _
+  have hU2 : offA ℓ (termU2 L Y n) := by
+    match n, hΨ with
+    | 0, _ => exact offA_zero ℓ
+    | 1, _ => exact offA_zero ℓ
+    | m + 2, hΨ => exact offA_dd (offA_lv_DeltaM L.Cm (hΨ m (by omega))) _
+  have hU3 : offA ℓ (termU3 L Y n) :=
+    offA_neg (offA_add (offA_mul_right (offA_dd (hY _ hlt).1 _) _)
+      (offA_mul_right (offA_dd (hY _ hlt).1 _) _))
+  have hU4 : offA ℓ (termU4 L Y n) :=
+    offA_mul_right (offA_fsum _ (fun i hi =>
+      offA_lv_Js L.p (hΨ i (Finset.mem_range.1 hi)) (hZq (n - 1 - i) (by omega)))) _
+  have hU5 : offA ℓ (termU5 L Y n) :=
+    offA_fsum _ (fun i hi => offA_lv_brA (hΨ i (by have := Finset.mem_range.1 hi; omega)) _)
+  have hSω : offA ℓ (Somega L Y n) := offA_add (offA_add (offA_add (offA_add hU1 hU2) hU3) hU4) hU5
+  exact ⟨offA_add (offA_add hT1 hT2) hT3, offA_mul_right hSω _⟩
+
+theorem offA_lv_level {D : Frame} {L : LayerCoeffs} {ah bh : ℝ → ℝ}
+    (hah : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ah D.cdom) (hbh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ bh D.cdom) {Y : ℕ → LevelPair} {n : ℕ}
+    (h : SolvesForced D ah bh (fPair L Y n) (yPair Y n)) (hθ : offA D.ell (fTheta L Y n))
+    (hω : offA D.ell (fOmega L Y n)) : offA D.ell (lvV Y n) ∧ offA D.ell (lvW Y n) := by
+  have hA : ContinuousOn (fun t => ampOp (ah t) (bh t)) D.toFw.cdom := by
+    rw [Lem53BridgeAux.lem_5_3_br_ampOp_fun_eq]
+    exact (Framework.Cascade.contDiffOn_ampMatrix hah hbh).continuousOn
+  have main : ∀ x : P3, D.ell < ‖x.2.2‖ → yPair Y n x = 0 := by
+    intro x hx
+    rcases le_or_gt x.1 D.tin with hle | hlt
+    · exact h.planted x hle
+    rcases le_or_gt D.Tstar x.1 with hge | hltT
+    · exact h.off x hge
+    have hb : x.1 < D.toFw.Tstar := hltT
+    have hsub : Icc D.tin x.1 ⊆ D.cdom :=
+      fun t ht => ⟨D.t0_lt_tin.trans_le ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt hltT⟩
+    have hg0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc D.tin x.1, fPair L Y n (t, x.2) = 0 := by
+      intro t _
+      show fTheta L Y n (t, x.2) • e 0 + fOmega L Y n (t, x.2) • e 1 = 0
+      rw [hθ (t, x.2) hx, hω (t, x.2) hx, zero_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]
+    have hz' : ∀ t ∈ Icc D.tin x.1, HasDerivAt (fun τ => yPair Y n (τ, x.2))
+        (ampOp (ah t) (bh t) (yPair Y n (t, x.2)) + fPair L Y n (t, x.2)) t :=
+      fun t ht => h.ode x.2.1 x.2.2 t (hsub ht)
+    have hw' : ∀ t ∈ Icc D.tin x.1, HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : R2))
+        (ampOp (ah t) (bh t) 0 + fPair L Y n (t, x.2)) t := by
+      intro t ht
+      rw [hg0 t ht, map_zero, add_zero]
+      exact hasDerivAt_const t 0
+    have heq := Framework.Cascade.amp_unique hA hb (fun t => fPair L Y n (t, x.2))
+      (fun t ht => (hz' t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
+      (fun t ht => (hw' t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
+      (fun t ht => hz' t (Ico_subset_Icc_self ht)) (fun t ht => hw' t (Ico_subset_Icc_self ht))
+      (by
+        show yPair Y n (D.tin, x.2) = 0
+        exact h.planted _ le_rfl)
+    exact heq ⟨hlt.le, le_rfl⟩
+  refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
+  · have := congrArg (fun v : R2 => v 0) (main x hx); simpa [yPair, e] using this
+  · have := congrArg (fun v : R2 => v 1) (main x hx); simpa [yPair, e] using this
+
+theorem offA_lv_prod_off (D : Frame) {f : R2 → ℝ} (hf : ∀ a : R2, 1 < ‖a‖ → f a = 0) (P F : ℝ → ℝ) :
+    offA D.ell (fun z : P3 => P z.1 * F z.2.1 * gLift D.ell f z) := by
+  intro z hz
+  have hg : gLift D.ell f z = 0 := by
+    apply hf
+    show 1 < ‖D.ell⁻¹ • z.2.2‖
+    rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, Real.norm_of_nonneg D.ell_pos.le, lt_inv_mul_iff₀ D.ell_pos]
+    simpa using hz
+  simp [hg]
+
+theorem offA_lv_levels {D : Frame} {L : LayerCoeffs} {ah bh : ℝ → ℝ}
+    (hah : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ah D.cdom) (hbh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ bh D.cdom) {Y : ℕ → LevelPair} {J : ℕ}
+    (h0 : offA D.ell (lvV Y 0) ∧ offA D.ell (lvW Y 0))
+    (hsol : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n ≤ J → SolvesForced D ah bh (fPair L Y n) (yPair Y n)) :
+    ∀ n, n ≤ J → offA D.ell (lvV Y n) ∧ offA D.ell (lvW Y n) := by
+  have key : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ n, n < N → n ≤ J → offA D.ell (lvV Y n) ∧ offA D.ell (lvW Y n) := by
+    intro N
+    induction N with
+    | zero => intro n hn; exact absurd hn (Nat.not_lt_zero n)
+    | succ N ih =>
+      intro n hn hJ
+      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hpos
+      · exact h0
+      · obtain ⟨hSθ, hSωt⟩ := offA_lv_sources L hpos (fun j hj => ih j (by omega) (by omega))
+        exact offA_lv_level hah hbh (hsol n hpos hJ) (offA_neg (offA_lv_Pne hSθ))
+          (offA_neg (offA_lv_sAnti (offA_lv_Pne hSωt)))
+  exact fun n hJ => key (n + 1) n (Nat.lt_succ_self n) hJ
+
+theorem earlyT_lv_Psi {tin : ℝ} (L : LayerCoeffs) {X : P3 → ℝ} (h : earlyT tin X) :
+    earlyT tin (Psi L X) :=
+  earlyT_mul_right (earlyT_mul_right

+theorem natural_congr_of_early {Φ Φ' : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} {N : ℝ} {ζ ζ' : ℝ → R2}

+    (hΦΦ : ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ × R2, tin ≤ z.1 → z.1 < T → Φ z = Φ' z) {t : ℝ} (ht : t < T) (x : R2) :

+  rcases lt_or_ge t tin with hlt | hge
+  · show Φ (t, _, _) = Φ' (t, _, _)
+    rw [hΦ _ hlt.le, hΦ' _ hlt.le]
+  · show Φ (t, N * inner ℝ (ζ t) x, Minv t x) = Φ' (t, N * inner ℝ (ζ' t) x, Minv' t x)

+theorem Etheta_congr_of_early {V Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} {tin T : ℝ} (hV : earlyT tin V)
+    (hΨ : earlyT tin Ψ) (N : ℝ) {M M' Minv Minv' : ℝ → Mat2} (hM : ∀ t ∈ Ico tin T, M t = M' t)
+    (hMinv : ∀ t ∈ Ico tin T, Minv t = Minv' t) (p : R2) (G : ℝ → R2) :
+    ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ × R2, z.1 < T →
+      Planar.Etheta N M Minv p G V Ψ z = Planar.Etheta N M' Minv' p G V Ψ z := by
+  intro z hz
+  rcases lt_or_ge z.1 tin with hlt | hge
+  · rw [earlyT_Etheta hV hΨ N M Minv p G z hlt.le, earlyT_Etheta hV hΨ N M' Minv' p G z hlt.le]
+  · show dT V z + N * inner ℝ (Mat2.perp (covec (Minv z.1) p)) (G z.1) * dS Ψ z
+        + (-(dA 1 Ψ z) * (gTilde (M z.1) (G z.1)) 0 + dA 0 Ψ z * (gTilde (M z.1) (G z.1)) 1)
+        + brN N p Ψ V z

+        + (-(dA 1 Ψ z) * (gTilde (M' z.1) (G z.1)) 0 + dA 0 Ψ z * (gTilde (M' z.1) (G z.1)) 1)

+    EqOn (fun z => DeltaNMAt N (Minv z.1) p Ψ z) (fun z => DeltaNMAt N (Minv' z.1) p Ψ z)

+  · exact (earlyT_DeltaNMAt hΨ N Minv p z hlt.le).trans

+theorem Eomega_congr_of_early {V Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × R2 → ℝ} {tin T : ℝ} (hV : earlyT tin V)

+  rcases lt_or_ge z.1 tin with hlt | hge

+    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Ico 0 T ×ˢ (univ : Set R2)) :=
+  (hg.mono (prod_mono Ico_subset_Iio_self le_rfl)).congr fun z hz => hfg z.1 hz.1.2 z.2
+
+end Congr

+theorem sumV_mem_cli (C : LevelData) {F : ℕ → Pair} {a b r : ℕ}
+    (hOK : ∀ n, n < b → C.LevelOK F n) (hr : r + 2 * b + 1 ≤ C.rstar + 2) :
+    YMem C.D C.S.wt (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico a b, C.ampV n r) r (LevelData.sumV F a b) := by
+  unfold LevelData.sumV
+  refine YMem.sum (Finset.Ico a b) (fun n => C.ampV n r) (fun n => (F n).1)
+    (fun t ht => C.D.wt_nonneg ht) (fun n _ => C.ampV_nonneg n r) (fun n hn => ?_)
+  have hn := (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hn).2
+  exact ((hOK n hn).memV r (by omega)).toYMem

+      r (PsiSum C kinv F J) := by
+  have hN := C.S.N_pos
+  have hσ := C.S.sigma_pos
+  refine YMem.sum (Finset.Ico 0 (J + 1)) (fun n => π / 2 * 2 ^ r * kap * C.ampV n r / (C.S.N * C.S.sigma))

+theorem abs_le_amp_of_mem {D : Frame} {A : ℝ} {r : ℕ} {φ : P3 → ℝ} (h : YMem D D.wt A r φ)
+    (y : P3) (hy : y.1 < D.Tstar) : |φ y| ≤ A := by
+  have hA : 0 ≤ A := h.amp_nonneg D.weight_wt
+  rcases le_or_gt y.1 D.tin with h1 | h1
+  · rw [h.vanish y h1, abs_zero]; exact hA
+  · have hI : y.1 ∈ D.I := ⟨h1.le, hy⟩
+    have hb := h.bound_all D.weight_wt [] (by simp) y hI
+    simp only [iter_nil, Frame.wcost_nil, mul_one] at hb
+    calc |φ y| ≤ A * D.wt y.1 := hb
+      _ ≤ A * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (D.wt_le_one _ hI) hA
+      _ = A := mul_one A
+
+theorem thetaTot_abs_le (C : LevelData) {F : ℕ → Pair} {J : ℕ} (hOK : ∀ n, n ≤ J → C.LevelOK F n)

+    ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : R2), t < C.S.Tstar →
+      |thetaTot F N zeta Minv J (t, x)| ≤ C.S.Ystar * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico 0 (J + 1), C.K.Ccal n 0 * C.S.delta ^ n := by
+  intro t x ht
+  rw [← LevelData.sum_ampV]
+  exact abs_le_amp_of_mem (Vsum_mem C hOK (r := 0) (by omega)) _ ht
+
+theorem thetaTot_abs_le_split (C : LevelData) {F : ℕ → Pair} {J : ℕ}
+    (hOK : ∀ n, n ≤ J → C.LevelOK F n) (hJ : 2 * J + 1 ≤ C.rstar) (N : ℝ) (zeta : ℝ → R2)
+    (Minv : ℝ → (R2 →L[ℝ] R2)) :
+    ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : R2), t < C.S.Tstar →
+      |thetaTot F N zeta Minv J (t, x)| ≤ |natural N zeta Minv (F 0).1 (t, x)|
+        + C.S.Ystar * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (J + 1), C.K.Ccal n 0 * C.S.delta ^ n := by
+  intro t x ht
+  have htail := sumV_mem_cli C (a := 1) (b := J + 1) (r := 0) (fun n hn => hOK n (by omega)) (by omega)
+  rw [← LevelData.sum_ampV]
+  have hsplit : thetaTot F N zeta Minv J (t, x) = natural N zeta Minv (F 0).1 (t, x)
+      + natural N zeta Minv (LevelData.sumV F 1 (J + 1)) (t, x) := by
+    show (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico 0 (J + 1), (F n).1 (t, N * inner ℝ (zeta t) x, Minv t x)) = _
+    rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot (by omega)]
+    rfl
+  rw [hsplit]
+  exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add le_rfl (abs_le_amp_of_mem htail _ ht))
+
+theorem psiTot_sParity (C : LevelData) (kinv : ℝ → ℝ) {ε : ℝ} {φ : P3 → ℝ}
+    (h : HasParity sNegL ε φ) (hp : SPeriodic φ) : HasParity sNegL (-ε) (C.Psi kinv φ) := by

+theorem Vsum_mem_all (C : LevelData) {F : ℕ → Pair} {J : ℕ}
+    (hC : ∀ r : ℕ, ∃ C' : LevelData, C'.S = C.S ∧ r + 2 * J + 1 ≤ C'.rstar
+      ∧ ∀ n, n ≤ J → C'.LevelOK F n) :
+    ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ A : ℝ, YMem C.D (fun _ => 1) A m (Vsum F J) := by
+  intro m
+  obtain ⟨C', hS, hr, hOK⟩ := hC m
+  have h := (Vsum_mem C' hOK (J := J) (r := m) hr).toSharp
+  refine ⟨∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico 0 (J + 1), C'.ampV n m, ?_⟩
+  have e2 : C.D = C'.D := by
+    show C.S.toFrame = C'.S.toFrame; rw [hS]
+  rw [e2]
+  exact h

+theorem PsiSum_mem_all (C : LevelData) {kinv : ℝ → ℝ} {kap : ℕ → ℝ} (hkap : ∀ r, 0 ≤ kap r)
+    (hk : ∀ r, TMem C.D (fun _ => 1) (kap r) r kinv) {F : ℕ → Pair} {J : ℕ}
+    (hC : ∀ r : ℕ, ∃ C' : LevelData, C'.S = C.S ∧ r + 2 * J + 1 ≤ C'.rstar
+      ∧ ∀ n, n ≤ J → C'.LevelOK F n) :
+    ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ A : ℝ, YMem C.D (fun _ => 1) A m (PsiSum C kinv F J) := by
+  intro m
+  obtain ⟨C', hS, hr, hOK⟩ := hC m
+  have e2 : C.D = C'.D := by
+    show C.S.toFrame = C'.S.toFrame; rw [hS]
+  have hk' : TMem C'.D (fun _ => 1) (kap m) m kinv := by rw [← e2]; exact hk m
+  have h := (PsiSum_mem C' hOK hk' (hkap m) (J := J) hr).toSharp
+  refine ⟨∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico 0 (J + 1), π / 2 * 2 ^ m * kap m * C'.ampV n m / (C'.S.N * C'.S.sigma), ?_⟩
+  have e1 : PsiSum C kinv F J = PsiSum C' kinv F J := by
+    show (fun x => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico 0 (J + 1), (C.S.N * C.S.sigma)⁻¹ * (kinv x.1 * sAnti (F n).2 x))
+      = (fun x => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico 0 (J + 1), (C'.S.N * C'.S.sigma)⁻¹ * (kinv x.1 * sAnti (F n).2 x))

+  have h2 : ∀ i y, pd i (fun z => -pd i g (-z)) y = pd i (pd i g) (-y) := by

+def CoeffsAgree (D : Frame) (Sc : Scales) (L : AffineCore.Cascade.LayerCoeffs) (Lfw : LayerCoeffFns) : Prop :=
+  L.N = Sc.N ∧ L.sigma = Sc.sigma ∧ L.p = Sc.p ∧ L.kinv = Lfw.kinv ∧ L.cp = Lfw.cp ∧ L.Cm = Lfw.Cm ∧
+    L.Gt = Lfw.Gt ∧ L.e1t = Lfw.e1t ∧ (∀ t ∈ D.cdom, L.kap t * L.kinv t = 1) ∧ Sc.N ≠ 0 ∧ Sc.sigma ≠ 0
+
+def CoeffsRegular (D : Frame) (L : AffineCore.Cascade.LayerCoeffs) : Prop :=
+  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L.kinv D.cdom ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L.kap D.cdom ∧
+    (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (L.cp k) D.cdom ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (L.Gt k) D.cdom ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (L.e1t k) D.cdom ∧
+      ∀ l, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (L.Cm k l) D.cdom)
+
+def fieldsOf (L : AffineCore.Cascade.LayerCoeffs) : LayerCoeffFns := ⟨L.kinv, L.cp, L.Cm, L.Gt, L.e1t⟩
+
+theorem coeffsAgree_fieldsOf {D : Frame} {Sc : Scales} {L : AffineCore.Cascade.LayerCoeffs}
+    (hN : L.N = Sc.N) (hs : L.sigma = Sc.sigma) (hp : L.p = Sc.p)
+    (hk : ∀ t ∈ D.cdom, L.kap t * L.kinv t = 1) (hN0 : Sc.N ≠ 0) (hs0 : Sc.sigma ≠ 0) :
+    CoeffsAgree D Sc L (fieldsOf L) :=
+  ⟨hN, hs, hp, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, hk, hN0, hs0⟩
+
+def FamilyRegular (D : Frame) (Y : ℕ → AffineCore.Cascade.LevelPair) : Prop :=
+  ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Y j).1 D.slab ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Y j).2 D.slab ∧ SPeriodic (Y j).1 ∧
+    SPeriodic (Y j).2 ∧ ∀ x ∈ D.slab, smean (Y j).2 x = 0
+
+theorem Psi_eq {D : Frame} {Sc : Scales} {L : AffineCore.Cascade.LayerCoeffs} {Lfw : LayerCoeffFns}
+    (h : CoeffsAgree D Sc L Lfw) (X : P3 → ℝ) : AffineCore.Cascade.Psi L X = PsiS Sc Lfw.kinv X := by
+  obtain ⟨hN, hs, -, hk, -⟩ := h
+  funext y
+  simp only [AffineCore.Cascade.Psi, PsiS, hN, hs, hk]
+  rfl
+
+theorem calZ_eq {D : Frame} {Sc : Scales} {L : AffineCore.Cascade.LayerCoeffs} {Lfw : LayerCoeffFns}
+    (h : CoeffsAgree D Sc L Lfw) (Y : ℕ → AffineCore.Cascade.LevelPair) (q : ℕ) :
+    AffineCore.Cascade.calZ L Y q = Construction.Cascade.calZ Sc Lfw Y q := by
+  have hPsi := Psi_eq h
+  obtain ⟨hN, hs, hp, hk, hcp, hCm, -⟩ := h
+  funext x
+  simp only [AffineCore.Cascade.calZ, Construction.Cascade.calZ]
+  congr 1
+  · simp only [AffineCore.Cascade.termZ1, Construction.Cascade.Z1, AffineCore.Cascade.lvW, hN, hk, hcp]
+    rfl
+  · rcases q with _ | _ | q
+    · rfl
+    · rfl
+    · simp only [AffineCore.Cascade.termZ2, Construction.Cascade.Z2, AffineCore.Cascade.PsiLv,
+        AffineCore.Cascade.lvW, hs, hN, hCm, hPsi]
+      rfl
+
+theorem termT2_eq {D : Frame} {Sc : Scales} {L : AffineCore.Cascade.LayerCoeffs} {Lfw : LayerCoeffFns}
+    (h : CoeffsAgree D Sc L Lfw) (Y : ℕ → AffineCore.Cascade.LevelPair) (n : ℕ) :
+    AffineCore.Cascade.termT2 L Y n = Construction.Cascade.T2 Sc Lfw Y n := by
+  have hPsi := Psi_eq h
+  obtain ⟨hN, hs, hp, hk, -⟩ := h
+  funext x
+  simp only [AffineCore.Cascade.termT2, Construction.Cascade.T2, AffineCore.Cascade.PsiLv,
+    AffineCore.Cascade.lvW, AffineCore.Cascade.lvV, hN, hp, hPsi]
+  rfl
+
+theorem termT3_eq {D : Frame} {Sc : Scales} {L : AffineCore.Cascade.LayerCoeffs} {Lfw : LayerCoeffFns}
+    (h : CoeffsAgree D Sc L Lfw) (Y : ℕ → AffineCore.Cascade.LevelPair) (n : ℕ) :
+    AffineCore.Cascade.termT3 L Y n = Construction.Cascade.T3 Sc Lfw Y n := by
+  have hPsi := Psi_eq h
+  funext x
+  simp only [AffineCore.Cascade.termT3, Construction.Cascade.T3, AffineCore.Cascade.PsiLv,
+    AffineCore.Cascade.lvW, AffineCore.Cascade.lvV, hPsi]
+  rfl
+
+theorem termU3_eq {D : Frame} {Sc : Scales} {L : AffineCore.Cascade.LayerCoeffs} {Lfw : LayerCoeffFns}
+    (h : CoeffsAgree D Sc L Lfw) (Y : ℕ → AffineCore.Cascade.LevelPair) (n : ℕ) (x : P3) :
+    L.sigma / L.N * AffineCore.Cascade.termU3 L Y n x = Construction.Cascade.U3 Sc Lfw Y n x := by
+  obtain ⟨hN, hs, hp, hk, hcp, hCm, hG, he, -⟩ := h
+  simp only [AffineCore.Cascade.termU3, Construction.Cascade.U3, AffineCore.Cascade.lvV, hN, hs, he]
+  show Sc.sigma / Sc.N * -(Lfw.e1t 0 x.1 * dd (Ltr.a 0).vec (Y (n - 1)).1 x
+      + Lfw.e1t 1 x.1 * dd (Ltr.a 1).vec (Y (n - 1)).1 x) = _
+  ring
+
+theorem levelZero_eq (P : DesignParams) (N1 : ℝ) (k : ℕ → ℕ) (S : SkeletonReadout) (m : ℕ)
+    {D : Frame} (hD : D.ell = ell P N1 m) :
+    Construction.Fields.levelZeroV P N1 k S m
+        = (fun z : P3 => (S.ramp P N1 k m z.1 * S.Theta m z.1) * P.F z.2.1 * AffineCore.Cascade.gLift D.ell P.fBump z) ∧
+      Construction.Fields.levelZeroW P N1 k S m
+        = (fun z : P3 => (S.ramp P N1 k m z.1 * S.OmegaHat P N1 m z.1) * P.F z.2.1 * AffineCore.Cascade.gLift D.ell P.fBump z) := by
+  rw [hD]
+  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
+
+end AffineCore.Construction.Cascade.Decomp

+import AffineCore.Construction.Cascade.Builders
+import AffineCore.Construction.Cascade.LeafT2Aux

+
+structure CoeffMem (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (kap Cbar : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
+  fl_kap : ∀ r, 0 ≤ kap r
+  fl_Cbar : ∀ r, 0 ≤ Cbar r
+  fl_kinv : ∀ r, r ≤ C.rstar → TMem C.D (fun _ => 1) (kap r) r L.kinv
+  fl_cp : ∀ r, r ≤ C.rstar → ∀ (k : Fin 2), TMem C.D (fun _ => 1) (Cbar r * C.S.piL) r (L.cp k)
+  fl_Cm : ∀ r, r ≤ C.rstar → ∀ (k l : Fin 2), TMem C.D (fun _ => 1) (Cbar r * C.S.piL) r (L.Cm k l)
+  fl_Gt : ∀ r, r ≤ C.rstar → ∀ (k : Fin 2), TMem C.D (fun _ => 1) (Cbar r * C.S.piL ^ 2) r (L.Gt k)
+  fl_e1t : ∀ r, r ≤ C.rstar → ∀ (k : Fin 2), TMem C.D (fun _ => 1) (Cbar r * C.S.piL) r (L.e1t k)
+
+def rowTheta (kap Cbar : ℕ → ℝ) (Ybr : ℝ) (r : ℕ) : ℝ :=
+  LeafT1Aux.cT1 kap Cbar r + LeafT2Aux.rowT2 Ybr kap r + LevelData.cT3 kap Ybr r
+
+def rowOmega (kap Cbar : ℕ → ℝ) (Ybr : ℝ) (r : ℕ) : ℝ :=
+  LeafU1Aux.constU1 kap Cbar r + LeafU2Aux.rowU2 kap Cbar r + LevelData.cU3 Cbar r
+    + LeafU4Aux.constU4 kap Ybr r + LeafU5Aux.rowU5 kap Ybr r
+
+def rowCalZ (kap Cbar : ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) : ℝ :=
+  LevelData.cZ1 kap Cbar r + LevelData.cZ2 kap Cbar r
+
+theorem rowTheta_nonneg {kap Cbar : ℕ → ℝ} {Ybr : ℝ} (hkap : ∀ r, 0 ≤ kap r)
+    (hCbar : ∀ r, 0 ≤ Cbar r) (hYbr : 0 ≤ Ybr) (r : ℕ) : 0 ≤ rowTheta kap Cbar Ybr r := by
+  unfold rowTheta LeafT1Aux.cT1 LevelData.cT3
+  have := hkap (r + 1); have := hkap (r + 3); have := hCbar r
+  have := LeafT2Aux.rowT2_nonneg (kap := kap) hYbr hkap r
+  positivity
+
+theorem rowOmega_nonneg {kap Cbar : ℕ → ℝ} {Ybr : ℝ} (hkap : ∀ r, 0 ≤ kap r)
+    (hCbar : ∀ r, 0 ≤ Cbar r) (hYbr : 0 ≤ Ybr) (r : ℕ) : 0 ≤ rowOmega kap Cbar Ybr r := by
+  unfold rowOmega LeafU1Aux.constU1 LeafU2Aux.rowU2 LevelData.cU3 LeafU4Aux.constU4
+    LeafU4Aux.constU4half LeafU5Aux.rowU5
+  have := hkap (r + 1); have := hkap (r + 3); have := hCbar r; have := hCbar (r + 1)
+  positivity
+
+theorem rowCalZ_nonneg {kap Cbar : ℕ → ℝ} (hkap : ∀ r, 0 ≤ kap r) (hCbar : ∀ r, 0 ≤ Cbar r)
+    (r : ℕ) : 0 ≤ rowCalZ kap Cbar r := by
+  unfold rowCalZ LevelData.cZ1 LevelData.cZ2
+  have := hkap r; have := hkap (r + 2); have := hCbar r
+  positivity
+
+def leafConstsOf (kap Cbar : ℕ → ℝ) (Ybr : ℝ) (hkap : ∀ r, 0 ≤ kap r) (hCbar : ∀ r, 0 ≤ Cbar r)
+    (hYbr : 0 ≤ Ybr) : LeafConsts where
+  cth := rowTheta kap Cbar Ybr
+  com := rowOmega kap Cbar Ybr
+  cZ := rowCalZ kap Cbar
+  cth_nonneg := rowTheta_nonneg hkap hCbar hYbr
+  com_nonneg := rowOmega_nonneg hkap hCbar hYbr
+  cZ_nonneg := rowCalZ_nonneg hkap hCbar
+
+theorem T2_eq_fl (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) :
+    T2 C.S L F n = LeafT2Aux.termT2 C.S L.kinv F n := rfl
+
+theorem U2_eq_fl (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ) :
+    U2 C.S L F n = LeafU2Aux.termU2 C L.Cm L.kinv F n := by
+  rcases n with _ | _ | n <;> rfl
+
+theorem U5_eq_fl (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (F : ℕ → Pair) (n : ℕ)
+    (h : C.calZ = calZ C.S L) : U5 C.S L F n = LeafU5Aux.termU5 C L.kinv F n := by
+  funext x
+  simp only [U5, LeafU5Aux.termU5, LeafU5Aux.termU5W, LeafU5Aux.termU5Z, h]
+  rfl
+
+theorem leafTheta_fl (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) {kap Cbar : ℕ → ℝ} (hm : CoeffMem C L kap Cbar)
+    (hS : C.Stheta = Stheta C.S L) (hc : C.cth = rowTheta kap Cbar C.U.Ybr) : C.LeafTheta := by
+  have h1 := LeafT1Aux.leafS_T1 C hm.fl_kap hm.fl_Cbar hm.fl_kinv hm.fl_Gt
+  have h2 := LeafT2Aux.leafS_T2_guarded C hm.fl_kap hm.fl_kinv
+  have h3 := LevelData.leafS_T3 C hm.fl_kap hm.fl_kinv
+  have h := LevelData.TermLeafS.add C (LevelData.TermLeafS.add C h1 h2) h3
+  show C.TermLeafS C.Stheta C.cth
+  rw [hS, hc]
+  exact LevelData.TermLeafS.of_eq C h (fun F n x => rfl)
+
+theorem leafOmega_fl (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) {kap Cbar : ℕ → ℝ} (hm : CoeffMem C L kap Cbar)
+    (hS : C.Stomega = Stomega C.S L) (hZ : C.calZ = calZ C.S L)
+    (hc : C.com = rowOmega kap Cbar C.U.Ybr) : C.LeafOmega := by
+  have h1 := LeafU1Aux.termU1_leafS C hm.fl_kap hm.fl_Cbar hm.fl_kinv hm.fl_cp
+  have h2 := LeafU2Aux.leafS_U2_guarded C hm.fl_kap hm.fl_Cbar hm.fl_kinv hm.fl_Cm
+  have h3 := LevelData.leafS_U3 C hm.fl_Cbar hm.fl_e1t
+  have h4 := LeafU4Aux.leafS_U4_ofLayer C hm.fl_kap hm.fl_kinv
+  have h5 := LeafU5Aux.leafS_U5_guarded C hm.fl_kap hm.fl_kinv
+  have h := LevelData.TermLeafS.add C (LevelData.TermLeafS.add C
+    (LevelData.TermLeafS.add C (LevelData.TermLeafS.add C h1 h2) h3) h4) h5
+  show C.TermLeafS C.Stomega C.com
+  rw [hS, hc]
+  refine LevelData.TermLeafS.of_eq C h (fun F n x => ?_)
+  show U1 C.S L F n x + U2 C.S L F n x + U3 C.S L F n x + U4 C.S L F n x + U5 C.S L F n x = _
+  rw [U1_eq, U2_eq_fl, U3_eq, U4_eq C L F n hZ, U5_eq_fl C L F n hZ]
+
+theorem leafZ_fl (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) {kap Cbar : ℕ → ℝ} (hm : CoeffMem C L kap Cbar)
+    (hZ : C.calZ = calZ C.S L) (hc : C.cZ = rowCalZ kap Cbar) : C.LeafZ := by
+  have h1 := LevelData.leafZ_Z1 C hm.fl_kap hm.fl_Cbar hm.fl_kinv hm.fl_cp
+  have h2 := LevelData.leafZ_Z2 C hm.fl_kap hm.fl_Cbar hm.fl_kinv hm.fl_Cm
+  have h := LevelData.TermLeafZ.add C h1 h2
+  show C.TermLeafZ C.calZ C.cZ
+  rw [hZ, hc]
+  exact LevelData.TermLeafZ.of_eq C h (fun F q x => rfl)
+
+theorem parityLeafZ_fl (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (hZ : C.calZ = calZ C.S L) :
+    C.ParityLeafZ := by
+  have h := (LeafParity.parityZ_Z1 C L.kinv L.cp).add (LeafParity.parityZ_Z2 C L.kinv L.Cm)
+  show LevelData.TermParityZ C.calZ
+  rw [hZ]
+  exact h.of_eq (fun F q x => rfl)
+
+theorem parityLeafTheta_fl (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (hS : C.Stheta = Stheta C.S L) :
+    C.ParityLeafTheta := by
+  have h := ((LeafT1Aux.parity_T1 C L.kinv L.Gt C.calZ).add (LeafT2Aux.parity_T2 C.S L.kinv C.calZ)).add
+    (LeafParity.parityTheta_T3 C L.kinv C.calZ)
+  show LevelData.TermParityTheta C.calZ C.Stheta
+  rw [hS]
+  exact h.of_eq (fun F n x => rfl)
+
+theorem parityLeafOmega_fl (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (hS : C.Stomega = Stomega C.S L)
+    (hZ : C.calZ = calZ C.S L) : C.ParityLeafOmega := by
+  have h := ((((LeafU1Aux.termU1_parity C L.kinv L.cp C.calZ).add
+      (LeafU2Aux.parity_U2 C L.Cm L.kinv C.calZ)).add (LeafParity.parityOmega_U3 C L.e1t C.calZ)).add
+      (LeafU4Aux.parity_U4 C L.kinv)).add (LeafU5Aux.parity_U5 C L.kinv)
+  show LevelData.TermParityOmega C.calZ C.Stomega
+  rw [hS]
+  refine h.of_eq (fun F n x => ?_)
+  show U1 C.S L F n x + U2 C.S L F n x + U3 C.S L F n x + U4 C.S L F n x + U5 C.S L F n x = _
+  rw [U1_eq, U2_eq_fl, U3_eq, U4_eq C L F n hZ, U5_eq_fl C L F n hZ]
+
+theorem familyLeaves_fl (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) {kap Cbar : ℕ → ℝ}
+    (hm : CoeffMem C L kap Cbar) (hS : C.Stheta = Stheta C.S L) (hO : C.Stomega = Stomega C.S L)
+    (hZ : C.calZ = calZ C.S L)
+    (hLC : C.LC = leafConstsOf kap Cbar C.U.Ybr hm.fl_kap hm.fl_Cbar C.U.Ybr_nonneg) :
+    C.LeafZ ∧ C.LeafTheta ∧ C.LeafOmega :=
+  ⟨leafZ_fl C L hm hZ (by show C.LC.cZ = _; rw [hLC]; rfl),
+    leafTheta_fl C L hm hS (by show C.LC.cth = _; rw [hLC]; rfl),
+    leafOmega_fl C L hm hO hZ (by show C.LC.com = _; rw [hLC]; rfl)⟩
+
+theorem familyParity_fl (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns) (hS : C.Stheta = Stheta C.S L)
+    (hO : C.Stomega = Stomega C.S L) (hZ : C.calZ = calZ C.S L) :

+
+theorem leafConstsOf_record_eq (U : UniversalData) :
+    leafConstsOf U.kapSeq U.Cbar U.Ybr U.kapSeq_nonneg U.Cbar_nonneg U.Ybr_nonneg

+
+theorem familyLeaves_record (C : LevelData) (L : LayerCoeffFns)
+    (hm : CoeffMem C L C.U.kapSeq C.U.Cbar) (hS : C.Stheta = Stheta C.S L)

+    leafOmega_fl C L hm hO hZ (by show C.LC.com = _; rw [hLC]; rfl)⟩
+
+end AffineCore.Construction.Cascade.FamilyLeavesAux

+def AllOrderBounds {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (I : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → E) :
+    Prop :=
+  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f I ∧ ∀ b : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ I, ‖iteratedDerivWithin b f I t‖ ≤ K
+
+theorem aob_clm {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
+    [NormedSpace ℝ F] {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → E} (hf : AllOrderBounds (Ico a b) f) (L : E →L[ℝ] F) :
+    AllOrderBounds (Ico a b) (fun t => L (f t)) := by
+  refine ⟨L.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf.1, fun n => ?_⟩
+  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hf.2 n
+  refine ⟨‖L‖ * K, fun t ht => ?_⟩
+  have h1 := L.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_left (hf.1 t ht)
+    (uniqueDiffOn_Ico a b) ht (n := n) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
+  rw [← norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin]
+  refine h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (norm_nonneg _))
+  rw [norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin]
+  exact hK t ht
+
+theorem aob_mul {a b : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : AllOrderBounds (Ico a b) f)
+    (hg : AllOrderBounds (Ico a b) g) : AllOrderBounds (Ico a b) (fun t => f t * g t) := by
+  classical
+  refine ⟨hf.1.mul hg.1, fun n => ?_⟩
+  choose Kf hKf using hf.2
+  choose Kg hKg using hg.2
+  refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * Kf i * Kg (n - i), fun t ht => ?_⟩
+  have h1 := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (A := ℝ) hf.1 hg.1 (uniqueDiffOn_Ico a b)
+    ht (n := n) (N := ∞) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
+  rw [← norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin]
+  refine h1.trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
+  rw [norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin,
+    norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
+  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
+  exact mul_le_mul (hKf i t ht) (hKg (n - i) t ht) (norm_nonneg _)
+    ((norm_nonneg _).trans (hKf i t ht))
+
+theorem aob_sub {a b : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : AllOrderBounds (Ico a b) f)
+    (hg : AllOrderBounds (Ico a b) g) : AllOrderBounds (Ico a b) (fun t => f t - g t) := by
+  refine ⟨hf.1.sub hg.1, fun n => ?_⟩
+  obtain ⟨Kf, hKf⟩ := hf.2 n
+  obtain ⟨Kg, hKg⟩ := hg.2 n
+  refine ⟨Kf + Kg, fun t ht => ?_⟩
+  have e : iteratedDerivWithin n (fun t => f t - g t) (Ico a b) t
+      = iteratedDerivWithin n f (Ico a b) t - iteratedDerivWithin n g (Ico a b) t :=
+    iteratedDerivWithin_sub ht (uniqueDiffOn_Ico a b) ((hf.1 t ht).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
+      ((hg.1 t ht).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
+  rw [e]
+  exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hKf t ht) (hKg t ht))
+
+theorem deriv_bounds_of_eqOn {D : Framework.Cascade.Frame} {c X : ℝ → ℝ}
+    (hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c D.cdom) (hX : AllOrderBounds D.I X) (hcX : EqOn c X D.I) :
+    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ D.I, |iteratedDeriv n c t| ≤ K := by
+  intro n
+  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hX.2 n
+  refine ⟨K, fun t ht => ?_⟩
+  have hct : ContDiffAt ℝ (n : ℕ) c t :=
+    (hs.contDiffAt (D.isOpen_cdom.mem_nhds (D.I_subset_cdom ht))).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
+  have e : iteratedDerivWithin n c D.I t = iteratedDerivWithin n X D.I t :=
+    iteratedDerivWithin_congr hcX ht
+  rw [← iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv (uniqueDiffOn_Ico D.tin D.Tstar) hct ht]
+  change |iteratedDerivWithin n c D.I t| ≤ K
+  rw [e, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
+  exact hK t ht
+
+theorem inner_Jrot (ξ g : R2) : inner ℝ (Jrot ξ) g = ξ 0 * g 1 - ξ 1 * g 0 := by
+  simp [Jrot, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, e]
+  ring
+
+theorem kap_c1_c2_allOrders {W : LemmaSWindows} {Lc : CascadeLetters} {P : DesignParams}
+    {B : ProfileBounds} {ε N1 : ℝ} {k : ℕ → ℕ} {S : SkeletonReadout} {m : ℕ}
+    {Cb Cprime cj CRc : ℕ → ℝ} {K : ℝ} {Kmaster : ℕ → ℝ}
+    (hbase : cascadeHyp_base W Lc P B ε N1 k S m Cb Cprime cj CRc K Kmaster)
+    {Sc : CascadeClasses.Scales} (hLS : IsLayerScales P N1 S m Sc)
+    {L : LayerCoeffs} {Minv : ℝ → Mat2} {w Θ Ωh PΘ PΩ : ℝ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {f : R2 → ℝ}
+    {ah bh : ℝ → ℝ}
+    (hdata : LevelDataOK Sc.toFrame L (S.M m) Minv (S.zeta m) (S.Gbelow P N1 k m) w Θ Ωh PΘ PΩ F
+      f ah bh) :
+    ∃ A : ℕ → ℝ,
+      Monotone A ∧ (∀ n, 1 ≤ A n) ∧ ∀ n,
+      Framework.Cascade.TMem Sc.toFrame.toFw (fun _ => 1) (A n) n L.kap ∧
+      Framework.Cascade.TMem Sc.toFrame.toFw (fun _ => 1) (A n) n L.c1 ∧
+      Framework.Cascade.TMem Sc.toFrame.toFw (fun _ => 1) (A n) n L.c2 := by
+  obtain ⟨⟨-, htin, hT, -, -, -⟩, -, -, -, -⟩ := hLS
+  set D := Sc.toFrame.toFw with hD
+  have hI : D.I = S.Iwin m := by
+    show Ico Sc.toFrame.tin Sc.toFrame.Tstar = Ico (S.tIn m) S.Tstar; rw [htin, hT]
+  have hζ : AllOrderBounds D.I (S.zeta m) := by
+    rw [hI]; exact ⟨hbase.smooth_zeta.1, hbase.smooth_zeta.2⟩
+  have hG : AllOrderBounds D.I (S.Gbelow P N1 k m) := by
+    rw [hI]; exact ⟨hbase.smooth_gbelow.1, hbase.smooth_gbelow.2⟩
+  have hκ : AllOrderBounds D.I (kap S m) := by
+    rw [hI]; exact ⟨hbase.smooth_kap.1, hbase.smooth_kap.2⟩
+  have hIco : D.I = Ico D.tin D.Tstar := rfl
+
+  have hζi : ∀ i : Fin 2, AllOrderBounds D.I (fun t => (S.zeta m t) i) := fun i => by
+    rw [hIco] at hζ ⊢; exact aob_clm hζ (EuclideanSpace.proj i)
+  have hGi : ∀ i : Fin 2, AllOrderBounds D.I (fun t => (S.Gbelow P N1 k m t) i) := fun i => by
+    rw [hIco] at hG ⊢; exact aob_clm hG (EuclideanSpace.proj i)
+  have hX1 : AllOrderBounds D.I (fun t =>
+      (S.zeta m t) 0 * (S.Gbelow P N1 k m t) 1 - (S.zeta m t) 1 * (S.Gbelow P N1 k m t) 0) := by
+    rw [hIco] at hζi hGi ⊢
+    exact aob_sub (aob_mul (hζi 0) (hGi 1)) (aob_mul (hζi 1) (hGi 0))
+
+  obtain ⟨Aκ, hmκ, h1κ, hκT⟩ := Framework.Cascade.TMem.ofAllOrders hdata.kap_smooth
+    (deriv_bounds_of_eqOn hdata.kap_smooth hκ (fun t ht => hdata.kap_eq ht))
+  obtain ⟨A1, hm1, h11, h1T⟩ := Framework.Cascade.TMem.ofAllOrders hdata.c1_smooth
+    (deriv_bounds_of_eqOn hdata.c1_smooth hX1
+      (fun t ht => by rw [hdata.c1_eq ht, inner_Jrot]))
+  obtain ⟨A2, hm2, h12, h2T⟩ := Framework.Cascade.TMem.ofAllOrders hdata.c2_smooth
+    (deriv_bounds_of_eqOn hdata.c2_smooth (hζi 0) (fun t ht => hdata.c2_eq ht))
+  refine ⟨fun n => max (Aκ n) (max (A1 n) (A2 n)), fun a b hab => max_le_max (hmκ hab)
+    (max_le_max (hm1 hab) (hm2 hab)), fun n => (h1κ n).trans (le_max_left _ _), fun n => ?_⟩
+  have hw : ∀ t ∈ D.I, (0 : ℝ) ≤ (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) t := fun _ _ => zero_le_one
+  exact ⟨(hκT n).mono hw (le_max_left _ _) le_rfl,
+    (h1T n).mono hw ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)) le_rfl,
+    (h2T n).mono hw ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)) le_rfl⟩
+
