+  have hZq : YMem C.D C.S.wt (C.ampZ (n - 1 - i) (r + 2)) (r + 1) (C.calZ F (n - 1 - i)) :=
+    (hz.1 (r + 2) (by omega)).mono hwt le_rfl (by omega)
+  have hA := (C.psi_mem (hk (r + 1) (by omega)) (hkap (r + 1)) hWi).toYMem.dd_s
+  have hB := hZq.dperp C.S.p
+  have hCf := hZq.dd_s
+  have hDf := (C.psi_mem (hk (r + 1) (by omega)) (hkap (r + 1)) (hWi2.dperp C.S.p)).toYMem.mono hwt le_rfl
+    (Nat.le_succ r)
+  have hJ := ((hA.mul_wt hB).sub (hCf.mul_wt hDf)).const_mul C.S.N
+  have hN := C.S.N_pos
+  have hσ := C.S.sigma_pos
+  have hδ := C.S.delta_pos
+  have hYs := C.S.Ystar_pos
+  have hP := C.S.piL_pos
+  have hl := C.S.ell_pos
+  have hb0 : 0 < Ybr := by linarith
+  have hs2 : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := by positivity
+  have hci := C.K.Ccal_nonneg i (r + 2)
+  have hcq := C.K.Ccalp_nonneg (n - 1 - i) (r + 2)
+  have hkr := hkap (r + 1)
+  have hbr : C.S.Ystar * C.S.piL ^ 2 * (C.S.ell * C.S.sigma * C.S.delta)⁻¹ ≤ Ybr := by
+    have h1 := C.S.bracket_T2 hYbr hY
+    have h2 : (C.S.piL ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (one_le_pow₀ C.S.one_le_piL)
+    exact h1.trans (mul_le_of_le_one_right hb0.le h2)
+  refine hJ.retarget hwt
+    (T := constU4half kap Ybr r * (C.S.Ystar * C.S.delta ^ n * (C.S.piL ^ 2)⁻¹)
+        * (C.K.Ccal i (r + 2) * C.K.Ccalp (n - 1 - i) (r + 2)))
+    (b := ((|C.S.p 1| + |C.S.p 0|) / Real.sqrt 2)
+        * (C.S.Ystar * C.S.piL ^ 2 * (C.S.ell * C.S.sigma * C.S.delta)⁻¹ / Ybr)) ?_ ?_ ?_
+  · unfold LevelData.ampV LevelData.ampZ constU4half
+    have hδn : C.S.delta ^ i * C.S.delta ^ (n - 1 - i) * C.S.delta = C.S.delta ^ n := by
+      rw [← pow_add, ← pow_succ]; congr 1; omega
+    rw [abs_of_pos hN, ← hδn]
+    field_simp
+    ring
+  · have h1 : (|C.S.p 1| + |C.S.p 0|) / Real.sqrt 2 ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hs2).2 C.S.abs_p_sum_le
+    have h2 : C.S.Ystar * C.S.piL ^ 2 * (C.S.ell * C.S.sigma * C.S.delta)⁻¹ / Ybr ≤ 1 :=
+      (div_le_one hb0).2 hbr
+    have h3 : 0 ≤ C.S.Ystar * C.S.piL ^ 2 * (C.S.ell * C.S.sigma * C.S.delta)⁻¹ / Ybr := by positivity
+    calc _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul h1 h2 h3 zero_le_one
+      _ = 1 := one_mul 1
+  · unfold constU4half
+    positivity
+
+theorem leafS_termU4W (C : LevelData) {kinv : ℝ → ℝ} {kap : ℕ → ℝ} {Ybr : ℝ}
+    (hkap : ∀ r, 0 ≤ kap r) (hk : ∀ r, r ≤ C.rstar → TMem C.D (fun _ => 1) (kap r) r kinv)
+    (hYbr : 1 ≤ Ybr) (hY : C.S.Ystar ≤ Ybr * C.S.N ^ (-(7 : ℝ) / 8)) :
+    C.TermLeafS (termU4W C kinv) (constU4half kap Ybr) := by
+  intro F n hn hI hZ
+  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
+  have hwt : ∀ t ∈ C.D.I, 0 ≤ C.S.wt t := fun t ht => C.D.wt_nonneg ht
+  constructor
+  · intro r hr
+    have hYs := C.S.Ystar_pos
+    have hδ := C.S.delta_pos
+    have hP := C.S.piL_pos
+    have hb0 : 0 < Ybr := by linarith
+    have hkr := hkap (r + 1)
+    have hK : 0 ≤ constU4half kap Ybr r * (C.S.Ystar * C.S.delta ^ (m + 1) * (C.S.piL ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
+      unfold constU4half; positivity
+    have hS := YMem.sum (Finset.range (m + 1))
+      (fun i => constU4half kap Ybr r * (C.S.Ystar * C.S.delta ^ (m + 1) * (C.S.piL ^ 2)⁻¹)
+        * (C.K.Ccal i (r + 2) * C.K.Ccal (m + 1 - 1 - i) (r + 2)))
+      (fun i x => C.S.N * (dd Ltr.s.vec (C.Psi kinv (F i).2) x * dd Ltr.s.vec (dperp C.S.p (F (m + 1 - 1 - i)).2) x
+        - dd Ltr.s.vec (dd Ltr.s.vec (F (m + 1 - 1 - i)).2) x * C.Psi kinv (dperp C.S.p (F i).2) x))
+      hwt (fun i _ => mul_nonneg hK (mul_nonneg (C.K.Ccal_nonneg _ _) (C.K.Ccal_nonneg _ _)))
+      (fun i hi => summandW_mem_U4 C hkap hk hYbr hY hI (Finset.mem_range.1 hi) hr)
+    have hfun : termU4W C kinv F (m + 1) = fun x => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), C.S.N *
+        (dd Ltr.s.vec (C.Psi kinv (F i).2) x * dd Ltr.s.vec (dperp C.S.p (F (m + 1 - 1 - i)).2) x
+          - dd Ltr.s.vec (dd Ltr.s.vec (F (m + 1 - 1 - i)).2) x * C.Psi kinv (dperp C.S.p (F i).2) x) := rfl
+    rw [hfun]
+    refine hS.mono hwt ?_ le_rfl
+    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
+    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
+    unfold LevelData.ampS
+    calc _ ≤ constU4half kap Ybr r * (C.S.Ystar * C.S.delta ^ (m + 1) * (C.S.piL ^ 2)⁻¹) * C.SBracket m r :=
+          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sumCcal_le_SBracket_U4 C m r) hK
+      _ = _ := by ring
+  · intro hg x hs hx
+    simp only [termU4W]
+    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i hi => ?_)
+    have hi' := Finset.mem_range.1 hi
+    have h1 : dd Ltr.s.vec (dperp C.S.p (F (m + 1 - 1 - i)).2) x = 0 :=
+      ((flatDperp_U4 (fun k => (hI (m + 1 - 1 - i) (by omega)).coreW (by omega) k) C.S.p).dd Ltr.s.vec) x hs hx
+    have h2 : C.Psi kinv (dperp C.S.p (F i).2) x = 0 :=
+      (flatPsi_U4 C kinv (flatDperp_U4 (fun k => (hI i hi').coreW (by omega) k) C.S.p)) x hs hx
+    rw [h1, h2]
+    ring
+

+theorem dd_psi_U4 (C : LevelData) {kinv : ℝ → ℝ} {kap : ℝ} {r : ℕ} {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} {A : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
+    {Wt : P3 → ℝ} (hk : TMem C.D (fun _ => 1) kap r kinv) (hW : YMem C.D ρ A m Wt) (v : P3)
+    (hv : v.1 = 0) : EqOn (dd v (C.Psi kinv Wt)) (C.Psi kinv (dd v Wt)) C.D.slab := by
+  intro x hx
+  unfold LevelGeom.Psi
+  have hsA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (sAnti Wt) C.D.slab :=
+    contDiffOn_sAnti C.D.isOpen_slab C.D.sCyl_slab hW.smooth
+  have hk' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (tlift kinv) C.D.slab := contDiffOn_tlift hk.smooth
+  have hprod : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => kinv y.1 * sAnti Wt y) C.D.slab := hk'.mul hsA
+  have hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => kinv y.1 * sAnti Wt y) x :=
+    differentiableAt_of_contDiffOn C.D.isOpen_slab hprod hx
+  have e1 : dd v (fun y => (C.S.N * C.S.sigma)⁻¹ * (kinv y.1 * sAnti Wt y)) x
+      = (C.S.N * C.S.sigma)⁻¹ * dd v (fun y => kinv y.1 * sAnti Wt y) x := by
+    have := dd_const_smul hd1 ((C.S.N * C.S.sigma)⁻¹) v
+    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using this
+  rw [e1]
+  congr 1
+  have e2 := dd_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)
+    (differentiableAt_of_contDiffOn C.D.isOpen_slab hk' hx)
+    (differentiableAt_of_contDiffOn C.D.isOpen_slab hsA hx) v
+  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply'] at e2
+  have hkdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ kinv x.1 :=
+    (hk.smooth.contDiffAt (C.D.isOpen_cdom.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
+  have e3 := dd_sAnti C.D.isOpen_slab C.D.sCyl_slab hW.smooth v hx
+  rw [show (fun y : P3 => kinv y.1 * sAnti Wt y) = fun y => tlift kinv y * sAnti Wt y from rfl, e2,
+    dd_tlift hkdiff, e3, hv]
+  simp [tlift]
+
+theorem dd_comm_U4 {D : Frame} {φ : P3 → ℝ} (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ D.slab) (u v : P3) :
+    EqOn (dd u (dd v φ)) (dd v (dd u φ)) D.slab := by
+  intro x hx
+  have hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 φ x :=
+    (hφ.contDiffAt (D.isOpen_slab.mem_nhds hx)).of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
+  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) x :=
+    (hcd.fderiv_right (m := 1) le_rfl).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
+  have hsym : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ φ x := hcd.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp)
+  have h1 : dd u (dd v φ) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) x u v := by
+    unfold dd; rw [fderiv_clm_apply hd (differentiableAt_const v)]; simp
+  have h2 : dd v (dd u φ) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) x v u := by
+    unfold dd; rw [fderiv_clm_apply hd (differentiableAt_const u)]; simp
+  rw [h1, h2, hsym.eq u v]
+
+theorem eqOn_U4 (C : LevelData) {kinv : ℝ → ℝ} {kap : ℕ → ℝ}
+    (hk : ∀ r, r ≤ C.rstar → TMem C.D (fun _ => 1) (kap r) r kinv) {F : ℕ → Pair} {n : ℕ} (hI : C.Inv F n)
+    (hn : 2 * n ≤ C.rstar + 1) :
+    EqOn (termU4 C kinv F n) (fun x =>
+      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, C.S.N * Js C.S.p (C.Psi kinv (F i).2) (dd Ltr.s.vec (F (n - 1 - i)).2) x)
+      + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), C.S.N * Js C.S.p (C.Psi kinv (F i).2) (C.calZ F (n - 1 - i)) x)
+      C.D.slab := by
+  intro x hx
+  have hv : (dirA (perpR2 C.S.p)).1 = 0 := rfl
+  show termU4W C kinv F n x + termU4Z C kinv F n x = _
+  simp only [termU4W, termU4Z]
+  congr 1
+  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
+    have hi' := Finset.mem_range.1 hi
+    have hWi := ((hI i hi').memW 0 (by omega)).toYMem
+    have hWq := ((hI (n - 1 - i) (by omega)).memW 0 (by omega)).toYMem
+    have e1 : dd Ltr.s.vec (dperp C.S.p (F (n - 1 - i)).2) x = dperp C.S.p (dd Ltr.s.vec (F (n - 1 - i)).2) x :=
+      dd_comm_U4 hWq.smooth Ltr.s.vec (dirA (perpR2 C.S.p)) hx
+    have e2 : C.Psi kinv (dperp C.S.p (F i).2) x = dperp C.S.p (C.Psi kinv (F i).2) x :=
+      (dd_psi_U4 C (hk 0 (Nat.zero_le _)) hWi (dirA (perpR2 C.S.p)) hv hx).symm
+    simp only [Js, e1, e2]
+  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
+    have hi' := Finset.mem_range.1 hi
+    have hWi := ((hI i (by omega)).memW 0 (by omega)).toYMem
+    have e2 : C.Psi kinv (dperp C.S.p (F i).2) x = dperp C.S.p (C.Psi kinv (F i).2) x :=
+      (dd_psi_U4 C (hk 0 (Nat.zero_le _)) hWi (dirA (perpR2 C.S.p)) hv hx).symm
+    simp only [Js, e2]
+

+theorem parity_summand_U4 {L : P3 →L[ℝ] P3} {ε a b c d : ℝ} {A B Cf Df : P3 → ℝ} (N : ℝ)
+    (hA : HasParity L a A) (hB : HasParity L b B) (hC : HasParity L c Cf) (hD : HasParity L d Df)
+    (h1 : a * b = ε) (h2 : c * d = ε) :
+    HasParity L ε (fun x => N * (A x * B x - Cf x * Df x)) := by
+  intro x
+  show N * (A (L x) * B (L x) - Cf (L x) * Df (L x)) = ε • (N * (A x * B x - Cf x * Df x))
+  rw [hA x, hB x, hC x, hD x]
+  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
+  rw [show a * A x * (b * B x) = (a * b) * (A x * B x) by ring,
+    show c * Cf x * (d * Df x) = (c * d) * (Cf x * Df x) by ring, h1, h2]
+  ring

+theorem parity_sum_U4 {L : P3 →L[ℝ] P3} {ε : ℝ} (s : Finset ℕ) {f : ℕ → P3 → ℝ}
+    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, HasParity L ε (f i)) : HasParity L ε (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, f i x) := by
+  intro x
+  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
+  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => h i hi x)

+    (hC : SPeriodic Cf) (hD : SPeriodic Df) :
+    SPeriodic (fun x => N * (A x * B x - Cf x * Df x)) := by
+  intro x
+  show N * (A (x + sPer) * B (x + sPer) - Cf (x + sPer) * Df (x + sPer)) = N * (A x * B x - Cf x * Df x)
+  rw [hA x, hB x, hC x, hD x]

+theorem periodic_sum_U4 (s : Finset ℕ) {f : ℕ → P3 → ℝ} (h : ∀ i ∈ s, SPeriodic (f i)) :
+    SPeriodic (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, f i x) := by
+  intro x
+  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => h i hi x)

+theorem termU4W_sParity (C : LevelData) (kinv : ℝ → ℝ) {F : ℕ → Pair} {n : ℕ}
+    (hP : ∀ j < n, LevelData.ParityOK F j) :
+    HasParity sNegL (lsign n) (termU4W C kinv F n) := by

+theorem sParity_Psi (C : LevelData) (kinv : ℝ → ℝ) {ε : ℝ} {W : P3 → ℝ} (h : HasParity sNegL ε W)

+    (hΨ : HasParity sNegL εΨ Ψ) (hΦ : HasParity sNegL εΦ Φ) :
+    HasParity sNegL (εΨ * εΦ) (brA Ψ Φ) := by
+  intro x
+  have e1 := hΨ.dd_fixed sNegL_sNegL hεΨ (sNegL_vec_a 1) x
+  have e2 := hΦ.dd_fixed sNegL_sNegL hεΦ (sNegL_vec_a 0) x
+  have e3 := hΨ.dd_fixed sNegL_sNegL hεΨ (sNegL_vec_a 0) x
+  have e4 := hΦ.dd_fixed sNegL_sNegL hεΦ (sNegL_vec_a 1) x
+  show -(dd (Ltr.a 1).vec Ψ (sNegL x) * dd (Ltr.a 0).vec Φ (sNegL x))
+      + dd (Ltr.a 0).vec Ψ (sNegL x) * dd (Ltr.a 1).vec Φ (sNegL x)
+      = (εΨ * εΦ) • (-(dd (Ltr.a 1).vec Ψ x * dd (Ltr.a 0).vec Φ x)
+        + dd (Ltr.a 0).vec Ψ x * dd (Ltr.a 1).vec Φ x)
+  rw [e1, e2, e3, e4]
+  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
+  ring

+theorem aParity_brA {εΨ εΦ : ℝ} (hεΨ : εΨ ≠ 0) (hεΦ : εΦ ≠ 0) {Ψ Φ : P3 → ℝ}

+    HasParity aNegL (εΨ * εΦ) (brA Ψ Φ) := by
+  intro x
+  have e1 := hΨ.dd_reversed aNegL_aNegL hεΨ (aNegL_vec_a 1) x
+  have e2 := hΦ.dd_reversed aNegL_aNegL hεΦ (aNegL_vec_a 0) x
+  have e3 := hΨ.dd_reversed aNegL_aNegL hεΨ (aNegL_vec_a 0) x
+  have e4 := hΦ.dd_reversed aNegL_aNegL hεΦ (aNegL_vec_a 1) x
+  show -(dd (Ltr.a 1).vec Ψ (aNegL x) * dd (Ltr.a 0).vec Φ (aNegL x))
+      + dd (Ltr.a 0).vec Ψ (aNegL x) * dd (Ltr.a 1).vec Φ (aNegL x)
+      = (εΨ * εΦ) • (-(dd (Ltr.a 1).vec Ψ x * dd (Ltr.a 0).vec Φ x)
+        + dd (Ltr.a 0).vec Ψ x * dd (Ltr.a 1).vec Φ x)

+theorem dd_s_level_fst_eqOn (C : LevelData) {F : ℕ → Pair} (hF : C.IsCascade F) (m : ℕ)
+    (hf : Forcing C.D (C.forcing (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1))) :
+    EqOn (dd Ltr.s.vec (F (m + 1)).1)
+      (comp 0 (duh C.D C.R (dd Ltr.s.vec (C.forcing (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1))))) C.D.slab := by
+  intro x hx
+  have hsm := contDiffOn_duh C.prop hf
+  rw [dd_congr C.D.isOpen_slab (level_fst_eqOn C hF m hf) Ltr.s.vec hx]
+  have e1 : dd Ltr.s.vec (comp 0 (duh C.D C.R (C.forcing (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1)))) x
+      = (dd Ltr.s.vec (duh C.D C.R (C.forcing (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1))) x) 0 :=
+    iter_comp hsm 0 [Ltr.s] hx
+  rw [e1, dd_duh_letter C.prop hf Ltr.s (by decide) hx]
+  rfl
+
+theorem dd_s_level_snd_eqOn (C : LevelData) {F : ℕ → Pair} (hF : C.IsCascade F) (m : ℕ)
+    (hf : Forcing C.D (C.forcing (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1))) :
+    EqOn (dd Ltr.s.vec (F (m + 1)).2)
+      (comp 1 (duh C.D C.R (dd Ltr.s.vec (C.forcing (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1))))) C.D.slab := by
+  intro x hx
+  have hsm := contDiffOn_duh C.prop hf
+  rw [dd_congr C.D.isOpen_slab (level_snd_eqOn C hF m hf) Ltr.s.vec hx]
+  have e1 : dd Ltr.s.vec (comp 1 (duh C.D C.R (C.forcing (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1)))) x
+      = (dd Ltr.s.vec (duh C.D C.R (C.forcing (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1))) x) 1 :=
+    iter_comp hsm 1 [Ltr.s] hx
+  rw [e1, dd_duh_letter C.prop hf Ltr.s (by decide) hx]
+  rfl
+
+theorem dd_s_forcing_snd (C : LevelData) {G : ℕ → Pair} {n : ℕ}
+    (hf : Forcing C.D (C.forcing G n)) (hS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (C.Stomega G n) C.D.slab)
+    (hper : SPeriodic (C.Stomega G n)) {x : P3} (hx : x ∈ C.D.slab) :
+    (dd Ltr.s.vec (C.forcing G n) x) 1 = -(Pne (C.Stomega G n) x) := by
+  have hU := C.D.isOpen_slab
+  have e1 : dd Ltr.s.vec (comp 1 (C.forcing G n)) x = (dd Ltr.s.vec (C.forcing G n) x) 1 :=
+    iter_comp hf.smooth 1 [Ltr.s] hx
+  rw [← e1]
+  have hfun : comp 1 (C.forcing G n) = fun y => -(sAnti (Pne (C.Stomega G n)) y) := by
+    funext y; simp [comp, LevelGeom.forcing, pairOf_apply_one]
+  have hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Pne (C.Stomega G n)) C.D.slab :=
+    hS.sub (contDiffOn_smean hU C.D.sCyl_slab hS)
+  rw [hfun, dd_neg, dd_s_sAnti hU C.D.sCyl_slab hP (Pne_periodic hper) hx]
+  rw [Pne, smean_Pne (sliceCont_of_contDiffOn C.D.sCyl_slab hS hx), sub_zero]
+
+theorem carrier_eqOn (C : LevelData) {Wt : P3 → ℝ} {kinv kap : ℝ → ℝ} {Ak A : ℝ} {r : ℕ}
+    (hkinv : ∀ t ∈ C.D.cdom, kinv t * kap t = 1)
+    (hk : TMem C.D (fun _ => 1) Ak r kinv) (hW : Y0Mem C.D C.S.wt A r Wt) :
+    EqOn (fun y => C.S.N ^ 2 * kap y.1 * dd Ltr.s.vec (dd Ltr.s.vec (C.Psi kinv Wt)) y)
+      (fun y => C.S.N / C.S.sigma * dd Ltr.s.vec Wt y) C.D.slab := by
+  intro y hy
+  have hU := C.D.isOpen_slab
+  have hyc : y.1 ∈ C.D.cdom := hy
+  have hkd : DifferentiableAt ℝ kinv y.1 :=
+    (hk.smooth.contDiffAt (C.D.isOpen_cdom.mem_nhds hyc)).differentiableAt (by simp)
+  have hprod : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P3 => kinv z.1 * Wt z) C.D.slab :=
+    (contDiffOn_tlift hk.smooth).mul hW.smooth
+  simp only
+  rw [dd_congr hU (C.dd_s_psi hk hW) Ltr.s.vec hy]
+  rw [dd_cmul (differentiableAt_of_contDiffOn hU hprod hy),
+    dd_tcoef_mul_of_fst_zero hU hkd hW.smooth hy (by simp)]
+  have hN := C.S.N_pos.ne'
+  have hσ := C.S.sigma_pos.ne'
+  have hkap : kap y.1 ≠ 0 := fun h0 => by
+    have := hkinv y.1 hyc; rw [h0, mul_zero] at this; exact zero_ne_one this
+  have hki : kinv y.1 = (kap y.1)⁻¹ := (mul_eq_one_iff_eq_inv₀ hkap).1 (hkinv y.1 hyc)
+  rw [hki]
+  field_simp
+
+theorem principal_omega (C : LevelData) {F : ℕ → Pair} (hF : C.IsCascade F) (m : ℕ)
+    (hf : Forcing C.D (C.forcing (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1)))
+    (hS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (C.Stomega (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1)) C.D.slab)
+    (hper : SPeriodic (C.Stomega (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1)))
+    {kinv kap bhat ctwo : ℝ → ℝ} {Ak A : ℝ} {r : ℕ}
+    (hA1 : ∀ t ∈ C.D.cdom, ∀ y : R2, (C.Acoef t y) 1 = bhat t * y 0)
+    (hbhat : ∀ t ∈ C.D.cdom, bhat t = C.S.sigma * ctwo t)
+    (hkinv : ∀ t ∈ C.D.cdom, kinv t * kap t = 1)
+    (hk : TMem C.D (fun _ => 1) Ak r kinv) (hW : Y0Mem C.D C.S.wt A r (F (m + 1)).2)
+    {x : P3} (hx : x ∈ C.D.slab) :
+    dd Ltr.t.vec
+          (fun y => C.S.N ^ 2 * kap y.1 * dd Ltr.s.vec (dd Ltr.s.vec (C.Psi kinv (F (m + 1)).2)) y) x
+        - C.S.N * ctwo x.1 * dd Ltr.s.vec (F (m + 1)).1 x
+      = -(C.S.N / C.S.sigma * Pne (C.Stomega (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x) := by
+  have hU := C.D.isOpen_slab
+  have ht : x.1 ∈ C.D.cdom := hx
+
+  rw [dd_congr hU (carrier_eqOn C hkinv hk hW) Ltr.t.vec hx]
+
+  have hdsW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dd Ltr.s.vec (F (m + 1)).2) C.D.slab := by
+    refine (contDiffOn_comp (contDiffOn_duh C.prop (hf.dd Ltr.s.vec)) 1).congr ?_
+    exact dd_s_level_snd_eqOn C hF m hf
+  rw [dd_cmul (differentiableAt_of_contDiffOn hU hdsW hx)]
+
+  rw [dd_congr hU (dd_s_level_snd_eqOn C hF m hf) Ltr.t.vec hx]
+  have hsm := contDiffOn_duh C.prop (hf.dd Ltr.s.vec)
+  have e1 :
+      dd Ltr.t.vec (comp 1 (duh C.D C.R (dd Ltr.s.vec (C.forcing (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1))))) x
+      = (dd Ltr.t.vec (duh C.D C.R (dd Ltr.s.vec (C.forcing (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1)))) x) 1 :=
+    iter_comp hsm 1 [Ltr.t] hx
+  rw [e1, dd_t_duh C.prop (hf.dd Ltr.s.vec) hx]
+  have e2 : (duh C.D C.R (dd Ltr.s.vec (C.forcing (trunc F (m + 1)) (m + 1))) x) 0
+      = dd Ltr.s.vec (F (m + 1)).1 x := (dd_s_level_fst_eqOn C hF m hf hx).symm
+  simp only [PiLp.add_apply]
+  rw [hA1 x.1 ht, e2, dd_s_forcing_snd C hf hS hper hx, hbhat x.1 ht]
+
+  have hσ := C.S.sigma_pos.ne'
+  field_simp
+  ring
+
+theorem dd_mul {f g : P3 → ℝ} {x : P3} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x)
+    (v : P3) : dd v (fun y => f y * g y) x = dd v f x * g x + f x * dd v g x := by
+  have e := dd_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) hf hg v
+  simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply'] using e
+
+theorem dd_sep3 {c P : ℝ → ℝ} {g : R2 → ℝ} {x : P3} (hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ c x.1)
+    (hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ P x.2.1) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x.2.2) (v : P3) :
+    dd v (fun y => c y.1 * P y.2.1 * g y.2.2) x
+      = v.1 * deriv c x.1 * P x.2.1 * g x.2.2 + c x.1 * (v.2.1 * deriv P x.2.1) * g x.2.2
+        + c x.1 * P x.2.1 * ddA v.2.2 g x.2.2 := by
+  have hct : DifferentiableAt ℝ (tlift c) x := hc.comp x differentiableAt_fst
+  have hPs : DifferentiableAt ℝ (slift P) x := hP.comp x differentiableAt_snd.fst
+  have hga : DifferentiableAt ℝ (alift g) x := hg.comp x differentiableAt_snd.snd
+  have hcp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => tlift c y * slift P y) x := hct.mul hPs
+  rw [show (fun y : P3 => c y.1 * P y.2.1 * g y.2.2) = fun y => (tlift c y * slift P y) * alift g y
+    from rfl, dd_mul hcp hga, dd_mul hct hPs, dd_tlift hc, dd_slift hP, dd_alift hg]
+  simp only [tlift, slift, alift]
+  ring
+
+def prod4 (w Θ Fs : ℝ → ℝ) (g : R2 → ℝ) : P3 → ℝ := fun z => w z.1 * Θ z.1 * Fs z.2.1 * g z.2.2
+
+theorem prod4_eq (w Θ Fs : ℝ → ℝ) (g : R2 → ℝ) :
+    prod4 w Θ Fs g = fun z => (fun t => w t * Θ t) z.1 * Fs z.2.1 * g z.2.2 := rfl
+
+theorem dd_t_prod4 {w Θ Fs : ℝ → ℝ} {g : R2 → ℝ} {x : P3} {dw dΘ : ℝ}
+    (hw : HasDerivAt w dw x.1) (hΘ : HasDerivAt Θ dΘ x.1)
+    (hFs : DifferentiableAt ℝ Fs x.2.1) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x.2.2) :
+    dd Ltr.t.vec (prod4 w Θ Fs g) x
+      = (dw * Θ x.1 + w x.1 * dΘ) * Fs x.2.1 * g x.2.2 := by
+  have hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t => w t * Θ t) x.1 :=
+    hw.differentiableAt.mul hΘ.differentiableAt
+  have hcd : HasDerivAt (fun t => w t * Θ t) (dw * Θ x.1 + w x.1 * dΘ) x.1 := hw.mul hΘ
+  rw [prod4_eq, dd_sep3 hc hFs hg, hcd.deriv]
+  simp [ddA_zero]
+
+theorem dd_s_prod4 {w Θ Fs : ℝ → ℝ} {g : R2 → ℝ} {x : P3}
+    (hw : DifferentiableAt ℝ w x.1) (hΘ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Θ x.1)
+    (hFs : DifferentiableAt ℝ Fs x.2.1) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x.2.2) :
+    dd Ltr.s.vec (prod4 w Θ Fs g) x
+      = w x.1 * Θ x.1 * deriv Fs x.2.1 * g x.2.2 := by
+  have hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t => w t * Θ t) x.1 := hw.mul hΘ
+  rw [prod4_eq, dd_sep3 hc hFs hg]
+  simp [ddA_zero]
+
+theorem ramp_theta (C : LevelData) {w Θ Ωh Fs : ℝ → ℝ} {g : R2 → ℝ}
+    {kinv kap ahat cone : ℝ → ℝ} {dw Ak A : ℝ} {r : ℕ} {x : P3} (hx : x ∈ C.D.slab)
+    (hw : HasDerivAt w dw x.1) (hΘ : HasDerivAt Θ (ahat x.1 * Ωh x.1) x.1)
+    (hFs : DifferentiableAt ℝ Fs x.2.1) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x.2.2)
+    (hahat : ahat x.1 = -(cone x.1) / (kap x.1 * C.S.sigma)) (hkinv : kinv x.1 * kap x.1 = 1)
+    (hk : TMem C.D (fun _ => 1) Ak r kinv)
+    (hW : Y0Mem C.D C.S.wt A r (prod4 w Ωh Fs g)) :
+    dd Ltr.t.vec (prod4 w Θ Fs g) x
+        + C.S.N * cone x.1 * dd Ltr.s.vec (C.Psi kinv (prod4 w Ωh Fs g)) x
+      = dw * Θ x.1 * Fs x.2.1 * g x.2.2 := by
+  rw [dd_t_prod4 hw hΘ hFs hg, C.dd_s_psi hk hW hx, hahat]
+  have hN := C.S.N_pos.ne'
+  have hσ := C.S.sigma_pos.ne'
+  have hkap : kap x.1 ≠ 0 := fun h0 => by rw [h0, mul_zero] at hkinv; exact zero_ne_one hkinv
+  have hki : kinv x.1 = (kap x.1)⁻¹ := (mul_eq_one_iff_eq_inv₀ hkap).1 hkinv
+  simp only [prod4, hki]
+  field_simp
+  ring
+
+theorem ramp_omega (C : LevelData) {w Θ Ωh Fs : ℝ → ℝ} {g : R2 → ℝ}
+    {kinv kap bhat ctwo : ℝ → ℝ} {dw Ak A : ℝ} {r : ℕ} {x : P3} (hx : x ∈ C.D.slab)
+    {T : Set ℝ} (hT : IsOpen T) (hxT : x.1 ∈ T)
+    (hwT : ∀ t ∈ T, DifferentiableAt ℝ w t) (hΩT : ∀ t ∈ T, DifferentiableAt ℝ Ωh t)
+    (hw : HasDerivAt w dw x.1) (hΘ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Θ x.1)
+    (hΩ : HasDerivAt Ωh (bhat x.1 * Θ x.1) x.1)
+    (hFs : Differentiable ℝ Fs) (hFs' : Differentiable ℝ (deriv Fs)) (hg : Differentiable ℝ g)
+    (hbhat : bhat x.1 = C.S.sigma * ctwo x.1) (hkinv : ∀ t ∈ C.D.cdom, kinv t * kap t = 1)
+    (hk : TMem C.D (fun _ => 1) Ak r kinv)
+    (hW : Y0Mem C.D C.S.wt A r (prod4 w Ωh Fs g)) :
+    dd Ltr.t.vec (fun y => C.S.N ^ 2 * kap y.1
+          * dd Ltr.s.vec (dd Ltr.s.vec (C.Psi kinv (prod4 w Ωh Fs g))) y) x
+        - C.S.N * ctwo x.1 * dd Ltr.s.vec (prod4 w Θ Fs g) x
+      = dw * (C.S.N / C.S.sigma * Ωh x.1) * deriv Fs x.2.1 * g x.2.2 := by
+  have hU := C.D.isOpen_slab
+
+  rw [dd_congr hU (carrier_eqOn C hkinv hk hW) Ltr.t.vec hx]
+  have hdsW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dd Ltr.s.vec (prod4 w Ωh Fs g)) C.D.slab :=
+    contDiffOn_dd hU hW.smooth _
+  rw [dd_cmul (differentiableAt_of_contDiffOn hU hdsW hx)]
+
+  have hV : IsOpen (C.D.slab ∩ Prod.fst ⁻¹' T) := hU.inter (hT.preimage continuous_fst)
+  have hxV : x ∈ C.D.slab ∩ Prod.fst ⁻¹' T := ⟨hx, hxT⟩
+  have heq : EqOn (dd Ltr.s.vec (prod4 w Ωh Fs g))
+      (prod4 w Ωh (deriv Fs) g) (C.D.slab ∩ Prod.fst ⁻¹' T) := by
+    intro y hy
+    rw [dd_s_prod4 (hwT y.1 hy.2) (hΩT y.1 hy.2) (hFs y.2.1) (hg y.2.2)]
+    rfl
+  rw [dd_congr hV heq Ltr.t.vec hxV, dd_t_prod4 hw hΩ (hFs' x.2.1) (hg x.2.2),
+    dd_s_prod4 hw.differentiableAt hΘ (hFs x.2.1) (hg x.2.2), hbhat]
+  have hσ := C.S.sigma_pos.ne'
+  field_simp
+  ring
+
+end AffineCore.Construction.Cascade.Lem55Aux
